content.rendered:
Chennai is one of India's oldest pharmaceutical centres. The city and its industrial suburbs host multinational research centres, listed Indian manufacturers, contract manufacturers, vaccine and diagnostics specialists, and hundreds of distributors that supply hospitals and pharmacies across South India.

This guide profiles 104 pharma companies with a Chennai presence, researched from company websites, official registries and directories in November 2026. Each profile states what the company actually does, where it is based, and the facts that could be verified from public sources.

Quick answer: the leading names

  • Tablets (India) Limited and Amrutanjan Health Care are the city's heritage names, founded in 1938 and 1893 respectively.
  • Apex Laboratories (Zincovit), Malladi Drugs (ephedrine and pseudoephedrine APIs) and Medopharm lead the established mid-size manufacturers.
  • Pfizer and Teva run global development centres in Chennai, and AstraZeneca runs a global technology and services hub here.
  • Hospira (Pfizer) and the Steril-Gene joint venture anchor sterile injectables manufacturing linked to the city.
  • Sai Mirra Innopharm, The Madras Pharmaceuticals and Axxelent Pharma Science lead the contract manufacturing (CDMO/CRAMS) group.
  • Palepu Pharma, Shree Amman Pharma and Sugambhika are among the largest distribution houses in the city.

Pharma in Chennai: the sector at a glance

Tamil Nadu is consistently counted among India's top pharmaceutical manufacturing states, and Chennai is its centre of gravity. Production clusters around the industrial estates on the city's western and southern edges, while research and corporate work concentrates along the Taramani technology corridor.

The Alathur SIDCO pharmaceutical estate and the Irungattukottai and Oragadam SIPCOT parks host formulation and API plants. Orchid Pharma built API facilities at Alathur and dosage-form plants at Irungattukottai, and Hospira, now a Pfizer company, later acquired the Irungattukottai injectables business.

  • Formulations first: most Chennai companies make or market tablets, capsules, liquids and topicals, with branded generics the dominant model.
  • Sterile injectables: Hospira's Irungattukottai plant and the Steril-Gene joint venture give the region regulated-market sterile capacity.
  • APIs: Malladi Drugs is a global-scale maker of ephedrine and pseudoephedrine salts, and Orchid's Alathur site anchors bulk-drug production.
  • Research corridor: TICEL Bio Park and the IIT Madras Research Park in Taramani host Pfizer's Global Drug Development Centre, Teva's development centre and biotech firms such as Levim Lifetech.
  • Traditional medicine: Siddha and Ayurvedic research companies such as Dr JRK's, IMIS Pharmaceuticals and Uni-Labs are a distinctive Chennai strength.
  • Distribution hub: large stockists in areas such as Park Town, Kilpauk and Saidapet supply hospitals and retailers across Tamil Nadu and neighbouring states.

Quick comparison: pharma companies in Chennai

Detailed profiles

1. Aarux Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Aarux Pharmaceuticals is a Chennai company working in nutraceuticals and complementary medicine. Its range is built around eggshell-membrane collagen products for joint health, alongside a colloidal-silver wound cream, a hair-growth serum and gut-health products.

The company's stated focus areas include osteoarthritis, varicose veins and ulcers, hair, skin and nail care, and nerve health. It operates from Anna Nagar West in Chennai.

  • Based in: Anna Nagar West, Chennai
  • Type: nutraceutical and complementary-medicine company
  • Product areas: collagen joint care, wound care, hair and skin care

2. Accede Healthcare (India) Private Limited

Accede Healthcare (India) Private Limited was incorporated in October 2017 and is based in Thousand Lights, Chennai. The company works in the manufacture and export of pharmaceutical products, including finished dosage forms.

Its stated portfolio also covers oncology products, orphan and speciality medicines, medical equipment and healthcare consultancy, which makes it a mixed manufacturing, export and services business rather than a single-product firm.

  • Incorporated: 16 October 2017
  • Based in: Thousand Lights, Chennai
  • Work: finished dosage forms, oncology and speciality products, exports

3. Accord Life Spec Pvt Ltd

Accord Life Spec is a Chennai pharmaceutical formulation company listed in directories as a manufacturer, dealer and exporter. It keeps an office in T. Nagar, Chennai's central business district.

Directory listings also place the company at the SIPCOT Industrial Growth Centre in Oragadam, the industrial corridor south-west of Chennai where several formulation plants are located. Public sources disagree on its founding year, so none is stated here.

  • Based in: T. Nagar, Chennai
  • Also listed at: SIPCOT Industrial Growth Centre, Oragadam
  • Type: formulation manufacturer, dealer and exporter

4. Advanced Biotech Products (P) Ltd

Advanced Biotech Products makes collagen-based biomaterials for wound care and surgery. The Chennai-registered company uses patented collagen technology associated with Encol Corporation of the United States.

Its product families include Helicoll and Healicoll wound dressings, Hemocoll, Surgicoll-Mesh and the Osseograft dental range. The catalogue spans dermal, surgical and dental lines rather than conventional tablets and capsules.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Focus: collagen-based wound care and surgical products
  • Lines: dermal, surgical and dental products

5. Aeon Formulations Pvt Ltd

Aeon Formulations manufactures and markets pharmaceutical products from Chennai. Its public material places weight on Ayurvedic, healthcare and nutraceutical products alongside conventional formulations.

Public information about the company is limited, and parts of its website have carried unrelated spam content, so this profile sticks to the company's core stated activity: making and marketing formulations and wellness products.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Work: manufacture and marketing of formulations
  • Focus: Ayurvedic, healthcare and nutraceutical products

6. AGL Pharma Private Limited

AGL Pharma is a Chennai pharmaceutical manufacturer. The company's own material says its products are checked by government-approved external quality-control agencies, a model smaller manufacturers often use instead of large in-house laboratories.

Beyond that, the company publishes little detail about its range or facilities, so buyers should request its licence and product list directly.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Type: pharmaceutical manufacturer
  • Quality control: external checks by government-approved agencies (company-stated)

7. AMR Pharma India Private Limited

AMR Pharma India Private Limited was incorporated in June 2013 and is based in Anna Nagar West, Chennai. Registry summaries describe it as a maker of solid and liquid oral formulations.

The company describes its unit as WHO-GMP and ISO oriented, producing oral liquids, topicals and cosmetics alongside oral solids. Those certification claims come from the company's own material and are attributed here as such.

  • Incorporated: 17 June 2013
  • Based in: Anna Nagar West, Chennai
  • Makes: oral solids and liquids, topicals and cosmetics

8. Amrutanjan Health Care Ltd.

Amrutanjan is one of India's oldest consumer-health brands. Kasinadhuni Nageswara Rao Pantulu founded the business in Bombay in 1893, and the headquarters moved to Madras in 1914. It has been a public limited company since 1936 and took the name Amrutanjan Health Care Limited in 2007.

From its Mylapore headquarters in Chennai, the company sells pain-management products led by its flagship balm, congestion-relief products, the Comfy women's hygiene range and Fruitnik beverages. It also makes bulk drugs such as theophylline.

  • Founded: 1893
  • Headquarters: Mylapore, Chennai
  • Known for: Amrutanjan Pain Balm
  • Type: listed public company

9. ANS Pharma

ANS Pharma is a small Chennai pharmaceutical trading business based in Kodambakkam. Its IndiaMART profile lists it as a retailer and trader of pharmaceutical tablets and injections, including oncology products such as erlotinib tablets.

Export records also show ANS Pharma shipping medicines through Chennai air cargo. Beyond directory and trade listings, the company publishes little public information, so this profile is deliberately brief.

  • Based in: Kodambakkam, Chennai
  • Type: pharmaceutical trader and retailer
  • Range: tablets and injections, including oncology products (directory-listed)
  • Note: limited public information

10. Anthus Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Anthus Pharmaceuticals is a Chennai pharmaceutical marketing company. Rather than leading with its own factory, it sells through divisions such as Tritilia for ENT and orthopaedics, Vedus for Ayurvedic products, and dedicated intensive-care and wound-care lines.

The company states that it fields a marketing force of more than 250 people and has its products made at accredited facilities. Those figures are the company's own and are attributed here.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Type: pharmaceutical marketing company
  • Divisions: ENT and orthopaedics, Ayurvedic, intensive care, wound care

11. Apex Laboratories Private Limited

Apex Laboratories is one of Chennai's established formulation makers. Incorporated in July 1978 and headquartered in Chennai, the company is credited with pioneering zinc formulations in India, and its Zincovit brand remains its best-known product.

The range covers nutraceuticals, oral solids and liquids, and topicals such as the Sofinox cream launched in 2011. Its manufacturing sits near Chennai, in the city's industrial belt.

  • Founded: incorporated 15 July 1978
  • Headquarters: Chennai
  • Known for: Zincovit
  • Makes: nutraceuticals, oral solids and liquids, topicals

12. Apex Laboratories Pvt Ltd

This entry is a second directory listing for Apex Laboratories, the Chennai company profiled directly above at entry 11. Directories carry the company under both "Apex Laboratories Private Limited" and "Apex Laboratories Pvt Ltd".

To avoid repetition, the full profile sits at entry 11: a Chennai-headquartered maker of zinc formulations, known for the Zincovit brand, incorporated in 1978.

  • Note: duplicate listing of the company at entry 11
  • Headquarters: Chennai
  • Flagship brand: Zincovit

13. ARKAMED PHARMAA

ARKAMED PHARMAA is a small Chennai proprietorship based in Royapettah. Directory listings describe it as a retailer and marketer of pharmaceutical products, with a visible emphasis on cardiovascular tablets.

Pharmacy listings credit Arkamed as manufacturer or marketer of cardiovascular brands including Clopeart AS, Nitrokaa, Carvedka and Metarka. Public information is limited to such listings.

  • Based in: Royapettah, Chennai
  • Type: proprietorship; pharma retail and marketing
  • Focus: cardiovascular tablets

14. AstraZeneca India Pvt Ltd

AstraZeneca's Chennai presence is a services hub, not a factory. The city hosts the company's Global Innovation and Technology Centre, described in recent reporting as a strategic centre for information technology, global business services and global operations, including supply chain and strategy work.

AstraZeneca India's separate Bengaluru hub covers research and digital health. In November 2026 reporting, Naveen Krishna Yamarthi took charge as managing director of the Indian entity and head of the Chennai centre.

  • Chennai presence: Global Innovation and Technology Centre
  • Focus: IT, global business services, supply chain operations
  • Type: multinational subsidiary (no Chennai manufacturing)

15. AURA Biotechnologies Private Limited

AURA Biotechnologies works in diagnostics rather than medicines. The company began in 2014 and is based in Ayanambakkam, Chennai, where it runs research, production and sales for diagnostic kits and reagents.

Its catalogue covers molecular diagnostics, immunology and recombinant proteins, serving human healthcare as well as veterinary, poultry and aquaculture testing. The company operates a GMP manufacturing facility of about 15,000 square feet in Chennai.

  • Started: 2014
  • Based in: Ayanambakkam, Chennai
  • Makes: diagnostic kits, reagents and recombinant proteins
  • Facility: GMP plant in Chennai

16. Awfis Aristo

Awfis Aristo is not a pharmaceutical company. It is a coworking and flexible-workspace centre run by Awfis Space Solutions in the Aristo Building, Thiru Vi Ka Industrial Estate, Ekkattuthangal, Chennai, close to the Guindy industrial area.

It appears in pharma directory listings because businesses, including healthcare and pharma offices, rent space there. It is included so readers are not misled: no medicines are made or sold by this listing itself.

  • Type: flexible workspace (not a medicine manufacturer)
  • Location: Ekkattuthangal, Chennai
  • Operator: Awfis Space Solutions

17. Axxelent Pharma Science Pvt. Ltd

Axxelent Pharma Science is a Chennai-headquartered contract development and manufacturing organisation (CDMO), incorporated in 2019. It offers development and manufacturing across oral solids, injectables, ophthalmic products, oral liquids and topicals.

The company positions its Chennai operations for regulated markets, naming the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Europe and China among the markets it serves.

  • Incorporated: 2019
  • Headquarters: Chennai
  • Type: CDMO
  • Dosage forms: oral solids, injectables, ophthalmic, oral liquids, topicals

18. Bafna Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Bafna Pharmaceuticals began in 1981 as a proprietary concern and set up its first unit at Madhavaram, Chennai in 1984. The company was incorporated in 1995 and is listed on the stock exchange.

Bafna makes betalactam and non-betalactam formulations and works as a contract manufacturer and exporter. Its Grantlyon facility near Red Hills has been described in filings as holding EU-GMP, UK-MHRA and TGA accreditations. The company is now a subsidiary of SRJR Lifesciences LLP.

  • Started: 1981; incorporated 1995
  • Base: Madhavaram and Red Hills area, Chennai
  • Makes: betalactam and non-betalactam formulations
  • Type: listed company

19. Beejan Pharmaceuticals

Beejan Pharmaceuticals is a partnership firm based on Anna Salai at Thousand Lights, Chennai. Directory and company material describe it as a manufacturer and marketer of pharmaceutical products, with a field force working across Tamil Nadu.

Products associated with the firm in pharmacy listings include Bee-Resq, Mecmium and Calciraib. As a partnership, it publishes less formal information than the limited companies on this list.

  • Based in: Thousand Lights, Anna Salai, Chennai
  • Type: partnership firm
  • Work: manufacturing and marketing across Tamil Nadu

20. Biomiicron Pharma india Pvt Ltd

Biomiicron is a Chennai formulation brand with a long trading history: the brand dates to 1999, when it was founded by S. M. K. Ketchaani Rajan, while the present private limited company was incorporated in June 2012 and is registered in Kodambakkam.

Its range covers liquid orals, capsules, tablets, ointments and protein powders, spanning allopathic and Ayurvedic lines in directory descriptions.

  • Brand founded: 1999
  • Company incorporated: 28 June 2012
  • Based in: Kodambakkam, Chennai
  • Makes: tablets, capsules, liquid orals, ointments, protein powders

21. Biomiicron Pharmaceutical

This entry is a second listing for Biomiicron, the Kodambakkam-based formulation company profiled at entry 20. The same company appears in directories as both "Biomiicron Pharma India" and "Biomiicron Pharmaceutical", and both listings use the same logo.

The full profile is at entry 20: a brand dating to 1999, incorporated in its present form in 2012, making tablets, capsules, liquid orals, ointments and protein powders.

  • Note: duplicate listing of the company at entry 20
  • Based in: Kodambakkam, Chennai

22. Cloud 7 Pharma private limited

Cloud 7 Pharma is one of the newest companies on this list. It was incorporated in April 2023 and is based in Ramapuram, Chennai.

Registries classify it in pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution, and directory listings describe a wholesaler and distributor of peptides and pharmaceutical tablets. The company also markets its own brands, including a slimming product sold as Cloud Slim.

  • Incorporated: 5 April 2023
  • Based in: Ramapuram, Chennai
  • Type: wholesaler and distributor
  • Range: peptides and pharmaceutical tablets

23. Delvin Formulations Pvt. Ltd.

Delvin Formulations is a Chennai formulation exporter. Its range has been organised into divisions covering chronic care, gastroenterology, diabetics and a general line sold under the Prima name.

Delvin is now part of Sai Mirra Innopharm, the Chennai contract research and manufacturing group profiled at entry 73, so enquiries for its products route through that group.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Type: formulation exporter
  • Divisions: chronic, gastro, diabetics, general
  • Note: now part of Sai Mirra Innopharm

24. DONAS DRUGS AND PHARMACEUTICALS PVT LTD.,

DONAS Drugs and Pharmaceuticals was incorporated in November 2015, with its registered office in T. Nagar, Chennai. Registry classifications describe the company mainly in wholesale distribution.

The Tamil Nadu Drugs Control department's manufacturer directory separately lists a DONAS address at Vanagaram, Chennai, with manufacturing licences recorded from 2017. Buyers should confirm which licence and site apply to any product they source.

  • Incorporated: 30 November 2015
  • Registered office: T. Nagar, Chennai
  • Also listed at: Vanagaram, Chennai (state manufacturer directory)
  • Type: wholesale distribution and licensed manufacturing listing

25. Dr.JRK’s Research and Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Dr JRK's Research and Pharmaceuticals is a Siddha and Ayurveda research company founded by Padma Shri Dr J. R. Krishnamoorthy. It is based at Kunrathur, Chennai.

The company is best known for its Psorolin range for psoriasis, alongside products such as Nilavembu Kudineer and D-co-D. It states that its work covers more than 40 formulations supported by over 150 publications; those figures are the company's own.

  • Based in: Kunrathur, Chennai
  • Focus: Siddha and Ayurvedic research products
  • Known for: Psorolin range, Nilavembu Kudineer

26. Elance Pharma

Elance Pharma is a Chennai pharmaceutical marketing company. Its public material organises the business around therapy areas rather than a factory: diabetology, cardiology, gynaecology and orthopaedics.

As with other marketing-led firms on this list, products sold under its brands are manufactured by third-party units, so buyers should ask which licensed site makes each product.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Type: pharmaceutical marketing company
  • Therapy areas: diabetology, cardiology, gynaecology, orthopaedics

27. Enma Pharmaceuticals Private Limited

Enma Pharmaceuticals was incorporated in April 2004 and is based in Anna Nagar West, Chennai. Registry records place it in pharmaceutical retail and distribution.

Directory descriptions associate the company with generic medicines and nutraceutical products. It publishes little further public information, so this profile stays brief.

  • Incorporated: 27 April 2004
  • Based in: Anna Nagar West, Chennai
  • Range: generic medicines and nutraceuticals
  • Type: retail and distribution classification

28. Eysys Pharmaceutical Private Limited

Eysys Pharmaceutical is a Chennai-headquartered formulation company with a broad portfolio. Its cardio-diabetic division is the most prominent part of the range in its public material.

The company states a portfolio of more than 250 products and a network of over 400 channel partners. Those numbers come from the company itself and are attributed here rather than independently verified.

  • Headquarters: Chennai
  • Focus: cardio-diabetic range within a broad portfolio
  • Type: formulation marketing company

29. Franco Indian Remedies Private Limited

Franco Indian Remedies is one of the older companies on this list. It was incorporated in May 1973 and runs a unit at Aminjikarai, Chennai, as part of the Franco-Indian group.

State drug-control listings record the unit making tablets, powders and granules, including sustained-release formulations, with licence entries stretching back to the 1980s and 1990s.

  • Incorporated: 18 May 1973
  • Based in: Aminjikarai, Chennai
  • Makes: tablets, powders and granules, including sustained-release forms
  • Group: Franco-Indian group

30. Gladstone Pharma India Pvt.Ltd.

Gladstone Pharma is a Chennai-based formulation company led by its chairman and managing director, Pichai Chandrasekaran. Its public material concentrates on chronic therapies.

The stated therapy areas include pain, epilepsy, stroke, vertigo and migraine, alongside anti-allergic products, dermatology and cosmetology lines, and ENT products.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Focus: chronic therapies, allergy, dermatology and ENT
  • Type: formulation company

31. Global Pharma HealthCare Ltd.

Global Pharma Healthcare was founded in 1999 by a group of doctors, according to the company. It works across finished formulations, sterile and speciality products, nutraceuticals and APIs, and offers contract manufacturing.

The company describes EU-GMP facilities and states a range of more than 450 products supplied to over 40 countries. Those figures are company-stated and are attributed here.

  • Founded: 1999
  • Based in: Chennai
  • Work: formulations, sterile products, nutraceuticals, APIs, contract manufacturing

32. Global Pharma Healthcare Private Limited

This entry is a second listing for Global Pharma Healthcare, profiled at entry 31. The company appears in directories under both "Global Pharma HealthCare Ltd." and "Global Pharma Healthcare Private Limited", with the same logo on both listings.

The full profile is at entry 31: a Chennai company founded in 1999 working in formulations, sterile and speciality products, nutraceuticals, APIs and contract manufacturing.

  • Note: duplicate listing of the company at entry 31
  • Based in: Chennai

33. Green Signal Bio Pharma Pvt Ltd

Green Signal Bio Pharma is a vaccine manufacturer based in Kodambakkam, Chennai. It makes BCG vaccine to Indian and British pharmacopoeia standards.

Alongside the preventive vaccine, the company produces BCG for immunotherapy, sold under names including UROVAC and ONCO, used in bladder-cancer treatment protocols. The company is led by its managing director, Dr P. Murali.

  • Based in: Kodambakkam, Chennai
  • Makes: BCG vaccine and BCG immunotherapy products
  • Type: vaccine manufacturer

34. Hospira Healthcare India Pvt Ltd (a Pfizer company)

Hospira Healthcare India is a Pfizer company. Its link to Chennai runs through the industrial belt at Irungattukottai, west of the city.

When Orchid Pharma sold its generic injectable formulations business, the Irungattukottai facility went with it to Hospira. The plant's work is sterile injectable formulations for global supply, rather than branded products for the Indian retail market.

  • Parent company: Pfizer
  • Chennai-area site: Irungattukottai
  • Makes: generic injectable formulations

35. Imis Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd – Corp office, Chennai

IMIS Pharmaceuticals is an Ayurvedic company founded in 1929, making it one of the oldest names in this guide. Its corporate office is in Chennai.

Its long-running Ayurvedic products include Pithorin, Kumkumadi Lepana, Antanil Gold, Netralite and Rheumaheal. The company is led by its managing director, Dr V. Nagalakshmi.

  • Founded: 1929
  • Corporate office: Chennai
  • Focus: Ayurvedic formulations
  • Known products: Pithorin, Kumkumadi Lepana, Rheumaheal

36. Indus Life Sciences Pvt Ltd

Indus Life Sciences is the pharmaceutical arm of a Chennai group with its corporate office in Abiramapuram. The wider group also works in FMCG, beauty care, food and beverages, and lifestyle products.

That group structure matters when researching the company: the Indus name covers several consumer businesses, of which pharmaceuticals is one part.

  • Corporate office: Abiramapuram, Chennai
  • Group interests: pharmaceuticals, FMCG, beauty care, food and beverages, lifestyle

37. Intsia Pharma® Private Limited

Intsia Pharma is a young Chennai formulation company based in Mangadu. Its operations began in 2019, and the private limited company was incorporated in September 2020.

It sells branded generics across analgesics, anti-diabetics, cardiovascular, central nervous system, gastrointestinal, respiratory and women's health ranges, and writes about export ambitions in its public material.

  • Operations began: 2019; incorporated 5 September 2020
  • Based in: Mangadu, Chennai
  • Range: branded generics across major therapy areas

38. K P Manish Global Ingredients Pvt. Ltd.

K P Manish Global Ingredients supplies ingredients to the food and pharmaceutical industries from Chennai. Rather than making finished medicines, it sources ingredients internationally and supports customers through an application centre.

The company states that it sources from more than 28 countries. Its group includes Kawman Pharma at Cuddalore, Sattva Vaid and Kawman Exact.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Type: food and pharma ingredients supplier
  • Role: international sourcing and application support

39. Karlin Pharmaceuticals & Exports Private Limited

Karlin Pharmaceuticals and Exports was incorporated in March 1999 and is based in Valasaravakkam, Chennai. It is best known for Torex cough syrup and a range of dry syrups.

Directory listings place its unit at the SIDCO Industrial Estate in Thirumudivakkam, one of the smaller industrial estates on Chennai's southern edge.

  • Incorporated: 22 March 1999
  • Based in: Valasaravakkam, Chennai
  • Known for: Torex cough syrup and dry syrups
  • Unit: SIDCO Industrial Estate, Thirumudivakkam

40. LEVIM LIFETECH PVT LTD

Levim Lifetech is a biotechnology company based at TICEL Bio Park in Taramani, Chennai. It works on peptides, proteins and antibody fragments rather than conventional small-molecule medicines.

The company is known for developing a liraglutide biosimilar for type 2 diabetes, reported by the Press Information Bureau as an Indian first under the national biopharma programme. The current company entity was incorporated in February 2021.

  • Based in: TICEL Bio Park, Taramani, Chennai
  • Focus: peptides, proteins and antibody fragments
  • Known for: liraglutide biosimilar development
  • Incorporated: 11 February 2021 (current entity)

41. LIFECARE PHARMA PVT LTD

Lifecare Pharma Private Limited, the Chennai company behind this listing, was incorporated in September 2019 and is based in Gopalapuram. Registries classify it in pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution.

Buyers should note that several unrelated Indian companies trade under similar Lifecare names, and should confirm the Chennai entity's CIN and address before placing orders.

  • Incorporated: 30 September 2019
  • Based in: Gopalapuram, Chennai
  • Type: pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution

42. Lippon Pharma Pvt Ltd

Lippon Pharma was incorporated in June 2019 and is based in Nerkundram, Chennai. Its brochure material covers tablets, capsules, softgels and injectables.

The stated therapy areas are cardiology, nephrology, diabetology, neurology, gynaecology and orthopaedics, and the company says it focuses on hospitals in South India.

  • Incorporated: 4 June 2019
  • Based in: Nerkundram, Chennai
  • Range: tablets, capsules, softgels and injectables
  • Focus: South Indian hospitals

43. Lividus pharmaceuticals

Lividus Pharmaceuticals was founded in 2007 and works from Chennai, with addresses in the Guindy and Thousand Lights areas in directory listings. It sells branded formulations rather than contract-manufacturing services.

Its range spans diabetes, hypertension and lipid disorders, infections, neuropsychiatric care, urology and nephrology, women's health and paediatrics.

  • Founded: 2007
  • Based in: Chennai
  • Range: branded formulations across chronic and acute therapies

44. Lystra Pharma Pvt. Ltd

Lystra Pharma was incorporated in July 2020 and is based in Porur, Chennai, behind the Ramachandra Hospital area. It works in pharmaceuticals, nutraceuticals and health supplements.

The company uses a PCD franchise model, appointing district-level partners to sell its range, which includes a cardiac-diabetic line.

  • Incorporated: 11 July 2020
  • Based in: Porur, Chennai
  • Model: PCD franchise
  • Range: cardiac-diabetic products and supplements

45. Maldi Drugs And Pharma Company

Maldi Drugs and Pharma Company appears in place listings as a pharmaceutical company in Chennai, but publishes almost no verifiable public information about its products, licences or history.

It should not be confused with Malladi Drugs and Pharmaceuticals, the API manufacturer profiled next. Anyone dealing with Maldi should verify its licence and address directly with the company and the state drug-control directory.

  • Based in: Chennai
  • Note: limited public information; verify licences directly

46. Malladi Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Malladi Drugs and Pharmaceuticals is Chennai's best-known API manufacturer. Founded in 1980 by M. L. N. Sastry and headquartered at Guindy, it became a leader in ephedrine and pseudoephedrine salts, and the first Indian maker to produce them through an indigenous fermentation process.

Its API units are at Ranipet and Renigunta, and the company reports inspections by the US FDA, EDQM, ANSM, KFDA and TGA. It was also the first Indian company to acquire an API facility abroad, in New Jersey, United States.

  • Founded: 1980
  • Headquarters: Guindy, Chennai
  • Known for: ephedrine and pseudoephedrine salt APIs
  • Plants: Ranipet and Renigunta, plus a unit in the United States

47. Maxell pharma pvt ltd

Maxell Pharma Private Limited is a Chennai-area pharmaceutical company incorporated in April 2010. Its registered office is at Iyyappanthangal, in the Sriperumbudur side of the Chennai region.

Registry and GST records classify the company in pharmaceutical manufacturing with wholesale and retail activity. It is a separate business from the Japanese electronics company of a similar name.

  • Incorporated: 16 April 2010
  • Registered office: Iyyappanthangal, Chennai region
  • Type: pharmaceutical company

48. Medi Sales India Pvt Ltd

Medi Sales India is a pharmaceutical distribution company in Chennai. Its office is at Kilpauk Garden Colony and its warehouse at Madhavaram, on the city's northern side.

The company highlights temperature-sensitive storage, which matters for vaccines and other cold-chain products. Its group includes Medi Sales Agencies, Pharma Edge, Maxx Farmacia and the Medway Hospitals business.

  • Based in: Kilpauk (office) and Madhavaram (warehouse), Chennai

How to choose a Chennai pharma supplier

Chennai's pharma market mixes global research centres, audited export plants and small trading firms. The checks below help separate a licensed manufacturer from a marketing office before you place an order or sign a franchise agreement.

  • Confirm the manufacturing licence number and site address against the Tamil Nadu Drugs Control department's published directories.
  • Ask for current GMP or WHO-GMP certificates, and for regulated-market approvals (for example US FDA or EU-GMP) where the supplier claims them.
  • Verify the legal entity behind the brand: incorporation details and registered address are public through MCA-derived registries such as Zaubacorp and The Company Check.
  • For distributors, ask for authorised-stockist letters from the manufacturers they claim to represent, and check cold-chain storage for vaccines and biologics.
  • Search for regulatory actions and alerts before committing: licences can be suspended, as the Sresan case in this list shows.
  • Visit the site, start with a trial order, and confirm who actually manufactures the product if you are dealing with a marketing company.

Frequently asked questions

Which are the largest pharma companies in Chennai?

By history and scale, the standout names are Tablets (India) Limited (founded 1938), Amrutanjan Health Care (1893), Apex Laboratories, Medopharm and Malladi Drugs. Multinationals add research weight rather than factories: Pfizer, Teva and AstraZeneca all run major Chennai centres.

Which parts of Chennai have the most pharma factories?

Manufacturing clusters around the western and southern industrial belts: Alathur, Irungattukottai, Oragadam, Ambattur, Madhavaram and Thirumudivakkam. Research and development concentrates in Taramani, around TICEL Bio Park and the IIT Madras Research Park.

Do Chennai pharma companies export?

Yes. Sai Mirra Innopharm, Medopharm, Global Pharma Healthcare and Unilink Pharma all describe export businesses, and Malladi Drugs supplies API customers in regulated markets including the United States and Europe. Export claims in this guide are attributed to the companies or their filings.

How can I verify a Chennai pharma supplier?

Check the company's licence in the Tamil Nadu Drugs Control directory, confirm its CIN and registered address in an MCA-derived registry, and ask for GMP certificates that name the actual manufacturing site. A marketing company's address is not proof of a factory.

Are all 104 entries manufacturers?

No. The list reflects Chennai's real pharma economy, so it also includes distributors, marketing companies, a contract research organisation, a software company, two research parks and one coworking centre that appeared in directory listings. Each profile states plainly what the organisation does.

Why do some companies appear twice in the list?

Directory data often lists the same company under two name variants or two addresses. Apex Laboratories, Biomiicron, Global Pharma Healthcare, Palepu Pharma and Tanmed each appear twice for this reason, and the second entry is marked as a duplicate rather than padded out.

content.rendered:
Mumbai is where Indian pharma keeps its head office. The largest drugmaker in the country, Sun Pharma, is run from Goregaon, and Cipla, Lupin and Glenmark are all headquartered in the city, alongside the Indian arms of GSK and Novartis.

This guide profiles the pharmaceutical companies headquartered or based in Mumbai, from listed multinationals to small export and marketing firms. Every profile below was researched in November 2026 from company websites, registries and filings, and each company keeps the logo or photo it already had on this page.

Quick answer

If you only need the headline names, these are the Mumbai pharma companies most readers are looking for:

  • Sun Pharmaceutical Industries — India's largest pharma company, headquartered at Goregaon (East).
  • Cipla — founded in Mumbai in 1935, known worldwide for affordable generics and inhalers.
  • Lupin — Santacruz (East) headquarters, strong in generics, biosimilars and APIs.
  • Glenmark — Mumbai-based, focused on respiratory, dermatology and oncology.
  • GSK India and Novartis India — the listed Indian arms of two global groups, both run from Mumbai.
  • FDC and Aristo — long-established Mumbai formulation makers, incorporated in 1940 and 1971.

Pharma in Mumbai: a head-office capital

Mumbai's role in Indian pharma is concentrated at the top of the company rather than on the factory floor. The pattern repeats across this list: the boardrooms, regulatory teams and export desks sit in Mumbai, while large-scale manufacturing has mostly moved to dedicated industrial states.

  • Head offices: Sun Pharma (Goregaon), Cipla, Lupin (Santacruz East), Glenmark and FDC (Andheri) are all headquartered in the city, as are GSK India at Worli and Novartis India at Bandra Kurla Complex.
  • Manufacturing belt: the Thane–Belapur corridor in Navi Mumbai grew up as the city's production zone, and firms such as FDC still run plants across Maharashtra, but its listed plants also sit in Goa and Himachal Pradesh, which is typical of the industry today.
  • Finance and listings: most of the large names here are listed on the BSE and NSE, both headquartered in Mumbai, so investor relations and compliance teams are local too.
  • Trade and exports: the city's port and air-cargo links support export-led firms such as Infugen Pharma, which ships formulations from Mumbai to markets in Africa, South East Asia and beyond.
  • Smaller firms: below the listed majors sits a layer of marketing-led and niche companies, including a women's-health specialist (Cibeles), a dermatology marketer (AMET Healthcare) and a B2B sourcing platform (PharmaCompass).

Quick comparison — pharma companies in this guide

The table mixes very different kinds of business, from listed manufacturers to a sourcing platform and a German drug-delivery specialist. The profiles below explain what each one actually does, so read the detail before comparing them.

Detailed profiles

1. AMET Healthcare Private Limited

AMET Healthcare is an Indian healthcare company built around sales, marketing and distribution rather than its own factories. Its own website says it was established in 2013 and markets pharmaceuticals, wellness and other healthcare products in India and overseas.

Its stated specialism is dermatology and cosmetology: skin and hair care brands are its competitive focus, and it distributes partner brands across the rest of Maharashtra and Goa. That makes it a marketing partner for skincare brands rather than a contract manufacturer.

  • Established: 2013 (company website)
  • Focus: dermatology and cosmetology products
  • Business model: sales, marketing and distribution of healthcare products
  • Type: private limited company

2. Amnour Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Amnour Pharmaceuticals is a young, marketing-led formulations company. Its own website dates its establishment to 10 February 2021 and gives its office address at Pimpri, on the Old Mumbai–Pune Highway, so it serves the Mumbai market from the Pune side of the corridor.

Its brands appear on pharmacy listings across everyday categories: Calnoria calcium tablets, Esnoria-L for reflux and the Mucinour respiratory range are all marketed by Amnour, according to Apollo Pharmacy and 1mg product pages. The company says its products are manufactured for it at WHO-GMP and ISO certified plants.

  • Established: 10 February 2021 (company website)
  • Base: Pimpri, Pune, on the Old Mumbai–Pune Highway
  • Known brands: Calnoria, Esnoria-L and Mucinour (pharmacy listings)
  • Model: own brands made at certified partner plants (company statement)

3. Aristo Pharmaceuticals Private Limited

Aristo Pharmaceuticals is one of Mumbai's long-established private formulation makers. Ministry of Corporate Affairs records show it was incorporated on 8 November 1971 and registered in Mumbai, and it has traded for more than five decades since.

Its registered office is at Shah Industrial Estate, off Veera Desai Road in Andheri (West). The company remains privately held and focuses on branded formulations for the Indian market, sold through its own field force.

  • Incorporated: 8 November 1971 (MCA records)
  • Registered office: Andheri (West), Mumbai
  • Type: private limited company
  • Business: branded pharmaceutical formulations

4. Cibeles Pharmaceutical Private Limited

Cibeles is a nutritional and pharmaceutical company dedicated solely to women's healthcare, which makes it the niche specialist on this list. Company profile data records that it was registered in May 2019 and began market operations in March 2020.

It was formed in alliance with BDR Pharmaceuticals, which backs it with manufacturing and research support. Its registered office is in the Mahalaxmi area of Mumbai, and its credo, published on its own website, puts Indian women's health at the centre of the business.

  • Registered: May 2019; market operations from March 2020
  • Registered office: Mahalaxmi, Mumbai (MCA records)
  • Focus: women's healthcare and nutrition
  • Backing: formed in alliance with BDR Pharmaceuticals

5. Cipla Limited

Cipla is Mumbai's oldest big pharma name. It was founded in 1935 by Dr Khwaja Abdul Hamied as The Chemical, Industrial & Pharmaceutical Laboratories, and shortened its name to Cipla in 1984. The company is headquartered in Mumbai and listed on the Indian stock exchanges.

Cipla built its reputation on affordable medicines: it is a leader in respiratory products such as inhalers, and in 2001 it drew global attention by offering HIV antiretroviral treatment at a small fraction of the prevailing price. Its range today covers respiratory, cardiovascular, diabetes and anti-infective medicines.

  • Founded: 1935, by Khwaja Abdul Hamied
  • Headquarters: Mumbai
  • Type: public listed company
  • Known for: respiratory medicines, inhalers and affordable generics

6. F D C Limited

FDC began in 1936 as a partnership firm started by Anand Chandavarkar to import pharmaceutical dosage forms, infant foods and surgical goods. It was incorporated in 1940 as Fairdeal Corporation (Private) Limited, renamed FDC Private Limited in 1986, and listed on the BSE and NSE in 1996.

The company is best known as a pioneer of oral rehydration salts in India: its Electral brand is a household name, and it is also a significant maker of ophthalmic products. Its plants are at Roha, Waluj and Sinnar in Maharashtra, Verna in Goa and Baddi in Himachal Pradesh, while the head office stays in Mumbai.

  • Founded: 1936; incorporated as Fairdeal Corporation in 1940
  • Listed: BSE and NSE, 1996
  • Headquarters: Mumbai (Andheri West)
  • Known for: Electral oral rehydration salts and ophthalmics

7. GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited

GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals Limited, known as GSK India, is the listed Indian subsidiary of the British biopharma group GSK plc. The Indian company was incorporated in 1924, originally as Glindia Limited, and took its present name in 2001 after the global Glaxo and SmithKline merger.

Its registered office is GSK House on Dr Annie Besant Road in Worli, Mumbai. GSK India manufactures, sells and distributes prescription medicines and vaccines across India, with a manufacturing facility at Nashik in Maharashtra supporting the business.

  • Incorporated: 1924 (as Glindia Limited)
  • Parent: GSK plc, United Kingdom
  • Registered office: GSK House, Worli, Mumbai
  • Focus: prescription medicines and vaccines

8. Glenmark Pharmaceuticals Ltd

Glenmark is a Mumbai-headquartered, listed pharmaceutical company founded in 1977 by Gracias Saldanha. It has grown from an Indian generics business into a company with branded and speciality products sold in markets around the world.

Its stated focus areas are respiratory, dermatology and oncology, and it combines a large generics portfolio with speciality brands. Glenmark's current logo, shown here, is taken from the company's own website.

  • Founded: 1977, by Gracias Saldanha
  • Headquarters: Mumbai
  • Type: public listed company
  • Focus: respiratory, dermatology and oncology

9. Infugen Pharma Pvt Ltd

Infugen Pharma is an export house for pharmaceutical formulations, run from Mulund (West) in Mumbai. Its website gives its head office at Runwal R Square on L B S Road, Mulund, and traces the business back to 1999.

The company specialises in oncology formulations alongside tablets, capsules, IV infusions and antibiotics, and says its oncology unit is WHO-GMP certified. It reports 115 products registered across 20 countries, with partners across Africa, South East Asia, Sri Lanka, Central America and the CIS.

  • Origins: 1999 (company website)
  • Head office: Mulund (West), Mumbai
  • Specialism: oncology and general formulation exports
  • Reach: 115 products registered in 20 countries (company statement)

10. Lupin Limited

Lupin was founded in Mumbai in 1968 by Dr Desh Bandhu Gupta, a chemistry professor who started the company to fight diseases of national priority, beginning with anti-tuberculosis medicines. It is now a listed, transnational company headquartered at Kalpataru Inspire, off the Western Express Highway in Santacruz (East).

Lupin sells branded and generic formulations, biotechnology products and active pharmaceutical ingredients in more than 100 markets. Its research base includes the Lupin Research Park near Pune, and the company is led today by the founder's family, including chief executive Vinita Gupta.

  • Founded: 1968, by Desh Bandhu Gupta
  • Headquarters: Santacruz (East), Mumbai
  • Type: public listed company
  • Known for: generics, complex generics, biosimilars and APIs in 100+ markets

11. Novartis India Limited

Novartis India Limited is the listed Indian arm of Novartis AG, the Swiss innovative-medicines group headquartered in Basel. Its registered office is at Inspire BKC in Bandra Kurla Complex, Bandra (East), Mumbai.

Unlike the generics-led companies on this list, Novartis India's business centres on patented, innovative medicines in speciality areas. The Mumbai office runs the Indian operations of the group, including medical, regulatory and commercial functions.

  • Parent: Novartis AG, Basel, Switzerland
  • Registered office: Inspire BKC, Bandra (East), Mumbai
  • Type: public listed company
  • Focus: innovative (patented) medicines

12. PharmaCompass

PharmaCompass is the odd one out on this list: not a manufacturer, but a digital B2B platform for the pharmaceutical industry. Registry data records the business, legally Lepro Pharma Compass OPC Private Limited, as founded in 2014.

The platform helps companies source active ingredients, finished formulations and excipients, and sells access to regulatory intelligence such as US drug master files (USDMFs), certificates of suitability (CEPs), prices, patents and inspection data. It is a research and sourcing tool used by procurement and business-development teams.

  • Founded: 2014 (registry data)
  • Legal name: Lepro Pharma Compass OPC Private Limited
  • Type: B2B marketplace and data platform
  • Covers: APIs, finished formulations, excipients, DMF and CEP data

13. RENAISSANCE PHARMACEUTICALS

Renaissance Pharmaceuticals is a Mumbai pharmaceutical company based at Andheri Industrial Estate on Veera Desai Road, Andheri (West). Its legal entity record (LEI) is active, and local business listings describe it as a pharmaceutical dealer and manufacturer operating since around 2006.

Public information about the company is limited beyond registry and trade data, which show it importing active ingredients and vitamins through Mumbai ports in recent years. Treat this profile as a starting point and verify licences and product range directly with the company before trading. (Limited public information.)

  • Base: Andheri Industrial Estate, Veera Desai Road, Andheri (West), Mumbai
  • Status: active registered entity (LEI record)
  • Activity: pharmaceutical manufacturing and trading
  • Note: limited public information; verify directly before trading

14. Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Limited

Sun Pharma is the biggest name on this list by a wide margin: India's largest pharmaceutical company and one of the world's largest specialty generics companies. It was founded in 1983 by Dilip Shanghvi, who remains its chairman and managing director.

Its headquarters is Sun House on the Western Express Highway at Goregaon (East), Mumbai. From there it runs a business spanning generics, branded formulations, consumer healthcare brands and active ingredients, and its 2014 acquisition of Ranbaxy consolidated its position at the top of Indian pharma.

  • Founded: 1983, by Dilip Shanghvi
  • Headquarters: Sun House, Goregaon (East), Mumbai
  • Type: public listed company
  • Known for: India's largest pharma company; specialty generics and chronic-care brands

15. LTS Lohmann Therapie-Systeme AG

LTS Lohmann is included because its logo appeared on this page and its technology is part of the Mumbai pharma story, but it is not a Mumbai company: it is a German drug-delivery specialist founded in 1984 and headquartered in Andernach, Germany. No Mumbai plant or office for LTS could be verified from public sources.

LTS develops and manufactures transdermal patches and oral thin films for pharmaceutical partners, with more than 20 marketed products built on its technology. If you are sourcing patch technology rather than a Mumbai supplier, LTS belongs on that separate shortlist.

  • Founded: 1984
  • Headquarters: Andernach, Germany
  • Specialism: transdermal patches (TTS) and oral thin films (OTF)
  • Note: technology partner, not a Mumbai-based company

How to choose a Mumbai pharma partner

The companies above do very different jobs, so match the type of business to what you actually need before comparing prices or terms:

  • For branded formulations and distribution muscle: look at the established Mumbai makers such as Aristo, FDC, Cipla, Lupin and Glenmark.
  • For exports and registrations in emerging markets: an export house such as Infugen Pharma is set up for exactly that work.
  • For a niche portfolio: Cibeles covers women's health, while AMET Healthcare offers dermatology-led marketing and distribution.
  • For sourcing and market data: use a platform such as PharmaCompass to find API and formulation suppliers and check their regulatory filings.
  • For drug-delivery technology: transdermal and oral-film specialists such as LTS Lohmann license technology rather than supplying the local market directly.

What to verify before you sign or order

  • Manufacturing and wholesale drug licences issued by the Maharashtra FDA, checked against the legal name on the licence.
  • Current company status and directors on the Ministry of Corporate Affairs registry, especially for smaller private firms.
  • GMP and WHO-GMP certificates for the actual plant that will make your product, not just the brand making the claim.
  • For listed companies, the latest annual report and exchange filings, which are public on BSE and NSE.
  • Product-level registrations and trademarks for any brand you plan to distribute, confirmed on the label and with the marketer named on it.

Frequently asked questions

Which is the largest pharma company headquartered in Mumbai?

Sun Pharmaceutical Industries, headquartered at Sun House, Goregaon (East). It is India's largest pharmaceutical company and one of the largest specialty generics companies in the world.

Which companies in this guide are listed on the stock exchanges?

Sun Pharma, Cipla, Lupin, Glenmark, FDC, GlaxoSmithKline Pharmaceuticals and Novartis India are all publicly listed in India. Aristo, AMET Healthcare, Cibeles, Infugen, Amnour and Renaissance are private companies, and PharmaCompass is a private digital platform.

Do these companies manufacture inside Mumbai?

Mostly, no. Mumbai hosts their head offices, and some production remains in the wider region, including the Thane–Belapur belt in Navi Mumbai. Large plants are usually in other states: FDC, for example, manufactures in Maharashtra, Goa and Himachal Pradesh.

Which Mumbai pharma company focuses on women's healthcare?

Cibeles Pharmaceutical Private Limited, registered in 2019 and backed by BDR Pharmaceuticals, works only in women's healthcare and nutrition.

Which company here is known for oral rehydration salts?

FDC Limited, the Mumbai company behind Electral. FDC began as Fairdeal Corporation in the 1930s and is regarded as a pioneer of ORS in India.

How can I check a small Mumbai pharma firm before trading with it?

Start with the checks in the verification section above: MCA status, Maharashtra FDA licences and plant-level GMP certificates. Where public information is thin, as with Renaissance Pharmaceuticals on this list, verify everything directly with the company.

This guide was researched and rewritten in November 2026 from company websites, corporate registries and stock-exchange information. Company details change, so confirm anything you plan to rely on with the company itself.

title.rendered: Top 62 Pharma Companies in Chandigarh Tri-city (2026)

content.rendered:
Chandigarh's pharmaceutical trade is not centred on factories inside the city. It is centred on offices. Most of the 62 companies in this guide sell, market or arrange manufacture from Chandigarh, Mohali and Panchkula, while the actual plants sit in the Baddi-Barotiwala-Nalagarh belt of Himachal Pradesh or in nearby industrial estates such as Derabassi and Barwala.

This guide was researched afresh in November 2026: company websites first, then corporate registry records and established trade directories. Every profile states what could be verified, marks company claims as claims, and keeps each company's existing logo in place. Use the quick answer and the comparison table to shortlist, then verify licences before you sign anything.

Quick answer

  • Most of these 62 companies are PCD franchise and marketing businesses, not factory owners. Manufacturing usually happens at units in Baddi, Nalagarh, Derabassi or Barwala.
  • The oldest names by registry date are Ultra Chiron Pharmaceuticals (1993), Focus Healthcare (1998), Sanify Healthcare (2003) and Sanctus Global Formulations (2008, founded as Crescent Therapeutics).
  • The only national listed major with a tricity plant is Sun Pharma, whose SEZ unit operates at Phase VIII-A, Mohali.
  • Two entries, PharmaAdda and Pharmahopers.com, are online platforms rather than manufacturers. Their profiles say so plainly.
  • Before paying any franchise deposit, verify the company's drug licence, the manufacturing site's WHO-GMP certificate and the exact legal entity name on the agreement.

How the Chandigarh tricity pharma cluster works

A Department of Pharmaceuticals cluster survey counted 43 pharmaceutical units in the Panchkula cluster and 80 in the Derabassi cluster in SAS Nagar district. Across the state border, the same survey counted about 400 units in the Baddi-Barotiwala-Nalagarh belt in Solan district. That belt grew after the central industrial package of June 2003 and sits roughly 45 minutes from Chandigarh by road.

Chandigarh itself plays a different role. Its Industrial Area Phase 1 and Phase 2, and the Motor Market at Manimajra, are dense with registered offices, marketing offices and franchise headquarters of companies whose products are made elsewhere. Panchkula adds the HSIIDC estates at Barwala and Alipur, and Mohali adds JLPL Sector 82, Derabassi and Zirakpur. One directory, PharmaAdda, counts about 800 pharma companies registered across Chandigarh and the tricity.

  • Where the factories are: the Baddi-Barotiwala-Nalagarh belt (Solan, Himachal Pradesh) is the main formulation zone. CDSCO runs a zonal office at Baddi covering Himachal Pradesh, Haryana, Punjab, Chandigarh, Jammu and Kashmir and Ladakh.
  • Where the offices are: Manimajra Motor Market and Industrial Area Phase 1 and 2 in Chandigarh; HSIIDC Barwala and Alipur and Industrial Area Phase 1 and 2 in Panchkula; JLPL Sector 82, Derabassi and Zirakpur in Mohali district.
  • The dominant business model is PCD (propaganda-cum-distribution) franchising, where a local partner gets district-level monopoly rights to market a company's brands.
  • The second model is third-party or contract manufacturing, where brands outsource production to units in Baddi, Nalagarh or Derabassi and concentrate on sales.
  • Industry blogs often estimate that the BBN belt produces 35 to 45 per cent of India's formulations. Treat those figures as industry estimates, not official statistics.

Comparison table: the 62 companies at a glance

Based in shows where each company's office or works sits, from the research behind this guide. Known for uses only facts stated in the profiles below.

The 62 companies in detail

1. Advi Pure Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd

Advi Pure Pharmaceuticals is one of the newest names on this list. The company was incorporated on 31 July 2024 and is registered with the Registrar of Companies, Chandigarh. Its registered office is at Zirakpur, on the Chandigarh border in Mohali district. It works in third-party manufacturing, supplying formulations that other brands sell under their own labels.

Directory listings describe a range that also covers beta-lactam antibiotics and ayurvedic preparations, and one listing places a manufacturing plant at Kala Amb in Himachal Pradesh. Because the company is recently incorporated, buyers should verify its licences and plant arrangements directly before placing orders.

  • Registered office: Unit 414, Sushma Infinium, Zirakpur (Mohali district)
  • Incorporated: 31 July 2024 (CIN U21002PB2024PTC062177)
  • Directors: Advitya Sharma and Pranav Kohli
  • Model: third-party manufacturing
  • Forms listed: tablets, capsules, softgels, syrups, injectables, ointments, eye and ear drops, ayurvedic products
  • Contact: advipure@gmail.com

2. Alna Biotech Pvt Ltd

Alna Biotech is one of the established PCD franchise companies of the tricity. It was incorporated on 5 November 2009 and keeps its registered office at Manimajra in Chandigarh. The company says its head office is at Plot 270 in Panchkula and its factory at Plot 21 in the HSIIDC Industrial Estate at Alipur-Barwala.

The company markets a catalogue that directories put at more than 1,200 products. Its ranges cover critical care, pain relief, antibiotics, orthopaedics, dermatology, gynaecology, paediatrics and ayurvedic lines. Franchise partners are offered district-level monopoly rights, according to the company's website.

  • Registered office: SCF 1013, Motor Market, Manimajra, Chandigarh
  • Factory: Plot 21, HSIIDC Industrial Estate, Alipur-Barwala, Panchkula (company website)
  • Incorporated: 5 November 2009 (CIN U24232CH2009PTC031855)
  • Model: PCD franchise with monopoly rights
  • Known for: a wide multi-segment catalogue across acute and chronic ranges

3. AREIC India Pharma

AREIC India Pharma works from Plot 315 in Industrial Area Phase 2, Panchkula, and directories date the business to 2020. It combines PCD franchise distribution with manufacturing, including its own soft gelatin capsule unit at Kala Amb in Himachal Pradesh, according to its IndiaMART profile. A further address at Yamuna Nagar also appears in industry listings.

  • Based in: Industrial Area Phase 2, Panchkula
  • Model: PCD franchise, manufacturing, trading and distribution
  • Manufacturing: own softgel unit at Kala Amb (per IndiaMART profile)
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, softgels, injectables, syrups, dry syrups, protein powder
  • Contact: info.areicindiapharma@gmail.com

4. Arkle Healthcare Pvt Ltd

Arkle Healthcare was incorporated in 2017 and is registered at Plot 940, Industrial Area Phase II, Chandigarh. Chief executive Shiv Bhasin leads the company. Arkle runs a PCD franchise network and also takes third-party manufacturing and trading work, supplying a broad general range rather than a single speciality.

  • Incorporated: 2017 (CIN U24304CH2017PTC041742)
  • Based in: Industrial Area Phase II, Chandigarh
  • Leadership: Shiv Bhasin
  • Model: PCD franchise and third-party manufacturing
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, soft gelatin capsules, syrups, dry syrups, paediatric drops, injections, ointments, protein powders, ayurvedic tonics

5. Arlak Biotech Pvt Ltd

Arlak Biotech is headquartered at Zirakpur, just outside Chandigarh, and is built around the PCD franchise model. It offers district-level monopoly rights to franchise partners. On its website the company claims ISO 9001:2008 certification and GMP and WHO-approved manufacturing arrangements.

The company says its catalogue runs to more than 2,500 branded and generic formulations. It also runs specialist divisions, including Soigner Pharma, Moruf Lifesciences and an ayurvedic division trading as Arlak Ayurveda. Managing director Umesh Kalra leads the business.

  • Based in: Zirakpur, near Chandigarh
  • Model: PCD franchise with district monopoly rights
  • Claims (company website): ISO 9001:2008 certification; GMP and WHO-approved status
  • Divisions named by the company: Soigner Pharma, Moruf Lifesciences, Arlak Ayurveda
  • Leadership: Umesh Kalra (managing director)

6. Aseric Pharma

Aseric Pharma is a proprietorship firm led by Darshna Bansal, working from Ranjan Plaza at Palm Enclave, Zirakpur. Its IndiaMART profile dates the business to 2021. Aseric specialises in PCD franchise distribution and also arranges third-party and contract manufacturing, with products made at WHO, ISO and GMP certified plants, according to the company.

  • Based in: Zirakpur (Mohali district)
  • Leadership: Darshna Bansal (proprietor)
  • Since: 2021 (company profile)
  • Model: PCD franchise; third-party and contract manufacturing
  • Segments: dermatology and cosmetics, cardiac-diabetic, general medicine, critical care, dental, ophthalmology, gynaecology, paediatrics
  • Also known for: a prominent ayurvedic range

7. Asterisk Healthcare

Asterisk Healthcare dates its business to 2005, which makes it one of the older names in this list. Its corporate office is at NAC Manimajra in Chandigarh. The company focuses on third-party manufacturing of tablets, capsules and dry syrups in DCGI-approved ranges, and says its manufacturing units hold WHO-GMP and GLP certification.

  • Based in: SCO 867, NAC Manimajra, Chandigarh
  • Since: 2005 (company)
  • Model: third-party manufacturing
  • Plant address listed at Bathri, Haroli, Una district, Himachal Pradesh
  • Claims (company): ISO accreditation; WHO-GMP and GLP certified units; 50-plus ranges offered for third-party work

8. Asto Care Pharmaceutical

Asto Care Pharmaceutical began operations in 2020, according to its website, and works from Industrial Area Phase 1 in Panchkula, where it also places a manufacturing facility. It is a PCD franchise company. The company claims a network of more than 300 distributors, over 1,500 products and more than 100 brands, so treat those figures as its own marketing numbers.

  • Based in: Plot 362, Amartex Business Center, Industrial Area Phase 1, Panchkula
  • Since: 2020 (company website)
  • Model: PCD franchise
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, syrups, injections, ointments and dermatology products
  • Brands named on its website: Neroasht Forte, the Vildacast range, Amesto CV 625, Astobril 90, the Glimvit range
  • Contact: astocarepharma@gmail.com

9. Avosia Pharma Pvt Ltd

Avosia Pharma is a young company, incorporated in 2023 and registered at Plot 315, Industrial Area Phase 2, Panchkula. Chief executive J.K. Garg leads the business. It offers PCD franchise distribution and third-party manufacturing, and its website puts the range at more than 500 products. A veterinary arm, Avosia Vetcare, works as a subsidiary, according to the company.

  • Incorporated: 2023 (CIN U46497PB2023PTC058130)
  • Based in: Panchkula
  • Leadership: J.K. Garg
  • Model: PCD franchise and third-party manufacturing
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, softgels, syrups, injectables, ointments, beta-lactams
  • Also: veterinary division (Avosia Vetcare)

10. Bendic Healthcare Pvt Ltd

Bendic Healthcare was incorporated in 2017 and is registered at Plot 26, Industrial Area Phase 2, Panchkula. Suresh Mishra is its chief executive. The company runs a PCD franchise business and describes itself as ISO certified. Its range leans towards chronic and lifestyle segments such as cardiac-diabetic care, alongside gynaecology, orthopaedics and paediatrics.

  • Incorporated: 2017 (CIN U24299UR2017PTC008291)
  • Based in: Panchkula
  • Leadership: Suresh Mishra
  • Model: PCD franchise
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, softgels, dry syrups, syrups, injections, ointments, drops, sachets
  • Claim (company): a range of 350-plus molecules

11. BioBox Pharma

BioBox Pharma works across the tricity, with an office listed at Paras Down Square Mall in Zirakpur and manufacturing facilities in Himachal Pradesh, according to its company profile. Managing director Gulshan Rawat leads the company; he also heads Biophar Lifesciences. BioBox offers PCD franchise distribution and third-party manufacturing, and states that it is ISO 9001 certified.

  • Based in: Zirakpur office; manufacturing facilities in Himachal Pradesh
  • Leadership: Gulshan Rawat (managing director)
  • Model: PCD franchise and third-party manufacturing
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, syrups, dry syrups, ointments, soft gels, nutraceuticals, injectables, nasal drops
  • Segments: anti-infectives, gastrointestinal, pain management, cardiovascular and diabetes, dermatology, urology, central nervous system, nutrition
