The platform says its team verifies companies before listing them. It is kept in this guide because the original list carried it, and because buyers use it to find tricity suppliers.

  • Type: B2B directory and discovery platform (pharmaadda.in)
  • What it lists: company profiles for PCD franchise, third-party manufacturing and manufacturer searches
  • Sector figure it publishes: almost 800 pharma companies registered in Chandigarh including the tricity, citing a Smartscrapers count of 354 pharma companies in Chandigarh as of 15 October 2025

48. Pharmahopers.com (PharmaHopers)

Pharmahopers.com, usually written PharmaHopers, is a business-to-business online marketplace built only for the pharmaceutical industry. Its own company history dates its launch to December 2016. It is based at SCO 18, Sector 16, Panchkula. Manufacturers, traders, distributors, wholesalers, importers, exporters and service providers use it to publish company profiles and product catalogues.

Many of the factsheets used to research this guide come from PharmaHopers profiles, which is typical of its role in the tricity trade: it is the shop window through which many Panchkula and Chandigarh franchise companies are found. It is a platform business, not a medicine manufacturer.

  • Type: B2B pharma marketplace (pharmahopers.com)
  • Based in: SCO 18, Sector 16, Panchkula
  • Since: launched December 2016 (company history)
  • Role: company profiles and catalogues for manufacturers, traders, distributors, wholesalers, importers and exporters

49. Pritus Healthcare Pvt Ltd

Pritus Healthcare works from SCF 289, Motor Market, Manimajra, Chandigarh. It offers a PCD franchise with district-wise monopoly rights, third-party manufacturing and pharma distribution. Directory listings put its range at more than 300 products with a focus on chronic and general formulations, and one listing claims more than 500 existing franchises; treat that figure as marketing.

  • Based in: Manimajra, Chandigarh
  • Model: PCD franchise; third-party manufacturing; distribution
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, injectables, syrups, paediatric drops, oils, powders, ointments, sachets
  • Segments: antihistamines, ophthalmic, antimicrobials, gynaecology, antibiotics, paediatrics, gastrointestinal, orthopaedic, dermatology
  • Claims (listings): WHO-GMP and ISO compliant

50. Salvus Pharma

Salvus Pharma works from Plot 633, JLPL Industrial Park, Sector 82, SAS Nagar, Mohali. Managing director Raman Lamba leads the company. Salvus states ISO 9001:2015 certification on its website and offers a PCD franchise on a monopoly basis plus third-party manufacturing. Its website also lists an administrative office in Landau, Germany.

  • Based in: Sector 82, Mohali
  • Leadership: Raman Lamba (managing director)
  • Model: PCD franchise on a monopoly basis; third-party manufacturing
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, injections, syrups, softgels, protein powders, ointments, nutraceuticals, drops, sachets
  • Segments: cardiac-diabetic, antibiotics, gynaecology and a dedicated dental range
  • Claims (company and IndiaMART): 1,000-plus molecules; 500 existing franchises

51. Sanctus Global Formulations Ltd

Sanctus Global Formulations is the clearest example here of the Chandigarh incorporation and Baddi plant pattern. A CARE Ratings profile records that the company was incorporated in October 2008 at Chandigarh as Crescent Therapeutics Limited, that the business was taken over by the Joshi family in February 2017, and that it was renamed in April 2018.

Its plant stands at Village Kunjhal, behind Jharmajri, Barotiwala, Baddi, and specialises in oral solid dosage forms: tablets and capsules, plus direct compression granules, pellets, powders and nutraceuticals. The company describes the plant as WHO-GMP certified and offers contract manufacturing and a PCD franchise. Product labels confirm real output: medicines sold by other brands list Sanctus as their manufacturer.

  • Incorporated: October 2008 at Chandigarh, as Crescent Therapeutics Limited (CARE Ratings)
  • Plant: Khasra 587/588, Village Kunjhal, Barotiwala, Baddi, Himachal Pradesh
  • Model: contract and third-party manufacturing; PCD franchise
  • Speciality: oral solid dosage forms, tablets and capsules
  • Contact: info@sanctusglobal.com

52. Sanify Healthcare Pvt Ltd

Sanify Healthcare was incorporated on 14 October 2003, which gives it more than two decades in the tricity trade. Its registered office is at Dhakoli, Zirakpur, and it operates from Plot 1323, JLPL Industrial Area, Sector 82, Mohali. Registry data classifies the company as a manufacturer of allopathic pharmaceutical preparations, with trade forming the majority of its turnover.

Sanify runs an ethical PCD franchise across India with district-level monopoly rights. Its website puts the range at more than 500 DCGI-approved products across antibiotics, paediatrics, gynaecology, cardiac care, dermatology, diabetic care and ENT. The company states that its manufacturing facilities are WHO, GMP and ISO certified.

  • Incorporated: 14 October 2003 (CIN U24232PB2003PTC026452)
  • Based in: Plot 1323, JLPL Industrial Area, Sector 82, Mohali; registered office at Dhakoli, Zirakpur
  • Model: ethical PCD franchise with monopoly rights
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, syrups and injectables (company website)
  • Contact: sanify@sanifyhealthcare.com

53. Sepik Life Sciences

Sepik Life Sciences works from Plot 14, Industrial Area Phase 2, Panchkula. It is a PCD franchise company that describes a presence across Chandigarh, Panchkula and Mohali. Its own website claims more than 25 years of experience and carries a large live catalogue: more than 200 tablet products alone, plus syrups and paediatric lines, injectables, gastro and PPI ranges, ayurvedic products and softgels.

  • Based in: Panchkula
  • Model: PCD pharma franchise
  • Catalogue (own website): tablets, syrups and suspensions, injectables, gastro and PPI range, ayurvedic products, softgels
  • Example brand on its website: Citisep syrup (citicoline and piracetam)
  • Claim (company): over 25 years of experience

54. ShinePro Life Sciences Pvt Ltd

ShinePro Life Sciences was incorporated on 16 February 2021 and works from Plot 331, Industrial Area Phase 1, Panchkula. Registry reporting describes it as a subsidiary of Mits Healthcare Private Limited, working in pharmaceutical wholesale and distribution. Its IndiaMART profile carries older text dating the business to 2010; the 2021 registry date is the reliable one.

  • Incorporated: 2021 (CIN U24230HR2021PTC092948)
  • Parent: subsidiary of Mits Healthcare Private Limited (per The Company Check)
  • Based in: Panchkula
  • Model: wholesale trading and distribution; PCD franchise
  • Mentor named in listings: M. K. Bhatia
  • Range traded: pharmaceutical tablets, capsules, oral solutions and critical-care injectables

55. SJK Pharmaceutical Pvt Ltd

SJK Pharmaceutical was incorporated on 30 July 2008 and works from Plot 79, Industrial Area Phase 9, Mohali. Director Rupinderjit leads the company. SJK manufactures and supplies formulations with a visible strength in liquid orals: its catalogues list long ranges of syrups and suspensions alongside tablets, capsules and ointments, and it offers third-party manufacturing and PCD franchise arrangements across India.

  • Incorporated: 2008 (CIN U24119PB2008PTC032156)
  • Based in: Mohali
  • Leadership: Rupinderjit (director)
  • Model: manufacturer, distributor and supplier; third-party manufacturing; PCD franchise
  • Known for: syrups and suspensions, plus listings for aceclofenac-paracetamol tablets, albendazole suspension and amikacin injection

56. Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd (Sun Pharma)

Sun Pharmaceutical Industries is the one national major in this list, and its tricity link is a factory, not an office. Sun Pharma operates a formulation plant at Plot A-41, Industrial Area Phase VIII-A, SAS Nagar, Mohali, listed in company location records as its SEZ Unit-I. Sun Pharma is India's largest pharmaceutical company and the world's fourth largest specialty generics company.

The Mohali plant came to Sun Pharma through its 2015 acquisition of Ranbaxy Laboratories, as Business Standard reported in March 2017 when the US FDA lifted the plant's import alert and removed its Official Action Indicated status, clearing it to supply approved products to the US market. Sun Pharma's head office is in Mumbai; the Mohali unit is its tricity manufacturing presence.

  • Tricity presence: SEZ Unit-I formulation plant, Plot A-41, Phase VIII-A, Mohali
  • Parent: Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd, headquartered in Mumbai
  • How it arrived: inherited with the Ranbaxy Laboratories acquisition in 2015
  • Regulatory note: US FDA lifted the Mohali plant's import alert in 2017 (Business Standard)

57. Ultra Chiron Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Ultra Chiron Pharmaceuticals was incorporated on 20 July 1993, making it the oldest company in this list by registry date. Its registered office is at Plot 80, Industrial Area Phase II, Chandigarh. Managing director Sanjeev Singal has been associated with the company since incorporation, with Amrik Singh as whole-time director. Its PharmaHopers profile lists an operating address at Focal Point, Phase 9, Mohali, and describes it as a manufacturer of tablets, drops and creams that also offers a PCD franchise.

  • Incorporated: 1993 (CIN U24231CH1993PTC013535)
  • Based in: Chandigarh (registered office); Mohali operating address per its profile
  • Leadership: Sanjeev Singal (managing director); Amrik Singh (whole-time director)
  • Model: manufacturer and PCD franchise
  • Forms (profile): pharmaceutical tablets, drops and creams

58. United Laboratories

United Laboratories is a Derabassi-based manufacturer in the wider tricity orbit, founded in 2015 by Munish Goel, with Shubham Goel as chief executive, according to its website. Its units stand at Hansa Industrial Park on Barwala Road, Derabassi, and at Village Bhagwanpura, Derabassi. The company specialises in third-party manufacturing of nutraceutical and ayurvedic products.

Its range covers tablets, capsules, softgels, gummies, powders, syrups and effervescent products, plus skincare lines, with more than 200 products claimed on its website. The company says its units are ISO and WHO-GMP certified and FSSAI approved for nutraceuticals, and that it exports to markets including the USA, Europe, South Africa and parts of Asia.

  • Based in: Derabassi, Mohali district (two units)
  • Since: 2015 (company website)
  • Leadership: Munish Goel (founder); Shubham Goel (chief executive)
  • Model: third-party and contract manufacturing; private label
  • Focus: nutraceuticals, ayurvedic products, softgel capsules and effervescent tablets

59. Ve-Nutra Pharma

Ve-Nutra Pharma is a nutraceutical manufacturer at Plot 131, HSIIDC, Alipur, Barwala, Panchkula. Industry listings date the business to 2020 and describe ISO 9001:2015 certification. It works in third-party and contract manufacturing and private labelling, with a stated strength in soft gelatin capsules. Its supplements target women's health, energy, weight management and sports nutrition, and it also supports PCD franchise partners.

  • Based in: Barwala, Panchkula
  • Model: third-party nutraceutical manufacturing and private labelling
  • Segments: cardiology, dermatology, digestive supplements, gynaecology and neurology
  • Claim (company): products made under WHO-GMP certified units
  • Also offers: PCD pharma franchise with district-wise monopoly rights

60. Ventus Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Ventus Pharmaceuticals was incorporated on 14 November 2011, though the company's own profile traces the business back to 2009 in Chandigarh. It works from Plot 216, HSIIDC Industrial Estate, Alipur Barwala, Panchkula, with a corporate office at Swastik Vihar, MDC Sector 5, Panchkula. Managing director Girjesh Kumar Singh and director Shaishav Sandal lead the company.

Ventus is a PCD franchise marketing company. Its brochure puts the range at more than 350 molecules and over 500 DCGI-approved products; treat those as company figures. Ranges cover general medicines, gynaecology, orthopaedics, critical care, neuropsychiatry, ayurvedic and nutraceutical lines. Its division Caresal Pharma sells from the same Barwala base.

  • Incorporated: 2011 (business traced to 2009 by the company)
  • Based in: Barwala and MDC Sector 5, Panchkula
  • Leadership: Girjesh Kumar Singh (managing director); Shaishav Sandal (director)
  • Model: PCD pharma franchise marketing
  • Claim (company): ISO 9001:2015 certified

61. Vibdrugs Biosciences

Vibdrugs Biosciences is a proprietorship of Amit Rawat, started in 2014 at Chandigarh. It works from SCF 427, Motor Market, Manimajra, and also lists an address at Plot 274, Industrial Area Phase 1, Panchkula. Vibdrugs is a PCD franchise company offering district-wise monopoly rights. Its own presentation puts the range at more than 500 DCGI-approved formulations, a company figure.

  • Based in: Manimajra, Chandigarh; also Panchkula
  • Since: 2014
  • Leadership: Amit Rawat (proprietor)
  • Model: PCD pharma franchise with monopoly rights
  • Divisions (company): general, gynae, derma, paediatric, ortho, cardiac-diabetic
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, syrups, injectables, ayurvedic products, respules, creams, eye and ear drops
  • Contact: info@vibdrugs.com

62. ZOYDEC Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

ZOYDEC Pharmaceuticals is the youngest incorporated company in this list. It was incorporated on 31 December 2020 and is registered at SCF 283, Motor Market, Manimajra, Chandigarh. Registry records name directors Rohan and Pardeep Kumar Singh. ZOYDEC offers a PCD franchise on a monopoly basis across India and third-party manufacturing, with DCGI-approved formulations claimed in its profiles.

  • Incorporated: 2020 (CIN U24230CH2020PTC043424)
  • Based in: Manimajra, Chandigarh
  • Directors: Rohan and Pardeep Kumar Singh
  • Model: PCD pharma franchise and third-party manufacturer
  • Segments: analgesics, antibiotics and anti-infectives, anticold and anti-allergics, antipsychotics
  • Forms: tablets, capsules, softgelatin, syrups, injectables, ointments, beta-lactams, dry syrups, lotions, sachets and a dental range

How to choose and verify a Chandigarh pharma supplier

A franchise or third-party deal is only as strong as the licences behind it. Before signing, ask for the company's drug licence and GST registration, the manufacturing site's licence and WHO-GMP certificate, and a product list that prints the exact manufacturing address. Check the company name and incorporation details against the MCA record: several profiles in this guide show registry dates that differ from marketing claims, and the registry version is the one that matters in a dispute.

  • Match the entity: the name on the agreement, the invoice and the product labels should be the same legal entity.
  • Visit the plant, not just the office. Most offices here are small; the factory is usually in Baddi, Nalagarh, Derabassi or Barwala.
  • Confirm monopoly terms in writing: district boundaries, target conditions and what happens if targets are missed.
  • Check who actually manufactures. Several companies in this list use third-party plants, which is normal, but the plant's licence should be shared openly.
  • Start small. Place a trial order and check labelling, packaging and delivery times before committing to a full district deposit.

Frequently asked questions

Why are so many pharma companies registered in Chandigarh but manufacturing in Baddi?

Chandigarh offers offices, connectivity and a commercial address, while the Baddi-Barotiwala-Nalagarh belt in Himachal Pradesh offers industrial land and the legacy of the 2003 central industrial package. Companies keep sales, franchise management and paperwork in the tricity and production in the belt, which is under an hour away by road.

What is a PCD pharma franchise?

PCD stands for propaganda-cum-distribution. A company gives a local partner the right to market its brands in a defined territory, often a single district, usually with monopoly rights. The partner promotes the products to doctors and chemists and handles local distribution, while the company supplies stock and promotional material.

How can I verify a company in this list?

Start with the MCA registry for the incorporation date, directors and registered office. Then ask the company for its drug licence and the manufacturing site's WHO-GMP certificate, and cross-check the address printed on product labels against the address the company gives you. Where this guide marks a figure as a company claim, it means the number comes from the company's own material.

Which is the oldest pharma company in this list?

By incorporation date, Ultra Chiron Pharmaceuticals, registered on 20 July 1993 at Industrial Area Phase II, Chandigarh. Logos Pharma dates its first manufacturing facility to 1994, according to its company profile, and Focus Healthcare follows with a 1998 founding.

Are PharmaAdda and Pharmahopers.com manufacturers?

No. Both are online platforms based in the tricity. PharmaAdda publishes directory lists of pharma companies, and PharmaHopers is a business-to-business marketplace where manufacturers, traders and distributors publish profiles and catalogues. They are useful for finding suppliers, but they do not make medicines themselves.

Does Sun Pharma really have a plant near Chandigarh?

Yes. Sun Pharmaceutical Industries operates its SEZ Unit-I formulation plant at Plot A-41, Industrial Area Phase VIII-A, SAS Nagar, Mohali. The plant came to Sun Pharma through the 2015 Ranbaxy acquisition, and the US FDA lifted its import alert in 2017.

content.rendered:
Ambala, in northern Haryana, hosts one of North India's densest clusters of pharmaceutical marketing companies. Most of them do not run large factories of their own. Instead, they build brands, appoint franchise partners across India, and have products made in certified plants in Haryana and Himachal Pradesh.

This guide profiles 86 pharma companies linked to Ambala, researched afresh from company websites, MCA-derived registries and trade directories. It covers PCD franchise firms, third-party manufacturers and specialists in ayurvedic, veterinary, nutraceutical and ophthalmic ranges, with the key facts a partner, supplier or job-seeker needs first.

Quick answer: the leading pharma companies in Ambala

If you need a shortlist fast, these are the Ambala names that stand out on track record, scale or specialism:

  • Casca Remedies — in business since 1988, with its own formulation plant and a portfolio of more than 1,400 products.
  • Ben Pharmaceuticals — also established in 1988; manufacturer, supplier and exporter with an unusually wide human and veterinary range.
  • Radicals Pharma — incorporated in 1986 and still manufacturing on the Ambala–Delhi highway.
  • Therawin Formulations — a 2003 partnership running PCD, generic, veterinary and contract-manufacturing divisions.
  • Orange Biotech — manufacturing since 2003, with neuro-psychiatry, gynae, paediatric and cardiac divisions.
  • Remedial Healthcare — PCD franchise specialist offering more than 300 products with monopoly rights.
  • Maksun Biotech — Saha-based franchisor with specialist divisions from gynae care to ophthalmics.
  • Vaxova Drugs — runs two manufacturing facilities and a range of more than 800 products.
  • Alvid Biocare — covers pharma, ayurvedic and veterinary lines, with 200+ products since 2012.
  • SBM Pharmaceuticals — marketing and third-party manufacturing since 2008, with herbal, cosmetics and IV divisions.
  • Granmed Pharma — franchise company working across eight therapy areas, from anti-infectives to CNS.
  • Zylig Lifesciences — manufacturer strong in critical-care injectables and general ranges.

Pharma in Ambala: how the cluster works

Ambala's pharma trade is concentrated in two adjoining urban areas, Ambala Cantt and Ambala City, with a further industrial pocket at Saha. The single most common business model is the PCD franchise, short for propaganda-cum-distribution, under which a company licenses its brands to a local partner for an agreed territory.

That model explains the geography. Dozens of companies share the same few streets around Nanhera Road and Kuldeep Nagar in Ambala Cantt, close to warehouses, transporters and the Ambala–Delhi highway (NH-44). Chandigarh and Panchkula are under an hour away, which keeps the cluster plugged into North India's biggest pharma trading hub.

Manufacturing often happens elsewhere. Many Ambala firms have their products made in WHO-GMP certified units in Himachal Pradesh towns such as Baddi, Kala Amb and Solan, where excise-free zones historically lowered costs, while some, such as Casca Remedies and Bovicure Pharma, run their own plants in or near Ambala.

What defines the Ambala cluster:

  • PCD first: most companies here are marketing and franchise businesses; partners typically receive monopoly rights for a district or pin-code area.
  • Two hubs: Ambala Cantt (Nanhera Road, Kuldeep Nagar) for franchise offices and godowns; the HSIIDC industrial estate at Saha for manufacturing units.
  • Certified supply: products are commonly made in WHO-GMP and ISO certified plants, frequently in Himachal Pradesh.
  • Specialists thrive: ayurvedic houses (Human Pharmacia, Shelmak), veterinary firms (Bovicure, Zenley) and ophthalmic specialists (Vaqure) sit alongside the generalists.
  • Beyond medicines: Ambala is also long established as a scientific and surgical instruments centre, often nicknamed Science City.

Quick comparison: 86 Ambala pharma companies at a glance

Detailed profiles: the 86 companies

1. Aconwell Pharma Pvt. Ltd.

Aconwell Pharma is a PCD pharma franchise company based in Ambala Cantt, with its office on Nanhera Road in the Kuldeep Nagar and Arjun Nagar area. It markets an allopathic range covering tablets, capsules, syrups, injectables, ointments and nutraceuticals, supplied to franchise partners across India.

Alongside the general range, Aconwell runs Womelis Pharma, a dedicated gynaecology division for women's-health products. Directory listings describe the company as a private limited firm led by managing director Rocky Singh.

  • Established: 2018 (directory listings)
  • Base: Ambala Cantt, Haryana
  • What it does: PCD pharma franchise
  • Company type: Private limited
  • Division: Womelis Pharma (gynaecology)

2. Adelina Lifesciences

Adelina Lifesciences is a partnership firm established in 2016, working from Sena Nagar in Dhulkot, Ambala City. It operates as a PCD franchise company and wholesaler of tablets, capsules, syrups and injectables.

The firm also runs specialist divisions: Ayulina Lifesciences for ayurvedic products and Urogenetica for urology. Its profiles name partner Yogesh Gupta as the firm's chief executive.

  • Established: 2016
  • Base: Dhulkot, Ambala City
  • What it does: PCD franchise and wholesale
  • Company type: Partnership firm
  • Divisions: Ayulina Lifesciences (ayurvedic); Urogenetica (urology)

3. Aelida Healthcare

Aelida Healthcare states on its own website that its work commenced in 2004. Based at Vita Enclave in Dhulkot, Ambala, it is a division of Addgel Labs Ltd and works in PCD franchising and third-party manufacturing.

Its range is broader than most on this list: alongside human medicines, Aelida offers a veterinary line that includes injections and bolus products. Directory profiles name Digvijay Sangwan as chief executive.

  • Established: 2004 (company website)
  • Base: Dhulkot, Ambala
  • What it does: PCD franchise; third-party manufacturing
  • Part of: Addgel Labs Ltd (division)

4. Aeon Remedies

Aeon Remedies is a partnership firm established in 2010, based on Circular Road in Model Town, Ambala City. It manufactures and wholesales capsules, tablets, gels and injections, and offers PCD franchise rights.

Directory profiles name Neeraj Singla as a partner in the firm. The company also appears as the parent of the younger Ambala brand Zonamed Healthcare, which describes itself as a subset of Aeon Remedies.

  • Established: 2010
  • Base: Model Town, Ambala City
  • What it does: Manufacturing, wholesale and PCD franchise
  • Company type: Partnership firm

5. Alvid Biocare

Alvid Biocare was established in 2012 and works from Nanhera Road in Kuldeep Nagar, Ambala Cantt. The company says it holds ISO 9001:2008 certification and runs PCD franchise and third-party manufacturing operations across three verticals: pharmaceuticals, ayurvedic products and veterinary care.

Its catalogue runs to more than 200 products. A group division, Ani Healthcare, makes animal feed supplements at the Food Park in Saha, giving Alvid a manufacturing footprint inside Ambala as well as a marketing one.

  • Established: 2012
  • Base: Kuldeep Nagar, Ambala Cantt
  • What it does: PCD franchise; third-party manufacturing
  • Range: Pharma, ayurvedic and veterinary; 200+ products
  • Certification: ISO 9001:2008 (company website)

6. Apikos Pharma

Apikos Pharma was established in 2014 and is headquartered in Arjun Nagar, Nanhera, Ambala Cantt. It is an ISO 9001:2015 certified company working in PCD franchising and third-party manufacturing, led by Anil Kapoor and Mukesh Kapoor.

The company puts its range at more than 300 formulations. Its own website markets Ambala franchise territories actively, making it one of the cluster's more visible recruiters of district-level partners.

  • Established: 2014
  • Base: Arjun Nagar, Ambala Cantt
  • What it does: PCD franchise; third-party manufacturing
  • Range: 300+ formulations (company website)
  • Certification: ISO 9001:2015

7. Aarise Pharma

The website carried with this listing belongs to Aarise Pharmaceuticals, a technology-driven CDMO and ethical-medicines manufacturer based at SIDCUL in Haridwar, Uttarakhand. The company says it has been working since 2019, and it specialises in demanding tablet technologies: dispersible, mouth-dissolving, effervescent, extended-release, sugar-coated and gastro-resistant tablets.

Alongside tablets, Aarise makes capsules, oral liquids, ointments and injections, supplies pharmaceutical APIs and offers third-party manufacturing. No Ambala office, registration or trading history for the company could be verified from public sources, so treat this entry as a name match rather than a confirmed Ambala company, and check the address directly before dealing.

  • Base: KH No. 32, Shri Vas Green, Bahadarabad, SIDCUL, Haridwar, Uttarakhand 249403
  • Operating since: 2019 (company website)
  • What it does: CDMO and ethical medicines; specialised tablets, capsules, oral liquids, ointments and injections; APIs; third-party manufacturing
  • Contact: info@aarisepharma.com; +91 9899783330 (company website)
  • Status: Ambala presence not verified

8. Aventura Healthcare Pvt. Ltd.

Aventura Healthcare is a private limited company based at Mohra, on the Dukheri Road side of Ambala Cantt. It works in PCD pharma franchising and generic medicine distribution.

The company's website publishes unusually detailed guidance for new franchise partners, including the documents and working capital a partner needs, and details its respiratory range built around the brand Ipraclix.

  • Base: Mohra, Ambala Cantt
  • What it does: PCD pharma franchise; generic distribution
  • Company type: Private limited

9. Axodin Pharmaceuticals Pvt. Ltd.

Axodin Pharmaceuticals was incorporated on 11 July 2016. Its registered office is in the Markandey Complex at Sena Nagar, Dhulkot, in Ambala City, and MCA-derived records name Rahul Saini and Darshana Devi as directors.

The company trades in pharmaceutical medicines and offers PCD franchise rights, one of several Sena Nagar firms that anchor the Ambala City side of the cluster.

  • Incorporated: 11 July 2016
  • Base: Sena Nagar, Ambala City
  • What it does: PCD pharma franchise; medicine trading
  • Company type: Private limited
  • CIN: U24230HR2016PTC064965

10. Ben Pharmaceuticals

Ben Pharmaceuticals is one of the longest-established names in this guide. Directory profiles date it to 1988 and place it on Nanhera Road in Kuldeep Nagar, Ambala Cantt, where it works as a manufacturer, supplier and exporter.

Few Ambala firms match its spread: tablets, capsules, injections, eye and ENT drops, cough syrups, veterinary drugs, nutraceuticals and ayurvedic products, offered on PCD franchise terms on a monopoly basis. Its profiles state GMP and ISO 9001:2008 certification and name Yogesh Midha as managing director.

  • Established: 1988
  • Base: Kuldeep Nagar, Ambala Cantt
  • What it does: Manufacturing, supply, exports and PCD franchise
  • Leadership: Yogesh Midha (managing director)

11. Meltic Healthcare Pvt. Ltd.

Meltic Healthcare works from Nanhera Road in Kuldeep Nagar, Ambala Cantt, as part of the Meltic Group. It offers PCD franchise rights and third-party manufacturing, and group materials put the combined range at more than 500 products with monopoly rights for partners.

A directory profile dates the company to 1996 and records it as a private limited firm; its PharmaHopers factsheet names Nikhil Bansal as founder and chief executive.

  • Established: 1996 (directory profile)
  • Base: Kuldeep Nagar, Ambala Cantt
  • What it does: PCD franchise; third-party manufacturing
  • Company type: Private limited
  • Part of: Meltic Group

12. Nuliek Healthcare

Nuliek Healthcare was founded in 2020 and works from Nanhera Road in Kuldeep Nagar, Ambala Cantt. It operates as a PCD franchise company and manufacturer, and also offers third-party manufacturing.

Alongside tablets, syrups, capsules, injections and ointments, Nuliek runs an ayurvedic and herbal line that includes products such as its Nulifem capsules. Directory profiles record it as a proprietorship led by Sahil Wadhwa, with ISO 9001:2015 certification.

  • Established: 2020
  • Base: Kuldeep Nagar, Ambala Cantt
  • What it does: PCD franchise; manufacturing; third-party manufacturing
  • Company type: Proprietorship
  • Certification: ISO 9001:2015 (directory profile)

13. Bioethics Life Sciences Pvt. Ltd.

Bioethics Life Sciences was established in 2013 and is based at Kismat Nagar on Babyal Road, Ambala Cantt. It is an ISO 9001:2015 certified PCD franchise company that also offers third-party services and ayurvedic exports.

Unlike many Ambala marketing firms, Bioethics runs its own manufacturing unit at Kala Amb in Himachal Pradesh. Its range covers tablets, capsules, injections, syrups, suspensions and protein supplements, and its profiles name Ravinder Kumar Tomar as chief executive.

  • Established: 2013
  • Base: Babyal Road, Ambala Cantt
  • What it does: PCD franchise; third-party services
  • Company type: Private limited
  • CIN: U24297HR2013PTC048626

  • Company type: Sole proprietorship

How to choose an Ambala pharma company

Ambala gives a franchise partner or bulk buyer unusual choice in a small area, but the companies differ sharply in what sits behind the brand. Work through these points before comparing price lists:

  • Match the model to your plan: pick a PCD franchisor for territory marketing rights, a third-party manufacturer for your own label, or a firm such as Casca Remedies or Bovicure Pharma that manufactures in-house.
  • Match the range to your market: generalists cover the everyday prescriptions; specialists such as Vaqure (ophthalmic), Zenley (veterinary) or Human Pharmacia (ayurvedic) fit a focused practice or trade channel better.
  • Check who actually makes the product: many Ambala brands are made by partner plants in Himachal Pradesh. That is normal in this cluster, but the plant, not the brand office, is what to verify.
  • Get the monopoly terms in writing: territory definitions vary from a single pin code to a whole district, and they decide how much competition you face from the same brand.
  • Ask about partner support: visual aids, product literature, samples and training are standard offers in this market; confirm exactly what is included before you commit stock money.
  • Start with a trial order: a small first order tests dispatch speed, packaging quality and paperwork before you scale up.

What to verify before you sign or pay

None of this takes long, and every serious company in Ambala will expect the questions:

  • Company registration: for private limited firms, check the CIN and active status in MCA-derived registries; several profiles above list CINs to start from.
  • Your own licences: franchise partners are normally asked for a wholesale drug licence and GST registration before an agreement is issued; companies such as Bioversal Remedies and Vaxova Drugs state this upfront.
  • Manufacturing credentials: ask for the WHO-GMP certificate of the actual plant making your products, and check it names that plant and is in date.
  • Product approvals: ask for the approval or DCGI documentation for the specific formulations you plan to sell, not just a general company brochure.
  • Quality paperwork: confirm you will receive batch certificates of analysis with each consignment, and ask how expiry and damage claims are handled.
  • Agreement terms: read the franchise or manufacturing agreement for territory, payment terms, minimum orders and exit clauses before paying any advance.

Frequently asked questions

How many pharma companies are there in Ambala?

This guide profiles 86 companies with an Ambala base or a direct Ambala presence, and the true number trading in the district is higher once small traders are counted. The bulk of them sit in Ambala Cantt and Ambala City, with a manufacturing pocket at Saha.

What is a PCD pharma franchise?

PCD stands for propaganda-cum-distribution. A pharma company licenses its brands to a local partner, who markets and distributes them to doctors, chemists and hospitals in an agreed territory. Ambala companies commonly grant monopoly rights for that territory, which is why the model dominates this cluster.

What do I need to start a pharma franchise with an Ambala company?

Companies on this list typically ask for a wholesale drug licence and GST registration before issuing a franchise agreement. You will also need working capital for opening stock; the amount varies with the range and territory you choose, so confirm it in the written agreement.

Do Ambala pharma companies offer third-party manufacturing?

Yes. A large share of the companies profiled here, including Casca Remedies, Alvid Biocare, Biostem Pharma and Maksun Biotech, manufacture products for other brands. Production often takes place in WHO-GMP certified units, many of them in Himachal Pradesh's industrial areas.

Which parts of Ambala have the most pharma companies?

Nanhera Road and Kuldeep Nagar in Ambala Cantt hold the densest cluster of franchise offices and godowns. The HSIIDC industrial estate at Saha hosts manufacturing units, and Ambala City neighbourhoods such as Sena Nagar, Dhulkot, Model Town and Baldev Nagar hold many more firms.

Are there ayurvedic and veterinary specialists in Ambala?

Yes. Human Pharmacia, Shelmak Lifesciences and Mediwin Research and Healthcare specialise in ayurvedic products, while Bovicure Pharma and Zenley Animal Health focus on veterinary medicines and feed supplements. Several general firms also run ayurvedic or veterinary divisions alongside their main ranges.

Bengaluru is one of India’s most research-led pharmaceutical and biotechnology centres, and it is also a city of very different kinds of listings. Global research groups, listed manufacturers, family-run formulation companies, distributors, packaging specialists and single-site facilities all appear side by side in local directories.

This guide rewrites the Bangalore list from fresh research. It keeps the same 96 listed entries in the same order, keeps every existing logo or image with the entry it belonged to, and flags facilities, duplicates and entries where public information is limited.

Quick answer

If you only have time for a shortlist, start with the entries that combine scale, a clear Bengaluru base and well documented operations:

  • Biocon Pharma Limited: generic formulations from the Biocon group, founded in Bengaluru in 1978.
  • Micro Labs Limited: Bengaluru formulations maker incorporated in 1973, known for Dolo-650.
  • Medreich Limited: Bengaluru CMO and CDMO business, incorporated in 1973 and part of Meiji Seika Pharma.
  • Strides Pharma Science Limited: Bengaluru headquartered maker of niche finished dosage formulations, with a Chandapura plant and a Bannerghatta Road R and D centre in this list.
  • Syngene’s clinical development unit: part of Syngene International, the Biocon group’s contract research, development and manufacturing organisation.
  • Karnataka Antibiotics and Pharmaceuticals Limited (KAPL): a Government of India enterprise based at Peenya.
  • Sami-Sabinsa Group Limited: Peenya based producer of herbal extracts, nutraceuticals and specialty chemicals.

Pharma and biotech in Bengaluru: the sector in brief

Karnataka was an early mover in biotechnology, launching India’s first dedicated state biotechnology policy in 2001. The current Karnataka Biotechnology Policy 2024-2029 aims to position the state as a global leader, with work on bio-manufacturing, translational research, start-up incubation, workforce development and simpler regulation.

A Karnataka government biotechnology newsletter describes a state ecosystem of more than 800 companies across biopharma, bio-agriculture, bio-industrial work, bio-IT and bio-services, alongside more than 25 national and state research centres. Bengaluru is the centre of that ecosystem, helped by institutions such as the Indian Institute of Science and the National Centre for Biological Sciences.

The city’s character is research-led. Biocon, founded in Bengaluru in 1978, grew from enzymes into biosimilars, generics and research services, and its subsidiary Syngene works as a contract research, development and manufacturing organisation. Around them sits a wide base of formulation plants, contract researchers, excipient and packaging suppliers, and marketing-led companies.

  • Peenya, in north-west Bengaluru, is the older industrial belt in this list, home to KAPL, Sami-Sabinsa, Anglo-French Drugs and several smaller manufacturers and packagers.
  • Bommasandra and Jigani, to the south, hold larger plants and research sites, including Apotex’s API facility, Stericon, Sterin Labs and the Syngene and Biocon Park area.
  • Electronic City and Hosur Road host research and corporate sites linked to Biocon and Syngene, while Whitefield and Manyata Embassy Business Park hold offices for groups such as AstraZeneca Pharma India, Indegene and Pharmed.
  • Many entries are marketing, franchise or distribution businesses rather than factories, so the entry type matters as much as the name.

Quick comparison: the 96 listed entries

Detailed profiles

1. Abbvie India Private Limited

AbbVie’s Bengaluru presence sits on Kasturba Road in central Bengaluru. Fresh registry research did not find a separate MCA entity under the exact listing name; the Bangalore entities at the address are AbbVie Therapeutics India Private Limited and AbbVie Healthcare India Private Limited. AbbVie India’s sourced focus includes eye care, with glaucoma, ocular surface and retinal diseases named in its India material.

  • Bangalore entities include AbbVie Therapeutics India Private Limited, incorporated in 1994 and formerly Allergan India Limited
  • AbbVie Healthcare India Private Limited was incorporated in 2008
  • Sourced focus: biopharmaceutical treatments, including eye care

2. Acurela Pharms Limited

Acurela Pharms Limited is a Bengaluru public company incorporated in 2021, with its registered address at Vijayanagar. The company describes its specialisation as manufacturing and marketing anaesthesia and critical-care products, including emergency medicine. Its registry classification covers other chemical products, so buyers should confirm the exact product licence for any medicine they plan to source.

  • Incorporated: 20 July 2021, RoC Bangalore

How to choose a Bangalore pharma partner

Start by matching the entry type to your need. A listed manufacturer, a contract research organisation, a PCD franchise company and a distributor solve different problems, and this list contains all four, plus facilities and offices that belong to larger groups.

  • For manufacturing: ask which site will actually make your product, and check that the site, not just the brand, holds the licences your dosage form needs.
  • For research services: look for a documented track record in your study type, such as stability work, clinical trials or formulation development.
  • For franchise or distribution offers: confirm territory terms, supply continuity and who holds the product licences before paying any deposit.
  • For global groups: confirm whether you are dealing with the Indian subsidiary, a regional office or a single facility, because contracts and compliance sit with the legal entity.

What to verify before you commit

Directory listings age quickly, and several entries in this guide turned out to be facilities, duplicates or businesses with limited public information. A short verification pass protects both buyers and jobseekers.

  • Legal identity: ask for the company identification number or LLP identification number and check it against the name on invoices and agreements.
  • Trading status: confirm the company is active; one entry in this list, Ayurwin Pharma, is recorded as dissolved in registry research.
  • Site role: confirm whether the Bengaluru address is a factory, warehouse, office or training centre before assuming local manufacturing.
  • Product paperwork: for any medicine, ask for the manufacturing licence, product approval and batch documentation for the specific product, not the brand in general.
  • People claims: treat founding years, product lists and facility claims from directories as leads to verify, especially where this guide marks public information as limited.

Frequently asked questions

Is Bengaluru mainly a manufacturing base or a research base?

It is both, with a strong research tilt. The city combines formulation and API plants in industrial areas such as Peenya and Bommasandra with research organisations, clinical trial units and corporate offices linked to groups such as Biocon, Syngene, AstraZeneca and Jubilant Biosys.

Are all 96 entries separate companies?

No. Fresh research found facilities, offices and duplicate listings among the 96 entries, including Biocon Campus, the Medreich units, two listings for Micro Labs and two for KAPL. Each profile says plainly when an entry is a facility or a duplicate, and points to the parent company.

Which Bengaluru areas appear most often in this list?

Peenya and Bommasandra-Jigani appear most often for manufacturing, while Electronic City, Hosur Road, Whitefield and Manyata Embassy Business Park appear for research sites and corporate offices. Older commercial districts such as Basavanagudi, Jayanagar and Chamarajpet host many smaller marketing and distribution companies.

What does “limited public information” mean in a profile?

It means fresh research found only registry, GST or directory level records, and no official website or detailed company material. In those profiles this guide reports only the sourced basics and does not claim founding years, products or certifications that could not be verified.

Does inclusion in this list mean a company is recommended?

No. Inclusion means the entry appeared in the original Bangalore coverage list and was re-researched for this guide. Buyers, partners and candidates should still verify legal identity, trading status, licences and site role using the checks in the section above.

This guide was rebuilt from fresh research in November 2026. Company details change, so confirm time-sensitive facts with the company or the registry before you rely on them.

content.rendered:
Hyderabad pharma at a glance

Hyderabad is not a single industrial estate with a few large factories. It is a connected life-sciences market covering discovery research, active ingredients, formulations, vaccines, contract services, distribution and specialist training.

This updated guide keeps the original directory breadth — 110 coverage entries — but rebuilds every profile from research checked on 5 November 2026. Duplicate listings and generic headings are identified honestly rather than dressed up as separate companies.

Quick answer

  • For vaccines and biologics: start with Biological E and Indian Immunologicals.
  • For large-scale APIs and formulations: look first at Aurobindo Pharma, Dr Reddy's Laboratories, MSN Laboratories, Natco Pharma, Hetero Labs and SMS Pharmaceuticals.
  • For research and contract services: Aragen, Aurigene Pharmaceutical Services and Sai Life Sciences are the clearest dedicated service names in this directory.
  • For smaller suppliers and specialists: use the A-to-coverage-order profiles below, then verify the site, licence and product evidence directly with the company.

Why Hyderabad matters in pharmaceuticals

Genome Valley is the research anchor. CBRE's 2025 Global Life Sciences Atlas describes it as home to more than 200 biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies from 18 countries, within what it calls India's largest life-sciences manufacturing and research cluster.

The same CBRE profile attributes nearly one-third of India's pharmaceutical production, about one-fifth of its pharmaceutical exports and about one-third of global vaccine output to Hyderabad. Those are market-level figures, not claims about any single company in the directory.

The city's depth comes from the overlap between bulk drugs and finished medicines. API producers, formulation plants, sterile-injectable specialists, CROs, pharmacovigilance teams and regulatory consultants operate in the same labour and supplier market.

  • Research and development: Genome Valley supports discovery, development and specialist laboratory work.
  • Vaccines and biologics: Biological E and Indian Immunologicals give the cluster unusual scale in human and animal health.
  • APIs and generics: Aurobindo, Dr Reddy's, Hetero, MSN, Natco and SMS anchor a broad export-oriented base.
  • Services: CROs, CDMOs, GMP consultants and training providers support firms that do not keep every function in-house.

Hyderabad Pharma City has also been repositioned as Green Pharma City. Telangana presents it as a sustainable manufacturing and research hub, while the original project vehicle, Hyderabad Pharma City Limited, was created under the state industrial infrastructure corporation to develop the Pharma City project.

Symax Laboratories – Api Manufacturers In Nacharam Hyderabad contributes to the city's active ingredient and intermediates base through fine chemicals, API intermediates and dry solvents — made-to-order API-related products. The sourced location is Plot No. A-28/1/14D, IDA Nacharam, Hyderabad 500076. Its key facts are set out below so that company-stated work can be distinguished from registry and directory evidence.

  • Official site names client companies including Granules, Jubilant Biosys, Lupin, Piramal, Alembic, Aurobindo and Aurigene — this is the company's own client claim; present it as such if used.

94. Sync Pharmaceuticals

Sync Pharmaceuticals is a Hyderabad pharma franchise and formulations marketing business at Rikab Gunj, known through trade and franchise listings rather than an official website. Listings describe ranges including proton-pump inhibitors, multivitamin and protein supplements, anti-diabetics, and derma and gynaecology products, while IndiaMART lists it as a wholesaler and distributor. The logo previously shown here belonged to an unrelated software company and has been removed.

Ltd | Hiring | Skilling | Deploying adds a specialist services dimension to Hyderabad's pharmaceutical ecosystem through contract research (CRO) and analytical / research outsourcing services for pharma companies. 104. Viatris (Mylan GBS)

  • Viatris was formed in November 2020 through the combination of Mylan and Pfizer's Upjohn business (SEC filing / company launch coverage).
  • Company sources state Viatris is headquartered in the US with global centres in Pittsburgh, Shanghai and Hyderabad, and a portfolio of more than 1,400 approved molecules.

  • Viatris India documents are issued in the name of Mylan Laboratories Limited at the Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad address above, with website viatris.com / viatris.in and CIN shown as U24231TG1984PLC05146 in the filing header (character rendering in the PDF is imperfect — verify CIN digits against MCA before printing it).

Virchow Laboratories Limited is included for aPI manufacturer — sulfamethoxazole. The sourced location is Plot No. 4, S.V. Co-op. Industrial Estate, IDA Jeedimetla, Hyderabad 500055. 107. Vista Pharmaceuticals Ltd.

Vista Pharmaceuticals Ltd. is included for oTC and generic prescription products — tablets, capsules and liquids. The sourced location is Guttala Begumpet, Hyderabad. Its key facts are set out below so that company-stated work can be distinguished from registry and directory evidence.

  • BSE-listed, scrip code 524711, CIN L24239TG1991PLC012264 (BSE filings); incorporated in 1991 in secondary company profiles.
  • Company profile summaries describe manufacture and sale of pharmaceutical, medical and veterinary preparations, offering OTC and prescription generic drugs consisting of tablets, capsules and liquids across therapeutic categories.
  • Official website is vistapharmaceuticals.com (exchange filings / company profiles).

108. VIVIN DRUGS & PHARMACEUTICALS LIMITED

VIVIN DRUGS & PHARMACEUTICALS LIMITED contributes to the city's active ingredient and intermediates base through manufacturer of pharmaceuticals, conventional drugs and intermediates / APIs, including an antiviral basket in acquisition coverage. The sourced location is 2A & 3A, New MLA & MPs Colony, Road No. 10C, Jubilee Hills, Hyderabad 500033 (MCA-derived). Its key facts are set out below so that company-stated work can be distinguished from registry and directory evidence.

  • Incorporated 28 July 2011, CIN U24232TG2011PLC075704, ROC Hyderabad; formerly Eytan Labs Limited (The Company Check / MCA-derived).
  • The Company Check records it as under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP); IBBI Form G (May 2026) describes VDPL and Vivin Laboratories Pvt Ltd as engaged in manufacture of pharmaceuticals, conventional drugs & intermediates, APIs etc., with plant reactor capacity stated as 376 KL.
  • An October 2026 news report said Virupaksha Organics had completed its acquisition of Vivin Drugs & Pharmaceuticals Limited and Vivin Laboratories Pvt Ltd through the NCLT process, under a resolution plan approved by the Hyderabad Bench on 21 August 2026.

109. Xenomics pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd

Xenomics pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd is included for marketed formulations across multiple therapeutic areas; pharma franchise. The sourced location is Hyderabad, Telangana 500009. Its key facts are set out below so that company-stated work can be distinguished from registry and directory evidence.

  • Official site states it was established in 2021 and describes itself as an emerging pharma company in India.
  • Official site lists therapeutic areas including orthopedics, neurology, cardiology, pulmonology, gastroenterology, nutraceuticals and pain management, and states products are manufactured by WHO & GMP certified manufacturers — company's own claim about third-party manufacture.
  • Medicine databases list products marketed by Xenomics Pharmaceuticals Pvt Ltd from the Hyderabad address above, e.g. Luliziva 1% Cream, Esmonova 40 Tablet and Tramoxy Tablet.

110. Zenara Pharma

Zenara Pharma is included for oral solid and liquid formulation manufacturing; subsidiary of Biophore India Pharmaceuticals. The sourced location is Plot Nos. 83/B, 84 & 87–96, Phase III, IDA Cherlapally, Hyderabad 500051. Its key facts are set out below so that company-stated work can be distinguished from registry and directory evidence.

  • Private limited company, incorporated 18 March 2004, CIN U24239TG2004PTC042894, ROC Hyderabad, recorded as a subsidiary of Biophore India Pharmaceuticals Private Limited (The Company Check / MCA-derived).
  • Official site describes Zenara as an integrated pharmaceutical company with a US FDA, EU and WHO-GMP approved oral solid and liquid manufacturing facility at Cherlapally, Hyderabad — company's own approval claim, as worded on its site.
  • News coverage (Sep 2022): Hyderabad-based Zenara Pharma, a fully owned subsidiary of Biophore, launched nirmatrelvir + ritonavir combi-pack (brand Paxzen) manufactured at its Hyderabad facility.

How to choose a Hyderabad pharma company

Start with the job, not the brand name. An API enquiry, a sterile-injectable CDMO search and a pharmacovigilance contract require different facilities, licences and evidence.

  • Match the specialism: confirm that the company actually performs the work, rather than trading, marketing or loan-licensing it.
  • Verify the site: distinguish a registered office, corporate office, research centre and manufacturing plant; they are often in different places.
  • Ask for current licences: request the manufacturing or wholesale licence that covers the exact site and dosage form.
  • Check regulatory evidence: where export supply matters, ask which regulator inspected the relevant site and when.
  • Test capacity and timelines: obtain a written quotation that separates development, validation, manufacture, testing and release.
  • Confirm the legal entity: use the CIN and contracting name, especially where a group, brand and site share similar names.

What to verify before you commit

Directory entries can age quickly. A current official website is a starting point, not proof that a particular plant can make a particular product or that a certification covers the work being bought.

For medicines and ingredients, verify batch documentation, quality agreements, audit rights, change notification and recall responsibility before placing an order. For services, verify the named team, data controls, reporting route and regulatory inspection history.

Frequently asked questions

Why is Hyderabad called a vaccine capital?

Hyderabad has an unusually deep concentration of vaccine and biologics capability. CBRE's 2025 life-sciences profile attributes about one-third of global vaccine output to the city and identifies Genome Valley as a cluster of more than 200 life-sciences companies.

What is Genome Valley?

Genome Valley is Hyderabad's organised life-sciences research and clean-manufacturing cluster. It brings together biotechnology and pharmaceutical companies, research organisations and specialist infrastructure in the wider Shamirpet area.

Is Green Pharma City the same as Hyderabad Pharma City?

Green Pharma City is the current branding for the large pharmaceutical city project that developed from Hyderabad Pharma City. It is presented by Telangana as a sustainable manufacturing and research hub, rather than a conventional industrial estate.

Are all 110 entries separate manufacturers?

No. The directory includes manufacturers, service providers, distributors, an industry association, training organisations, facilities, duplicate listings and three generic headings. Each profile identifies the type of entry instead of presenting every name as a separate factory.

Why are duplicate listings retained?

They are retained to preserve the original coverage and image order, but they are labelled as duplicates or site entries. Buyers should contract with the legal entity named in the main company profile, not with a duplicate directory heading.

How current is this guide?

The research was checked on 5 November 2026. Addresses, websites, ownership and regulatory status can change, so the official company and regulator records should be checked again before a commercial decision.

Research notes and sector sources

Company profiles were rebuilt from official company websites first, followed by MCA-derived company records and reputable trade or news sources. Claims that could not be verified were omitted. The detailed source for every profile is logged in the editorial research pack that accompanies this article.

  • CBRE: Hyderabad emerges as one of the top global centres of life sciences manufacturing activity, 2025
  • Business Today: Green Pharma City interview, 2025
  • Telangana Life Sciences: Genome Valley
