content.rendered:
Delhi has a dance academy for almost every goal, from a child's first Bollywood routine to professional salsa training and full-scale wedding choreography. This guide profiles 20 academies across the city, from Laxmi Nagar and Mayur Vihar in the east to Pitampura, Rohini and Rajouri Garden in the north and west.

Every profile below is based on fresh research from the academies' own websites and current listings, checked in November 2026. Fees and ratings change often, so we have left out prices and scores and focused on what each academy actually teaches, where it is, and who it suits best.

Quick answer

  • For Bhangra: BMP FIRE Bhangra Academy (Tilak Nagar), a Punjabi dance specialist that dates itself to 1989.
  • For salsa and Latin partner dance: Moving Souls (Malviya Nagar) and Lead and Follow India (South Delhi).
  • For a short visit to Delhi: Delhi Dance Academy (Lajpat Nagar 4) runs a two-hour Namaste India workshop for travellers.
  • For classical training with examinations: PAIPA (East of Kailash) teaches Kathak and runs examinations affiliated to Prayag Sangeet Samiti and Trinity College London.
  • For dance fitness: HASH Aerobics & Dance Studio (Model Town) and Evolution Dance and Fitness Zone (Kamla Nagar) blend Zumba and aerobics with dance.
  • For wedding choreography: DX Dance Xtreme (Pitampura), Spark Motion (Uttam Nagar) and Zenith Dance Company (Mayur Vihar) all build full sangeet performances.
  • For something different: Neeti's Dance Studio (Bali Nagar) is one of very few Indian studios teaching hula hoop dance.

How to choose a dance academy in Delhi

Start with the outcome you want. A hobby class, a fitness routine, a child's stage performance and a sangeet act all need different teaching, so the right academy depends on your goal, your area and how much structure you want.

  • Pick your style first: academies that specialise, like BMP FIRE for Bhangra or Moving Souls for salsa, usually teach that form in more depth than general studios.
  • Check the commute: most students stick with classes within a short metro or auto ride, so shortlist academies in your part of Delhi first.
  • Ask about batches: age and level groups matter, especially for children and for complete beginners joining mixed classes.
  • Use a trial or first class where offered, and confirm the current fee and timetable directly, as both change through the year.
  • For weddings, book choreography early in the season and ask whether the team trains at your venue or your home.

Quick comparison

The 20 academies in detail

1. The Music and Dance School

The Music and Dance School is a hobby school in Acharya Niketan, Mayur Vihar Phase 1, that teaches dance and music side by side. Listings describe dance batches in contemporary, hip-hop, Indian styles and Bollywood for children and adults, alongside music lessons, which makes it a practical single stop for families in East Delhi.

Justdial's listing records the school as established in June 2017. Reviews there single out individual teachers for praise, and the school markets itself to hobby learners of all ages rather than to professional aspirants, so expect structured batches grouped by age and level.

  • Location: D-37, Block B, Acharya Niketan, Mayur Vihar Phase 1
  • Styles: Contemporary, hip-hop, Bollywood and Indian styles; music classes too
  • Good to know: Listed as established in 2017 (Justdial); hobby batches for all ages

Visit website →

2. Rudra Dance Academy, Laxmi Nagar

Rudra Dance Academy runs from a basement studio in Gali No. 2, Laxmi Nagar, a short walk from Laxmi Nagar Metro station. Its own class lists cover a wide spread of styles: Bollywood, hip-hop, freestyle, popping, locking, breaking, jazz, contemporary, urban, house, K-pop and salsa, with choreography classes for weddings, parties and school functions.

The academy was founded by Sandy, and its website names Deepa as director and instructor, with a Bharatanatyam background. ThreeBestRated lists the academy as running since 2010, and directory summaries describe daily group classes for beginners through advanced dancers, starting from around four years old, plus workshops and studio hire.

  • Location: D-31, Basement, Gali No. 2, Laxmi Nagar, near the metro station
  • Styles: Bollywood, hip-hop, contemporary, jazz, K-pop, salsa and street styles
  • Good to know: Wedding and event choreography classes; workshops and studio rental listed

Visit website →

3. BMP FIRE Bhangra Academy

BMP FIRE is Delhi's Bhangra specialist. The academy describes itself as set up in 1989, which would make it one of the oldest Punjabi dance academies in the city, and it teaches Bhangra as a formal course rather than a casual add-on. Its Ravi Nagar studio near Tilak Nagar has dedicated Bhangra studios and a team the academy puts at ten instructors.

Alongside Bhangra, the academy lists Giddha, Bollywood, hip-hop and western courses, with classes available online as well as at the studio and average batch sizes of 10 to 15 students. The crew also organises stage and corporate events, and its BMP Fire Bhangra League brought competing teams to a Pitampura auditorium in October 2026.

  • Location: WZ-156, Ravi Nagar, near Tilak Nagar
  • Styles: Bhangra and Giddha specialisation; Bollywood, hip-hop and western courses
  • Good to know: Online classes offered; the academy says it has taught over one lakh students (its own figure)

Visit website →

4. Paipa Dance and Music Classes

PAIPA, short for Pradeep Adwani's Institute for Performing Arts, has taught dance and music in South Delhi since 1995, according to the institute. Its studio sits on Lala Lajpat Rai Marg in East of Kailash, near Kailash Colony Metro station, and it is run by choreographer Pradeep Adwani.

Dance courses run from Bollywood, hip-hop, jazz, salsa and contemporary to pure classical Kathak, semi-classical, belly dance and folk, with wedding and couple dance training as well. Music students can learn guitar, drums, tabla, harmonium, synthesizer and vocals. PAIPA says its examinations are affiliated to Prayag Sangeet Samiti and Trinity College London, and it holds seasonal fests where students perform on stage.

  • Location: E-13, Third Floor, East of Kailash, near Kailash Colony Metro station
  • Styles: Bollywood, Kathak, hip-hop, contemporary, jazz, salsa, belly dance, folk
  • Good to know: Established 1995 (the institute's own history); examinations affiliated to Prayag Sangeet Samiti and Trinity College London

Visit website →

5. HASH Aerobics & Dance Studio

HASH is a dance and fitness studio in Mahendru Enclave, Model Town, on Chhatrasal Stadium Road near Model Town Metro station. It appears repeatedly in North Delhi Zumba round-ups, and its mix is firmly fitness-led: Zumba and aerobics alongside Bollywood, hip-hop, contemporary, salsa and freestyle classes, with women-only batches and no age bar on joining.

The studio also runs classes for children, including kids' dance and karate, according to its magicpin listing. Its second specialism is wedding choreography: its WeddingWire profile offers choreography for the couple and for friends and family, song selection, track mixing and background dancers, with training at the studio, at the client's venue or online.

  • Location: A-12A, Mahendru Enclave, Chhatrasal Stadium Road, Model Town
  • Styles: Zumba, aerobics, Bollywood, hip-hop, contemporary, salsa
  • Good to know: Women-only batches; wedding choreography with training at the studio, at your venue or online

6. Right Moves Academy of Dance

Right Moves Academy of Dance is a Pitampura studio with a reputation for technique-led training. LBB's Delhi dance guide highlights its jazz and contemporary specialism and its well-regarded faculty, and recommends it for dancers who want to take the art form seriously rather than treat it as a casual hobby.

The academy's own booking site shows a weekly timetable built around beginners' classes, jazz, hip-hop, choreography sessions and contemporary, including contemporary with ballet, plus separate kids' batches for ages 4 to 6 and 7 to 12. It opens seven days a week, and the team also choreographs performances for weddings, engagements and office events.

  • Location: 37, Basement, Kailash Enclave, Harsh Vihar, Pitampura
  • Styles: Jazz, contemporary, ballet, hip-hop, choreography
  • Good to know: Kids' batches from age 4; open seven days a week

7. Delhi Dance Academy

Delhi Dance Academy works out of Amar Colony, Lajpat Nagar 4, opposite Tagore International School, within reach of Moolchand and Kailash Colony Metro stations. It runs regular classes, and its website lists a second centre in Sushant Lok 1, Gurgaon.

The academy is best known beyond Delhi for its Namaste India Dance Workshop, a two-hour session designed for tourists and expats that teaches Bollywood, Bhangra and Dandiya in one sitting, for individuals, couples and groups of up to 15, with a filmed video of the performance and costumes available to hire. Its team also handles wedding and sangeet choreography, including a professional troupe and backdrop dancers.

  • Location: E-238/239, Amar Colony, Lajpat Nagar 4
  • Styles: Bollywood, Bhangra, Dandiya and regular dance classes
  • Good to know: Two-hour Namaste India workshop for travellers; wedding choreography with troupe support

Visit website →

8. Evolution Dance and Fitness Zone

Evolution Dance and Fitness Zone is a Kamla Nagar fitness studio on Bungalow Road, above the Reebok showroom near GTB Nagar. So Delhi's North Delhi round-ups describe a broad workout menu under one roof: Zumba, yoga, Bhangra, aerobics, pilates and gymnastics, alongside a gym facility.

That makes Evolution a better fit for adults who want dance as part of a wider fitness routine than for style-by-style dance training. Kids' activity listings also show a children's dance and fitness batch at the studio, and the studio runs workshops, which are a low-commitment way to sample its teaching before joining a regular batch.

  • Location: 14-UB, Third Floor, Bungalow Road, Kamla Nagar
  • Styles and training: Zumba, yoga, Bhangra, aerobics, pilates, gymnastics, gym
  • Good to know: Kids' dance and fitness batch listed; workshops held through the year

9. Spark Motion Dance Academy & Wedding Choreography

Spark Motion Dance Academy is based on Sunil Dairy Road in Uttam Nagar, West Delhi, and is led by choreographer Kamal Sharma, who is named again and again in the academy's Google reviews. Regular dance classes run at the studio, and its full name gives away its main trade: wedding choreography.

Reviewers consistently describe simple, easy-to-learn routines built for whole families, including relatives who have never danced, which is exactly what most sangeet performances need. If you are in West Delhi and your main goal is a family function rather than graded training, Spark Motion is the local specialist on this list.

  • Location: G-1/82, Sunil Dairy Road, Uttam Nagar
  • Focus: Wedding and family-function choreography; regular dance and fitness classes
  • Good to know: Choreographer Kamal Sharma is the named lead in reviews

10. DX Dance Xtreme, Pitampura

DX Dance Xtreme is a Pitampura dance school and events outfit run by owner and artistic director Daksh Bajaj, whose WedMeGood profile describes dance education across styles alongside custom choreography for weddings, events and stage productions. Classes listed for the studio include hip-hop and salsa, with aerobics in the mix.

Weddings are the bigger side of the business. Its WeddingWire profile lists choreography across Bollywood, Punjabi, classical, old Hindi songs, ballroom, flash mobs, contemporary, hip-hop and Bhangra, with training offered at the studio, at the client's site, online or through recorded sessions. The studio is open Monday to Saturday and closed on Sundays.

  • Location: UU-195A, near Maharaja Agrasen Model School, Uttari Pitampura, Pitampura
  • Styles: Hip-hop, salsa, aerobics; a wide choreography range
  • Good to know: Destination-wedding choreography offered; closed on Sundays

Visit website →

11. Maddii Dance & Fitness Studio, Rohini

Maddii Dance & Fitness Studio, in Rohini Sector 24 near Babosa Mandir, also operates as Maddii Academy of Dancing Gems and is run by Manoj Pahwa. The academy's registration on the Delhi Directorate of Education's academy list records an establishment year of 2010.

Listings describe hip-hop and salsa classes alongside aerobics and general fitness, with children a large part of the enrolment and hours that run from early morning to late evening, seven days a week. The lead instructor also works as an event anchor and wedding choreographer, so the studio can cover a family function end to end.

  • Location: House No. 140, First Floor, Pocket 12, Sector 24, Rohini
  • Styles: Hip-hop, salsa, aerobics and fitness
  • Good to know: Open seven days, early morning to late evening; popular for kids' classes

12. The Dance Space, Laxmi Nagar & Shakarpur

The Dance Space teaches from D-122, Gali No. 6, Laxmi Nagar, and its name covers the Shakarpur side of East Delhi as well. A Delhi classes guide picks out its modern, energetic contemporary and hip-hop classes, and its listings also show Bollywood, classical and Zumba on the timetable, with ballet appearing in student reviews.

Student reviews name instructors Nikhil and Anuradha, and mention a ladies' batch and regular weekend video shoots where students record their routines. The studio's listings also describe sangeet choreography for weddings, including destination events, so it covers both weekly training and one-off family performances.

  • Location: D-122, Gali No. 6, Laxmi Nagar (also serving Shakarpur)
  • Styles: Contemporary, hip-hop, Bollywood, classical, Zumba
  • Good to know: Ladies' batch; sangeet choreography including destination weddings

13. Lead and Follow India

Lead and Follow India is a South Delhi partner-dance school built around the idea in its name: in Latin and ballroom dancing, one partner leads and the other follows, and classes teach both skills properly. Its Google listing places it at M-3B in South Delhi, and its website is leadandfollowindia.com.

Expect salsa and ballroom styles taught as social partner dancing rather than solo choreography, which suits adults who want to dance at socials and events rather than perform on stage. Public detail about its batches is limited compared with larger academies, so check the website for the current class schedule before visiting.

  • Location: M-3B, South Delhi (per its Google listing)
  • Styles: Salsa and ballroom partner dancing
  • Good to know: Focuses on lead-and-follow technique for social dancing

Visit website →

14. Big Dream Studio, Shahdara

Big Dream Studio is a music and dance studio in Naveen Shahdara, near Partappura in the Shahdara–Dilshad Garden area of East Delhi. It combines a dance academy with guitar classes, and its Google listing describes it simply as a music and dance studio, open Monday to Saturday.

For weddings, Big Dream Studio appears in WeddingWire's East Delhi choreographer listings, so local families can pair regular classes with sangeet preparation in the same studio. It is one of the few academies on this list serving the Shahdara side of East Delhi, where most larger academies cluster further south.

  • Location: A-14, First Floor, Naveen Shahdara, near Partappura, Shahdara
  • Focus: Dance classes, guitar classes, wedding choreography
  • Good to know: Open Monday to Saturday

15. The Pulse Studio

The Pulse Studio, at K-12 in Rajouri Garden, West Delhi, takes a fitness-first approach to dance. A Delhi dance-classes guide describes fitness-oriented classes and fusion styles that combine street, jazz and contemporary, with a strong focus on rhythm and performance, and suggests it suits intermediate dancers best.

Children are catered for too: kids' activity platforms list a kids' dance class at the studio, along with dance, yoga and music classes for children. If you are in West Delhi and want dance training that doubles as a workout, Pulse is the neighbourhood option built around that mix.

  • Location: K-12, Rajouri Garden
  • Styles: Street, jazz and contemporary fusion; dance fitness
  • Good to know: Kids' dance classes listed; described as a good fit for intermediate dancers

16. Back Beat Crew, Malviya Nagar

Back Beat Crew runs professional dance classes in Malviya Nagar, South Delhi, from C-116 near Vishal Mega Mart, according to its Google listing, which also classifies it as a fitness venue. Its own listing headline keeps the offer simple: professional training in hip-hop, Bollywood and Bhangra.

That trio of styles puts Back Beat Crew in the mainstream of what most Delhi students ask for: film-song routines, street style and Punjabi folk energy, in a South Delhi neighbourhood that also hosts Moving Souls on this list. Verified public detail is thinner than for the larger academies, so confirm the current timetable directly with the studio.

  • Location: C-116, near Vishal Mega Mart, Malviya Nagar
  • Styles: Hip-hop, Bollywood, Bhangra
  • Good to know: Also listed as a fitness venue; confirm current batches with the studio

17. Moving Souls

Moving Souls is a Latin and Bollywood academy founded and led by Ravi Rastogi, who trained at Broadway Dance Center in New York. Its main studio is in Shivalik Colony, Malviya Nagar, near Malviya Nagar Metro station, and the academy also lists studios in Ashok Vihar and Gurugram plus live online classes.

Salsa and Bachata are the core, taught in structured weekly batches for all levels, with Bollywood and jazz alongside and Zumba in the wider programme. The academy offers beginners a free trial class and stresses that no partner or experience is needed. Its troupe also performs and choreographs for corporate events, weddings and television, and the academy holds an annual student showcase.

  • Location: Basement, A-329, Block A, Shivalik Colony, Malviya Nagar
  • Styles: Salsa, Bachata, Bollywood, jazz, Zumba
  • Good to know: Free trial class for beginners; wedding choreography and a performing troupe

Visit website →

18. Nish Dance Academy

Nish Dance Academy stands at 7869-A, Roshnara Road, on the Kamla Nagar side of North Delhi, and is run by Vivek Rajput. Its entry on the Delhi Directorate of Education's academy list records an establishment year of 2009 and categorises it under freestyle dance.

The same official listing credits the academy with performance work that most studios never get near: its students performed a Republic Day dance on Rajpath in 2018 with a school group, and it has handled dance events for Delhi Police. The studio is open seven days a week, from morning to night, which suits school and college groups rehearsing for events.

  • Location: 7869-A, Roshnara Road, Delhi 110007
  • Focus: Freestyle dance and event performances
  • Good to know: Open seven days; the government academy listing records a Republic Day Rajpath performance in 2018

Visit website →

19. Neeti's Dance Studio

Neeti's Dance Studio, at Bali Nagar in West Delhi, is the most unusual entry on this list: it is one of very few studios in India built around hula hoop dance. Founded by dancer and educator Neeti Ahuja, the studio teaches hoop dance to children and adults, in person and online, and a Mid-Day feature describes its online hoopers joining from around the world.

The studio brings international hoop teachers to Delhi for workshops – US hoop artist Jennifer Dennehy taught there in 2019 – and holds annual events where students perform live. Hooping is the specialism, not the whole offer: the studio also teaches Bollywood, hip-hop, contemporary, Bhangra, freestyle, semi-classical and folk dance, ribbon dance and wedding choreography.

  • Location: Bali Nagar, West Delhi
  • Specialism: Hula hoop dance; also Bollywood, hip-hop, contemporary, folk
  • Good to know: Online hoop classes; international hoop workshops hosted

20. Zenith Dance Company (Academy & Troupe)

Zenith Dance Company is both an academy and a professional troupe, founded by Sooraj Katoch and Ritu Kapoor. The Delhi academy sits on the third and fourth floors of A-5/163 in Mayur Vihar Phase 1, above FirstCry, and the company says it now runs seven fully equipped centres across Delhi and Mumbai.

Classes cover Bollywood, contemporary, hip-hop, salsa, belly dance, ballet and Zumba, in the studio and online, and the academy site offers a free trial class booking. The troupe side is heavily booked for entertainment: WeddingWire lists Zenith for customised wedding shows with stage setups and themed performances, and the company also choreographs corporate events.

  • Location: A-5/163, Third and Fourth Floor, Mayur Vihar Phase 1
  • Styles: Bollywood, contemporary, hip-hop, salsa, belly dance, ballet, Zumba
  • Good to know: Academy plus professional troupe; seven centres across Delhi and Mumbai (the company's own figure)

Visit website →

Final word

There is no single best dance academy in Delhi, only a best match for your style, your area and your goal. Shortlist two or three academies from the table above, take a trial class where one is offered, and confirm the current timetable and fee directly with the studio before you enrol. Listings and schedules change through the year; everything in this guide was checked in November 2026.

Frequently asked questions

Which dance academy in Delhi is best for a complete beginner?

Most academies on this list run beginner batches, so choose by style and distance. Moving Souls offers beginners a free trial class, Right Moves runs a dedicated beginners' batch in Pitampura, and general studios such as Rudra and The Dance Space group students by level, so you will not be thrown in with advanced dancers.

Which academy is best for wedding choreography in Delhi?

DX Dance Xtreme and Spark Motion specialise in wedding and sangeet choreography, Delhi Dance Academy and Zenith add professional troupes and backdrop dancers, and HASH and Moving Souls also build full wedding performances. Book early in the wedding season, and ask whether rehearsals happen at the studio, at your home or at the venue.

Are there dance classes for children in Delhi?

Yes. The Music and Dance School and PAIPA run age-grouped batches from early childhood, Right Moves has separate batches for ages 4 to 6 and 7 to 12, Maddii draws a large children's enrolment in Rohini, and Neeti's teaches hula hoop to children as well as adults.

Can I learn salsa or ballroom in Delhi?

Yes. Moving Souls teaches salsa and Bachata in structured weekly batches in Malviya Nagar, with a free trial for beginners, and Lead and Follow India specialises in Latin and ballroom partner dancing in South Delhi. PAIPA and DX Dance Xtreme also list salsa among their styles.

Do any of these academies offer online classes?

Several do. BMP FIRE and Zenith run online classes alongside studio batches, Moving Souls offers live online batches, Neeti's teaches hula hoop online to students worldwide, and HASH and DX Dance Xtreme offer online training for wedding choreography.

How much do dance classes in Delhi cost?

Fees vary widely by academy, style and batch, and they change often, which is why this guide does not quote prices. Most studios will confirm the current monthly fee, joining fee and trial-class policy on a call or WhatsApp message before you enrol.

content.rendered:
Looking for an astrologer in Bangalore? This guide profiles 18 of the city’s best-known Vedic astrology practices — in Indiranagar, Jayanagar, BTM Layout, HSR Layout, Whitefield, Vijayanagar and beyond — and explains what each one actually offers, where it is based and how it consults.

Every profile was rechecked in November 2026 against the practice’s own website and current listings. Where a practice publishes little verifiable detail, the profile says so plainly. Fees are not listed: most of these practices do not publish a fee on their own site, so confirm the charge when you book.

Quick answer: which astrologer should you pick?

  • In Indiranagar: Sai Balaji Anugraha, Sai Upasak and Sri Krishna Astrologer all consult in person; Sri Krishna also lists branches across the city.
  • In Jayanagar: Vishwanath Guruji’s Sri Panchamukhi Astro Centre (established 1989) and Sri Ganapathi Astro Center.
  • In BTM Layout: Pandit MB Joshi, who also consults in HSR Layout and Malleshwaram, and Sai Sadhana, which works online by video.
  • Online from anywhere: Sai Sadhana by video call, and PN Rao — a Hyderabad astrologer included here because he consults for Bangalore clients by phone and WhatsApp.
  • In Whitefield and east Bangalore: Guru Sachidanand Astrology, and Dr. Sidhant Arun Sharma’s Mookambika Astro Center, which also lists Banashankari.

Top 18 Astrologers in Bangalore — Quick Comparison

Detailed Astrologer Profiles

1. Sai Balaji Anugraha Astrologer Center

Sai Balaji Anugraha is a Vedic astrology centre in Indiranagar, in the east of the city. Its website offers readings based on the birth chart and traditional Vedic methods, covering marriage, love and relationships, career, business, finance, education and health. Consultations take place in person at the Indiranagar office, and by phone and WhatsApp video for clients elsewhere in India and abroad.

Key facts

  • Based: Indiranagar; the centre’s site publishes its address as 793, 9th A Main Road, Chinmaya Mission Hospital Road
  • Website: saibalajianugraha.com
  • Services: horoscope reading; marriage astrology and Kundli matching; career, business and financial astrology; education and health astrology
  • Consultations: in person, phone and WhatsApp video
  • Experience: 40+ years, as stated on the centre’s website
  • Hours: Monday to Sunday, 8 AM to 9 PM, per its website

2. Shirdi Sai Krupa Astrologer Center

Shirdi Sai Krupa is a Vedic astrology practice in BTM Layout 2nd Stage, in south Bangalore. Its site focuses on family and marriage problems — husband-and-wife disputes, love marriage, divorce and financial difficulties — alongside business and career astrology, using dasha systems, transits and Kundali matching. Do not confuse it with Shri Sai Krupa in Nagarbhavi (profile 14), a different practice with a similar name.

Key facts

  • Based: BTM Layout 2nd Stage; directory listings give House No 625, 28th Main Road, behind Axa Signal
  • Website: bestastrologersinbangalore.com
  • Services: marriage and family problem solutions; love marriage and divorce guidance; career and business astrology; Kundali matching
  • Consultations: in person and online, per its site
  • Experience: 20 years, as stated on its website

3. ASTROLOGER PN RAO

Pandit PN Rao Shastri runs Dattasai Jyothishyalayam in Kukatpally, Hyderabad. He is not a Bangalore practice: the only source for the old claim of a Bangalore office was this guide’s earlier edition, and no independent listing supports it. He is included because his own site offers phone and WhatsApp video consultations to clients in Bangalore, and states his services and experience clearly.

Practising since 1994, he works in the Parashari tradition of Vedic astrology. His listed services include horoscope reading and Kundli matching, palmistry (Hasta Samudrika Shastra), numerology and name analysis, Vastu consultation, dosha analysis, Prasna Jyotish, gemstone advice and muhurta selection.

Key facts

  • Based: Kukatpally, Hyderabad (no Bangalore office)
  • Website: astrologerpnrao.com
  • Services: horoscope reading; marriage astrology and Kundli matching; palmistry; numerology; Vastu; dosha analysis
  • Consultations: online by phone and WhatsApp video; in person in Hyderabad
  • Languages: Telugu, Hindi and English, per his site
  • Experience: 30+ years; practising since 1994, per his site

4. Guru Sachidanand Astrology

Guru Sachidanand Astrology serves Whitefield and the eastern corridor — Brookefield, Kadubeesanahalli, Marathahalli, Mahadevapura and Krishnarajapuram. It is presented through astrologerinbangalore.info, a shared astrology website rather than a dedicated site, and the astrologer named there is Mr. Raghav Sharma. Services listed include Kundali analysis, horoscope and Kundali matching using the Ashtakoota system, career and financial astrology, Vaastu consultancy, love marriage solutions and poojas.

Key facts

  • Based: Whitefield and Brookefield; its site publishes an address at STS Arcade, Bhuvaneshwari Road, on the Kadubeesanahalli side, Bengaluru 560066
  • Website: astrologerinbangalore.info (shared site)
  • Astrologer named on site: Mr. Raghav Sharma
  • Services: Kundali analysis and matching; career predictions; relationship guidance; Vaastu consultations; poojas
  • Types: Vedic and Nadi astrology
  • Experience: the website speaks of over 35 years of Vedic practice (shared-site wording)

5. Sai Anugraha Astrologer Center

Sai Anugraha is a long-running astrology centre in MC Layout, Vijayanagar, in west Bangalore. Its own site describes checking horoscopes and preparing accurate birth charts, and advising on business, marriage, job, health and love matters. Despite the similar name, it is a different practice from Sai Balaji Anugraha in Indiranagar (profile 1).

Key facts

  • Based: Vijayanagar; House No 1520, 1st Floor, 15th Main Road, MC Layout, as published on its site
  • Website: bestastrologerinvijayanagar.in
  • Services: horoscope analysis; birth chart preparation; guidance on marriage, career, business, health and love
  • Experience: its own site says its astrologer has 50 years of experience
  • Consultations: in person; the site takes appointment bookings (online modes not stated)

6. Bala Tripura Sundari Astrologer Bengaluru

Bala Tripura Sundari Astrologer is presented through the same shared astrology website as Guru Sachidanand (profile 4), astrologerinbangalore.info, and it is the name that site uses for its Koramangala and Vijayanagar locations. The site offers Vedic and Nadi astrology, Vaastu remedies and dosha parihara through poojas, horoscope matching and muhurtham selection, and career and business guidance; a directory profile adds numerology and Vastu as specialisms.

The site’s own location cards give this practice two addresses: 628, 17th A Main Rd, near Sony Signal, near Manyavar, 6th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru 560095, presented for HSR Layout and Bellandur, with phone +91 80730 80673; and 32, 1st Cross, Sangolli Rayanna Rd, Sri Shalla Nagar, Pattegarhpalya, Vijayanagar, Bengaluru 560079, presented for Rajajinagar and Malleshwaram, with phone +91 99451 85928, a number the site also shows on another practice’s card. No individual astrologer is named for this practice on the site, and its pages give differing experience figures, so none is quoted here.

Key facts

  • Areas listed: Koramangala and Vijayanagar, for HSR Layout, Bellandur, Rajajinagar and Malleshwaram (per its website)
  • Addresses (per its website): 628, 17th A Main Rd, 6th Block, Koramangala, Bengaluru 560095; 32, 1st Cross, Sangolli Rayanna Rd, Pattegarhpalya, Vijayanagar, Bengaluru 560079
  • Website: astrologerinbangalore.info (shared site)
  • Services: horoscope matching; muhurtham; Vaastu remedies; dosha parihara poojas; career and business guidance
  • Types: Vedic and Nadi astrology
  • Consultations: in person and online, per its directory listing
  • Contact (per its website): +91 80730 80673 (Koramangala); +91 99451 85928 (Vijayanagar)

7. Sai Sadhana Astrologer Centre Bangalore

Sai Sadhana Astrology Center is a BTM Layout practice that works mainly online: its booking page offers one-to-one video consultations over Google Meet, in English, Hindi or Kannada. Its site lists birth chart (Janma Kundali) analysis, marriage astrology, Kundali matching, Vastu Shastra and health astrology, plus online poojas. The centre is staffed by a team of astrologers rather than one named practitioner.

Key facts

  • Based: BTM Layout 2nd Stage (postcode 560076, per its site and listings)
  • Website: saisadhanaastrology.com
  • Services: Janma Kundali analysis; marriage astrology; Kundali matching; Vastu Shastra; health astrology; online poojas
  • Consultations: online video (Google Meet); WhatsApp contact
  • Languages: English, Hindi and Kannada, per its site

8. Sai Upasak Best Astrologer in Bangalore

Sai Upasak Astrology in Indiranagar is the practice of Pandit G.R. Shastri, whose own site says he has been practising astrology since 1980. He works across several systems — Vedic and Nadi astrology, the Parashari and Krishnamurti paddhati, Lal Kitab, Ashtamangala Prashna, numerology, palmistry, gemology and Vastu — for questions about career, love, foreign settlement and marriage.

Profiles of the practice describe consultations in person and online, and one directory profile lists his languages as English, Hindi, Kannada, Telugu, Tamil and Marathi. A separate listing under a similar name in Koramangala could not be confirmed as the same practice, so this profile covers the Indiranagar practice only.

Key facts

  • Based: Indiranagar
  • Astrologer: Pandit G.R. Shastri
  • Website: saiupasakastrology.in
  • Services: Nadi and Vedic astrology; Ashtamangala Prashna; numerology; palmistry; gemology; Vastu Shastra
  • Practising since: 1980, per his own site

9. Pandit MB Joshi

Pandit M.B. Joshi consults from three Bangalore centres — BTM Layout, HSR Layout and Malleshwaram — and one in Hubli. His own site states over 20 years of practice and an 80-year family lineage, tracing the tradition to his grandfather, Maruthi Balappa Joshi of Udupi.

Alongside palmistry, Vastu and Kundli matching, he offers two Kerala systems that few Bangalore practices list: Ashtamangala Prashna and Kavade Shastra (cowrie-shell reading). Consultations are in person at the centres, and his site also offers call and WhatsApp consultations.

Key facts

  • Centres: BTM Layout (near Jayadeva Metro Station), HSR Layout and Malleshwaram; also Hubli — addresses on his site
  • Website: mbjoshiastro.in
  • Services: palmistry; Vastu guidance; marriage consultation; Kundli matching; Ashtamangala Prashna; Kavade Shastra; yantra and mantra
  • Consultations: in person; call and WhatsApp
  • Experience: 20+ years, as stated on his website

10. Astrologer Vishwanath Guruji Jayanagar

Pandit Sri Vishwanath Guruji runs the Sri Panchamukhi Astro Centre in Jayanagar 9th Block, near Ragigudda Temple, which his site says he established in 1989. The centre covers marriage, family, career and health problems, with Vastu consultations (including on-site visits across Bangalore), horoscope work and pujas such as Navagraha Shanti and Kaal Sarp Dosh Nivaran. Consultations are in person, by phone or by WhatsApp, and remote remedies are offered by phone, video and WhatsApp.

Key facts

  • Based: Jayanagar 9th Block; No. 2004, E-Cross, Sri Panchamukhi Nilaya, near Ragigudda Temple, as published on his site
  • Website: vishwanathguruji.com
  • Established: 1989, per his site
  • Experience: 35+ years, as stated on his website
  • Consultations: in person, phone and WhatsApp
  • Hours: Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 8 PM, per his site

11. Sri Shakti Anjaneya Astrologer

Sri Shakti Anjaneya Astro is the HSR Layout practice of astrologer J D Rao. His own website, linked from the practice's Google listing, names him as its Vedic astrologer and states that he has spent 10 years perfecting his knowledge of the branches of Vedic astrology; it leads with Vedic astrology, palm reading and remedies.

The site places the practice in the basement of House No 88 at the BDA Complex in HSR Layout's 4th Sector, which settles the conflicting floor and unit details in directory listings, and it publishes a contact number, +91 96329 23227. Directory listings add Vastu and puja services to the practice's offer; those rest on the listings rather than the website, so confirm the service you need before you visit.

Key facts

  • Based: HSR Layout; BDA Complex, House No 88, Basement, 4th Sector (practice website)
  • Astrologer: J D Rao (practice website)
  • Website: srishaktianjaneyaastro.com
  • Services: Vedic astrology and palm reading, with remedies (practice website); Vastu and pujas (per listings)
  • Experience: 10 years, as stated on the practice's website
  • Contact: +91 96329 23227 (practice website)
  • Hours (per listing): roughly 6:15 AM to 9 PM daily

12. Sri Krishna

Sri Krishna Astrologer is the Indiranagar practice of Pandith Sri Vasudev Dikshith, based on Chinmaya Mission Hospital Road near Indiranagar Metro Station. His site covers Vedic astrology, palmistry, numerology and horoscope reading and matching, with consultations in person and online, in English, Hindi, Kannada, Telugu and Tamil.

The site also lists branches in Jayanagar 4th Block, Banashankari, HSR Layout, KR Puram, Malleshwaram and Nagarbhavi, and one in Mumbai. He is a different practitioner from PN Rao (profile 3); the two were conflated in an earlier edition of this guide.

Key facts

  • Based: Indiranagar; #186, 1st Floor, 9th Cross, CMH Road, near Indiranagar Metro Station, as published on his site
  • Astrologer: Pandith Sri Vasudev Dikshith
  • Website: srikrishnaastrologer.com
  • Services: horoscope reading and matching; palmistry; numerology; Vedic astrology
  • Consultations: in person and online
  • Languages: English, Hindi, Kannada, Telugu and Tamil, per his site

13. Shri Balaji Jyothisyalaya Best Astrologer in Bangalore

Shri Balaji Jyothisyalaya is an astrology practice in HSR Layout Sector 2. Its own website, which could not be confirmed when this profile was first written, now supplies the missing detail: it names the practice's founder as Pandit Sri Swaroop Anand and presents palmistry and Kundali matching among its headline services, alongside personalised horoscope readings.

The site's service pages cover career and job guidance, marriage compatibility with remedies, health readings, finance guidance, rituals, tarot card readings and gemstone recommendations. It publishes the full address, a phone number, +91 95355 49128, an email address, info@shribalajijyothishyalaya.com, and hours listed as round the clock, seven days a week. One caution: its About page leaves the practice's years of experience as an unfilled template placeholder, so no experience figure is given here.

Key facts

  • Based: HSR Layout Sector 2; #168, 24th Main, 18th Cross Road, near Bescom Office, Bengaluru 560102 (practice website)
  • Founded by: Pandit Sri Swaroop Anand (practice website)
  • Website: shribalajijyothishyalaya.com
  • Services (practice website): palmistry; Kundali matching; horoscope readings; career, marriage, health and finance guidance; rituals; tarot readings; gemstone recommendations
  • Contact: +91 95355 49128; info@shribalajijyothishyalaya.com (practice website)
  • Hours (practice website): listed as open 24 hours, seven days a week

14. Shri Sai Krupa Astrologer Center

Shri Sai Krupa is a Vedic astrology centre in Nagarbhavi, in west Bangalore. Its directory profile describes natal chart analysis and personalised readings, with palmistry as a complementary tool, used for career direction, relationship compatibility and the timing of major decisions. It is a separate practice from Shirdi Sai Krupa in BTM Layout (profile 2), despite the similar name.

Key facts

  • Based: Nagarbhavi; House No 50, 7th Cross Road, Binny Layout, Marilingappa Extension (directory listing)
  • Website: shrisaikrupabestastrologerinbangalore.com
  • Services (per directory): Vedic astrology; natal chart analysis; palmistry
  • Consultations: in person and online, per its directory profile

15. Sri Ganapathi Astro Center

Sri Ganapathi Astro Center is led by Pandit Acharya Sri Damodhar Rao, whose site states 28+ years of experience. It works from two Bangalore addresses — Jayanagar 4th Block, opposite Ganesha Temple, and Nagarbhavi — and offers personalised consultations on relationships, career, finance and health, including Kundli matching and dosha parihara (remedies). Consultations are by appointment.

Key facts

  • Centres: Jayanagar 4th Block, 121/24, 1st Floor, 7th B Main, 30th Cross Road; and Nagarbhavi, 2nd Main Road, NGEF Layout (own site)
  • Astrologer: Pandit Acharya Sri Damodhar Rao
  • Website: sriganapathiastro.com
  • Services: personalised consultations; Kundli matching; dosha parihara; guidance on marriage, career, finance and health
  • Experience: 28+ years, as stated on its website

16. Sri Guru

Sri Guru Astrologer in Girinagar is the practice of Sri Guru Raghavendra Joshi. His own website, which could not be fully read when this profile was first written, now confirms the core detail: it describes a spiritual guidance centre led by him, offering horoscope reading, Vastu guidance, traditional remedies and spiritual solutions, for questions about love, marriage, family, career, business, health, education and relationships.

The website names the Girinagar address below as the practice's main branch and publishes a phone number, +91 98458 39481, and an email address, raghavendraastrocenterkrpuram@gmail.com. It states no figure for his years of practice; the experience figure in the key facts comes from his directory profile and is kept attributed to it.

Key facts

  • Based: Girinagar; No 1176, 7th Cross, 3rd B Main Road, near Karya Siddhi Hanuman Temple (practice website and directory listing)
  • Astrologer: Sri Guru Raghavendra Joshi
  • Website: sriguruastrologer.com
  • Services: horoscope reading; Vastu guidance; traditional remedies; spiritual solutions (practice website); directory profile adds palm reading, horoscope matching and numerology
  • Contact: +91 98458 39481; raghavendraastrocenterkrpuram@gmail.com (practice website)
  • Experience: over 20 years (per his directory profile; not stated on his website)
  • Hours (per directory): 10:30 AM to 8:30 PM (to 8 PM on Sundays)

17. Pandit Maruthi Rao Shastry ji Best Astrologer Bangalore

Pandit Maruthi Rao Shastry ji is a Vedic astrology practitioner based at Sri Mookambika Nilaya in Kamakshipalya. Business listings give the full address as No. 336, Sri Mookambika Nilaya, 5th Main Road, Meenakshinagar, Asthagrama Layout, Bengaluru 560079, and the services they consistently attach to his name are Janam Kundli and horoscope readings, Kundali matching and Vastu consultation, with face reading and palmistry also listed.

Two cautions apply. Older listings show an address in BTM Layout 2nd Stage, which could not be confirmed as current, so use the Kamakshipalya address his current listings carry. And the website address his listings publish no longer shows his practice: checked in November 2026, panditmaruthiraoshastry.com serves unrelated content, so contact him through his business listing instead. No figure for his years of practice could be verified, so none is given.

Key facts

  • Based: Kamakshipalya; No. 336, Sri Mookambika Nilaya, 5th Main Road, Meenakshinagar, Asthagrama Layout, Bengaluru 560079 (business listings)
  • Services (per listings): Vedic astrology; Janam Kundli and horoscope readings; Kundali matching; Vastu consultation; face reading; palmistry
  • Contact: +91 97392 26629 (business listing)
  • Website: the domain in his listings, panditmaruthiraoshastry.com, no longer carries the practice (checked November 2026)
  • Note: an older BTM Layout 2nd Stage address appears in some listings and could not be confirmed as current

18. Dr. Pandit Sri Sidhant Arun Sharma Guruji

Dr. Pandit Sri Sidhant Arun Sharma Guruji runs Sri Mookambika Astro Center, with listings in Whitefield — above Reliance Fresh on Whitefield Main Road, near HDFC Bank — and in Banashankari 3rd Stage. His WeddingWire profile lists Vedic astrology, Kundli Milan, palmistry, numerology, Vastu, colour therapy, tantra and career and relationship advice, with consultations over a call or in person.

A business-awards write-up credits him with the IIB Karnataka Top Influential Leadership Award 2023 for astrology and Vastu solutions. Third-party pages give conflicting experience figures, so none is quoted here.

Key facts

  • Centres: Whitefield (Whitefield Main Road, Sathya Sai Layout) and Banashankari 3rd Stage, 343, 2nd Main Road (directory listings)
  • Practice name: Sri Mookambika Astro Center
  • Website: mookambikaastrocenter.in
  • Services (per his WeddingWire profile): Vedic astrology; Kundli Milan; palmistry; numerology; Vastu; career and relationship advice
  • Consultations: in person and over a call, per his profile

How to Choose and Verify an Astrologer in Bangalore

  • Start with your question: Kundli matching, career, Vastu and health questions are handled by different specialists; each profile notes the practice’s focus.
  • Check the practice’s own website: a current site with a named astrologer and a published address is a good sign. Each profile names the practice’s website.
  • Confirm the fee before you book: almost none of these practices publish fees on their own sites. Ask when you call or message, and be wary of anyone who will not state a fee in advance.
  • Check the name and locality together: several practices here share similar names — the Sai-named centres are separate businesses — and some have moved over the years.
  • Consider online: several practices consult by phone, WhatsApp or video, which is useful if the centre is across the city.
  • Treat big claims carefully: experience figures in this guide are quoted only where the practice’s own site states them; where sources conflict, the profile says so.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which astrologer in Bangalore is best for Kundli matching?

Several practices in this guide list Kundli matching as a core service, including Pandit MB Joshi, Sai Balaji Anugraha, Sri Ganapathi Astro Center and Sai Sadhana. The right choice depends on your area and on whether you prefer to consult in person or online.

Do these astrologers offer online consultations?

Yes. Sai Sadhana consults by video call; PN Rao (Hyderabad) by phone and WhatsApp video; Vishwanath Guruji and Pandit MB Joshi offer phone and WhatsApp consultations alongside in-person visits; and Sri Krishna Astrologer offers both in-person and online consultations.

How much does an astrologer in Bangalore charge?

Most practices in this guide do not publish a fee on their own website, and several confirm the fee before the session instead. Ask for the fee, the session length and what is included when you book, and do not agree to pay for remedies you have not discussed.

What details do I need for a horoscope reading?

Typically your date, time and place of birth — several practices here ask for exactly these when you book. If your birth time is uncertain, say so when booking; prashna systems such as Ashtamangala Prashna, offered by Pandit MB Joshi and Sai Upasak, are designed to answer a question without relying on a birth chart.

Are the Sai-named centres in this guide the same business?

No. Sai Balaji Anugraha (Indiranagar), Shirdi Sai Krupa (BTM Layout) and Shri Sai Krupa (Nagarbhavi) are three separate practices, and Sai Anugraha (Vijayanagar) and Sai Sadhana (BTM Layout) are different again. Check the name and the locality together before you book.

This guide was fully re-researched and rewritten in November 2026. Details such as addresses, hours and services can change; confirm the essentials on the practice’s own website or listing before you travel.

The Big 4 Companies In India — Deloitte, PwC, EY, and KPMG — dominate professional services across audit, tax, consulting, and advisory. Whether you are a fresher exploring campus placements, an MBA graduate targeting consulting, or an experienced CA/CPA looking to switch, this guide compares all four firms on India revenue, offices, salaries, hiring process, work culture, and career paths.

We have pulled verified data on global and India headcount, analyst-to-manager salary bands, hybrid work policies, internship programmes, major clients, and office locations across Bengaluru, Gurugram, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Kolkata, and Ahmedabad.

How to Choose Among the Big 4 in India

  • Largest scale & global mobility: Deloitte leads on global revenue (US$70.5B) and India headcount (~140,000).
  • Fastest India revenue growth: PwC reports strong FY26 India revenue (~₹14,000 crore) with flexible hybrid work.
  • Learning & purpose-driven culture: EY invests heavily in EY Badges, graduate rotations, and strategy consulting.
  • People-first hybrid culture: KPMG offers Flex with Purpose and competitive analyst salaries (~₹10.9 lakhs).
  • City preference: All four have major hubs in Mumbai, Gurugram, Bengaluru, and Hyderabad — check office tables below.

Big 4 Companies In India — Quick Comparison

Detailed Company Profiles

1. Deloitte

India HQ: Mumbai  |  India Revenue: ₹10,000 crore (FY24)  |  India Employees: 140,000  |  India Offices: 24 locations

View careers at Deloitte →

Career highlights

  • Core services: Audit, Consulting, Financial Advisory, Risk Advisory, Tax
  • Best for: Ambitious professionals seeking the largest Big 4 brand, global mobility, and diverse service lines.
  • Internship: 2 to 6 months paid summer and virtual internships across consulting, audit, tax, risk advisory, and technology
  • Work model: Hybrid — 2-3 days a week in office
  • Interview difficulty: Medium

Deloitte is one of the premier Big 4 Companies In India, offering an unparalleled platform for ambitious professionals to launch and accelerate their careers. Founded in 1845 by William Welch Deloitte in London, the firm has a rich history of innovation and excellence that has propelled it to become the largest professional services network globally by revenue, reaching an impressive US$70.5 billion in 2025.

In India, Deloitte continues to dominate the market with significant revenue growth and a robust footprint across major cities. Our core services span audit and assurance, management consulting, financial advisory, risk advisory, tax, and legal services, providing our people with diverse opportunities to develop deep expertise and solve complex challenges for top-tier clients.

We pride ourselves on cultivating a dynamic workplace culture that champions continuous learning, inclusivity, and well-being. With structured career paths, global mobility programs, and access to Deloitte University, we empower our employees to achieve their highest potential.

Whether you are a fresh graduate or an experienced professional, joining Deloitte means becoming part of a collaborative community where your ideas matter and your career aspirations can truly take flight in a highly competitive and rewarding market.

Company overview: Deloitte is a British multinational professional services network headquartered in London, England. As the largest professional services network in the world by revenue and number of employees, it is one of the Big Four accounting firms.

History: Founded in 1845 by William Welch Deloitte in London, the firm expanded internationally and evolved through key mergers, notably with Haskins & Sells in 1952 and Touche Ross in 1989 to form Deloitte & Touche. Renamed Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu in 1993, it uniquely retained its consulting division during the early 2000s regulatory shakeups, growing into the world's largest professional services network.

Why choose Deloitte? Deloitte stands out as a leading career choice due to its inclusive work environment, global opportunities, and strong focus on professional development and employee well-being. It offers structured programs, learning via Deloitte University, and customizable career tracks that emphasize mentorship and merit-based advancement.

Brand Finance's Most Valuable Commercial Services Brand (2019-2025), TIME's Best Companies for Future Leaders 2025, and India's Best Companies To Work For (2022-2024).

Pros

  • Global brand recognition
  • Structured growth opportunities
  • Continuous learning and development
  • Generous benefits and PTO
  • Collaborative work culture

Cons

  • High workload and long hours
  • Complex organizational structure
  • Highly competitive environment
  • Strict compliance restrictions

Major India office locations

Salary snapshot (India)

2. PwC

India HQ: Gurugram  |  India Revenue: Rs 14,000 crore (FY26)  |  India Employees: 30,000  |  India Offices: 27 offices

View careers at PwC →

Career highlights

  • Core services: Assurance, Advisory, Tax
  • Best for: Professionals who want flexible hybrid work with strong assurance and advisory exposure.
  • Internship: 8-week and 6-month internship programmes across consulting, audit, tax, risk advisory, and technology
  • Work model: Flexible remote/hybrid — 6 days a month in office
  • Interview difficulty: Moderate

PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) stands proudly among the leading Big 4 Companies In India, renowned for its commitment to building trust in society and solving important problems. The firm's storied history began with the historic merger of Price Waterhouse, founded in 1849, and Coopers & Lybrand, established in 1854.

Today, PwC is a global powerhouse with a staggering $56.9 billion in global revenue, demonstrating formidable market position and financial stability. In India, PwC is experiencing rapid growth, offering exceptional career opportunities across its core services of assurance, advisory, and tax.

For prospective applicants, PwC represents a gateway to working with some of the world's most prestigious organizations. Our workplace culture is deeply rooted in inclusivity, flexibility, and continuous professional development.

We offer flexible working models, extensive training programs, and a supportive environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated. As a professional here, you will be challenged to innovate and lead, backed by a global network that values your well-being and career progression.

Join PwC to build a meaningful career, make a tangible impact, and thrive within a collaborative ecosystem designed to bring out your absolute best every single day.

Company overview: PricewaterhouseCoopers (PwC) is a leading global professional services network providing audit, assurance, tax, and consulting services.

History: PwC was formed in 1998 through the merger of Price Waterhouse (1849) and Coopers & Lybrand (1854). In 2010, the firm formally shortened its brand name to PwC.

Why choose PwC? PwC stands out for its inclusive workplace culture, continuous learning opportunities, flexible work models, and global impact serving major multinational clients.

India's Best Companies To Work For 2026, SAP ACE Awards 2025, and Coursera Outstanding Achievement Award 2025.

Pros

  • Strong global brand and market prestige
  • Great learning, training, and professional growth opportunities
  • Exposure to diverse industries and large-scale clients
  • Flexible working hours and hybrid work options
  • Inclusive culture and supportive team environment

Cons

  • Poor work-life balance in some teams
  • Long working hours and high pressure
  • Toxic culture reported in certain divisions

Major India office locations

Salary snapshot (India)

Frequently asked questions

  • Does PwC offer remote work? Yes — a flexible framework allows remote work and telecommuting with hybrid options (about 6 days a month in office).

3. EY

India HQ: Gurugram  |  India Revenue: Over ₹16,000 crore  |  India Employees: 120,000  |  India Offices: 16 locations

View careers at EY →

Career highlights

  • Core services: Assurance, Consulting, Strategy and Transactions, Tax
  • Best for: Consulting and strategy careers with strong learning programs and purpose-driven culture.
  • Internship: EY Summer Internship, EY Launch Internship, EY-Parthenon Internship
  • Work model: Hybrid — 2-3 days in office per week
  • Interview difficulty: Medium

Ernst & Young (EY) is a dynamic leader among the Big 4 Companies In India, driven by a powerful purpose to build a better working world. The firm was formed in 1989 through the strategic merger of Ernst & Whinney and Arthur Young & Co., uniting decades of heritage dating back to 1849.

Today, EY commands a massive global presence with US$53.2 billion in revenue, reflecting its robust financial health and commanding market position. Our core expertise encompasses assurance, consulting, strategy and transactions, and tax services, enabling us to deliver exceptional value to a diverse portfolio of multinational clients.

For career-driven individuals, EY offers an extraordinary environment characterized by continuous learning and global exposure. We are deeply committed to fostering an inclusive, collaborative, and supportive workplace culture where every team member can thrive.

Through initiatives like EY Badges and comprehensive leadership programs, we invest heavily in your professional development. By joining EY, you are not just taking a job; you are embarking on a transformative career journey where your unique talents are nurtured, and your potential is maximized in a fast-paced, forward-thinking, and highly innovative organization.

Company overview: EY is a global professional services network providing assurance, consulting, strategy and transactions, and tax services across more than 150 countries.

History: Formed in 1989 through the merger of Ernst & Whinney and Arthur Young & Co., with roots tracing back to 1849. The firm officially rebranded as EY in 2013.

Why choose EY? EY stands out for its purpose-driven culture, continuous learning through EY Badges, global mobility programs, and technology innovation leadership.

32-time SAP Awards winner, Microsoft Partner of the Year, and ServiceNow Partner of the Year.

Pros

  • Plentiful learning opportunities and strong professional development
  • Global exposure and strong brand name on resume
  • Good compensation and benefits including annual bonuses
  • Inclusive, collaborative, and supportive team culture
  • Flat organizational structure with approachable leadership

Cons

  • Poor work-life balance and long working hours
  • High pressure and strict deadlines
  • Office politics and micromanagement in some teams
  • Limited fast-track promotions in certain divisions

Major India office locations

Salary snapshot (India)

Frequently asked questions

  • What is the minimum CGPA required for EY? EY generally expects a minimum of 60% or equivalent CGPA in academics.
  • Can I apply to EY with a one-year education gap? Yes, a gap of up to one year is allowed.
  • Does EY require prior work experience for freshers? No, EY hires freshers without prior experience for entry-level roles.

4. KPMG

India HQ: Mumbai  |  India Revenue: Rs. 5,900-6,200 crore  |  India Employees: 31,000  |  India Offices: 16 locations

View careers at KPMG →

Career highlights

  • Core services: Audit, Tax, Advisory
  • Best for: Early professionals seeking people-first culture, hybrid flexibility, and accelerated growth in audit and advisory.
  • Internship: Global Internship Program, Build Your Own Internship, Embark Scholars, Summer Internship
  • Work model: Hybrid — Flex with Purpose
  • Interview difficulty: Competitive

KPMG is a distinguished member of the Big 4 Companies In India, offering a vibrant and progressive environment for professionals eager to make a significant global impact. The firm's legacy was forged in 1987 through the mega-merger of Peat Marwick International and Klynveld Main Goerdeler, bringing together the visionary leadership of Piet Klynveld, William Barclay Peat, James Marwick, and Reinhard Goerdeler.

With a formidable global revenue of US$39.8 billion, KPMG maintains a strong and resilient market position, delivering top-tier audit, tax, and advisory services. We are dedicated to providing our employees with accelerated career growth, extensive learning and development initiatives, and the chance to work alongside industry experts.

Our workplace culture is built on a people-first philosophy, prioritizing mental well-being, inclusivity, and flexible hybrid work options. At KPMG, you will find a supportive community that encourages innovation and rewards excellence.

We invite passionate and driven individuals to join our ranks, where you will be empowered to shape your own career path, tackle complex business challenges, and contribute to a legacy of excellence within one of the world's most respected and prestigious professional services networks.

Company overview: KPMG is a global network of independent professional firms providing Audit, Tax, and Advisory services across more than 146 countries.

History: KPMG was formed in 1987 through the mega-merger of Peat Marwick International and Klynveld Main Goerdeler (KMG). The initials stand for Piet Klynveld, William Barclay Peat, James Marwick, and Reinhard Goerdeler.

Why choose KPMG? KPMG blends professional growth, inclusivity, and global opportunity with a strong people-first culture and flexible hybrid policies.

Gold at Economic Times Human Capital Awards, Top 10 Best Companies for Women in India 2024, and Microsoft India Partner of the Year 2024.

Pros

  • Strong learning and development initiatives with education allowances
  • Accelerated career growth and promotion opportunities
  • Flexible hybrid work options and generous travel per diems
  • Comprehensive health and mental well-being support
  • Inclusive, diverse, and collaborative work environment

Cons

  • Long working hours
  • Lower salary bands compared to some peers
  • Office politics in some teams

Major India office locations

Salary snapshot (India)

Frequently asked questions

  • How do I apply for a job at KPMG? Internships or referrals are among the best routes; you can also apply online through the careers portal.
  • Does KPMG offer internships to undergraduates? Yes, KPMG annually recruits interns from colleges through structured programs including GIP and summer internships.
  • Do I need an accounting background to apply? No, but you should include all prior work experience in your application.

Conclusion

There is no single best Big 4 firm for everyone. Deloitte suits those who want maximum scale and global exposure. PwC is strong for assurance and advisory with flexible work. EY excels in consulting, strategy, and structured graduate programmes. KPMG offers a people-first culture with competitive entry salaries and hybrid flexibility.

A good perfume in India has to survive heat, humidity and long days, and it has to suit the person wearing it. This guide covers 18 perfumes sold in India today, from an international classic launched in 1991 to Indian brands such as Bella Vita, Denver, Wild Stone and Beardo, and it sticks to what each brand itself publishes: the notes, the concentration, the bottle size and who the fragrance is made for.

Every product below links to its Amazon.in listing and to the brand’s own website, so you can check the current pack, size and details before you buy. Prices change too often to print here, and star ratings tell you little about how a scent will wear on your skin, so neither appears in this guide.

This post contains affiliate links. As an Amazon Associate, we earn from qualifying purchases. This does not affect our editorial independence.

Quick answer

  • Classic floral for women: Elizabeth Taylor White Diamonds, a floral chypre eau de toilette from 1991.
  • Oud, worn light: Bella Vita White Oud and Honey Oud, or Lattafa Teriaq Intense for a warmer, spicier take.
  • Fresh and office-safe: Bella Vita CEO Man, Park Avenue Voyage Amazon Woods and Denver Hamilton.
  • Bold evenings: Beardo Godfather, the Beardo LSD and Mariner duo, and BlaBliblu Old Money.
  • Gift sets: the Bella Vita women’s gift set (4 x 20ml), the Denver Hamilton two-packs and the Bella Vita Narco and Devil combo.
  • Trying before committing: the 20ml combos and gift sets let you test several scents for the cost of one full bottle.

How to choose the right perfume in India

Start with concentration, because it decides both strength and how a perfume behaves in Indian weather. The rest is about matching the fragrance family to your day.

  • Eau de parfum (EDP) carries a higher share of fragrance oil than eau de toilette (EDT), so it usually smells stronger and lasts longer. Most perfumes in this guide are EDPs.
  • Eau de toilette (EDT) is lighter and fresher. White Diamonds is an EDT, and it suits daytime and office wear well.
  • Parfum is the strongest common format. BlaBliblu labels Old Money simply as a parfum.
  • Liquid perfume spray is the label Yardley uses for Gentleman Classic in India; it is not sold here as an EDT or EDP, so judge it by its notes rather than by a concentration badge.
  • Fresh families (citrus, aromatic, aquatic) feel clean in heat. Woody, spicy and oud families project more and suit evenings, air-conditioned spaces and winter.
  • Test on skin, not paper. A scent changes over a few hours as the top notes fade into the heart and base, so wear it once before judging it.
  • Climate counts. Heat amplifies projection and shortens wear, so a lighter hand with a strong EDP works better than extra sprays.

Quick comparison

All notes below are the ones each brand itself publishes. The comparison table carries no prices, because they change from week to week.

The 18 perfumes in detail

1. White Diamonds Eau De Toilette (100ml) — Elizabeth Taylor

White Diamonds is the senior perfume on this list. Elizabeth Taylor’s brand states that it launched in 1991, in a launch the brand itself describes as frenzied, and it was created with IFF master perfumer Carlos Benaïm. Taylor’s favourite flower, narcissus, became one of its defining notes.

The manufacturer’s published pyramid opens with Amazon lily, neroli and aldehydes, moves through tuberose, jasmine, narcissus and rose, and settles on amber, oakmoss, patchouli and sandalwood. The brand store describes the blend as a floral chypre and calls it long-lasting. It is a dressed-up, powdery floral: best for evenings, occasions and anyone who prefers a classic signature over a trend.

  • Brand: Elizabeth Taylor
  • For: Women
  • Type: Eau de toilette spray
  • Size: 100ml (also sold in smaller bottles)
  • Top notes (manufacturer): Amazon lily, neroli, aldehydes
  • Heart: Tuberose, jasmine, narcissus, rose
  • Base: Amber, oakmoss, patchouli, sandalwood
  • Launched: 1991, as stated by the brand

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: elizabethtaylor.com

2. CEO Man Perfume (100ml) — Bella Vita

CEO Man is Bella Vita’s boardroom fragrance for men: an eau de parfum built to smell clean and composed rather than loud. In India the brand states a simple pyramid: lemon and sugar at the top, lavender in the heart, and vetiver, moss and tonka at the base.

That structure makes it an easy office and daytime wear, fresh at first and smooth and woody as it dries down. Bella Vita states that its perfumes are IFRA-certified and made with oils from France, Spain and Italy. Note that the brand’s overseas stores publish a different note pyramid for CEO Man; the one used here is the version the brand states for India.

  • Brand: Bella Vita Luxury
  • For: Men
  • Type: Eau de parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Top notes (brand, India): Lemon, sugar
  • Heart: Lavender
  • Base: Vetiver, moss, tonka
  • Brand states: IFRA-certified; oils from France, Spain and Italy

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: bellavitaluxury.co.in

3. Hamilton & Imperial Perfume Pack (70ml x 2) — Denver

This pack pairs the two best-known names in Denver’s Hamilton range. Hamilton itself is the original of the line, an aromatic fougère eau de parfum that Denver describes as a timeless blend built for daily wear.

Imperial is the bolder half: Denver calls it a spicy oriental eau de parfum. Between them you get one safe everyday scent and one warmer evening scent in a single purchase, which makes the pack a practical first buy from the brand.

  • Brand: Denver
  • For: Men
  • Contents: Hamilton 70ml + Imperial 70ml, both eau de parfum
  • Hamilton notes (brand): lavender, bergamot and carnation; rose, juniper, cypress and galbanum; patchouli, pine, cedarwood and musk
  • Imperial notes (brand): mandarin, grapefruit and mint; rose, cinnamon, spices and patchouli; woody notes, musk and amber
  • Families (brand): Hamilton — aromatic fougère; Imperial — spicy oriental

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: denverformen.com

4. Hamilton & Honour Perfume Pack (100ml x 2) — Denver

The second Denver pack pairs Hamilton with Honour, the softest scent in the Hamilton series. Denver positions Honour as a floral musk blend designed to draw compliments in gatherings, and its product page title calls it a fresh citrus eau de parfum.

Honour opens with bergamot, tea and mandarin, has a heart of rose, cardamom and fern, and is anchored in sandalwood, tonka bean, amber and benzoin. Paired with the greener, sharper Hamilton, the pack covers both crisp and smooth moods at full-bottle sizes.

  • Brand: Denver
  • For: Men
  • Contents: Hamilton 100ml + Honour 100ml, both eau de parfum
  • Honour top notes (brand): Bergamot, tea, mandarin
  • Honour heart: Rose, cardamom, fern
  • Honour base: Sandalwood, tonka bean, amber, benzoin
  • Brand positions Honour for gatherings and gifting

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: denverformen.com

5. CEO Man & White Oud Unisex Combo — Bella Vita

This combo packs 20ml bottles of CEO Man and White Oud, the two Bella Vita scents that pull in opposite directions. CEO Man is the fresh, citrus-woody office scent described above; White Oud is the brand’s lighter reading of oud, a unisex eau de parfum that opens with artemisian lemon, has freesia in the heart and closes with amber, musk and oud.

The combo listing describes the pair with tonka, agarwood and orange notes and a woody character. At 20ml each, the bottles are travel-friendly and big enough to judge both scents properly before buying a full bottle of either.

  • Brand: Bella Vita Luxury
  • For: Men and women (unisex)
  • Contents: CEO Man 20ml + White Oud 20ml, both eau de parfum
  • White Oud notes (brand): artemisian lemon; freesia; amber, musk and oud
  • Combo described by the brand with tonka, agarwood and orange
  • Total quantity: 40ml

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: bellavitaluxury.co.in

6. Voyage Signature Collection — Park Avenue (Amazon Woods, 120ml)

Despite the grand name, this listing is a single 120ml bottle: Park Avenue Voyage Amazon Woods, a liquid perfume for men from Park Avenue’s Signature Collection. Park Avenue’s brand store lists its scent simply as wood and flags it as long-lasting.

The brand’s own description says the fragrance unfolds in three layers: a refreshing citrus opening with mandarin, a spicy heart of nutmeg and cinnamon, and a dense woody, musky base with amber running through it. It is a warm, woody everyday scent at a generous bottle size.

  • Brand: Park Avenue
  • For: Men
  • Type: Liquid perfume (the brand store does not label it EDP or EDT)
  • Size: 120ml, pack of 1
  • Notes (brand): citrus and mandarin; nutmeg and cinnamon; amber, woody and musky base
  • Brand store scent field: Wood

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: myraymond.com

7. Edge Eau De Parfum (100ml) — Wild Stone

Edge is Wild Stone’s sharp, fresh entry for men, and the brand’s own guides describe it in three moves: a citrus opening, spicy middle notes and a woody base. On Wild Stone’s blog the named notes are lemon and green notes up top, settling into cedarwood and amber.

That makes Edge a daytime and summer-leaning scent in this list: bright at first spray, then clean and woody. Wild Stone lists it as a 100ml perfume for men on its own store.

  • Brand: Wild Stone
  • For: Men
  • Size: 100ml
  • Notes (brand): lemon and green notes; spicy middle notes; cedarwood and amber base
  • Brand describes it as sharp and fresh, suited to everyday wear

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: wildstone.in

8. Brazilian Maracuja Cognac Eau De Parfum (50ml) — Engage

Engage is ITC’s fragrance brand, and Brazilian Maracuja Cognac is its bold premium eau de parfum for men. Maracuja is passionfruit, and Engage’s own shop keeps the stated notes short and striking: leather and amber.

The brand presents the scent as intense and magnetic, pairing the tropical fruit with the warmth of cognac, and lists the ingredient Passiflora edulis (passionfruit) seed oil. Engage positions it for daily use and for gifting. Ignore marketplace titles that add oud to the name; the brand’s own shop does not state oud for this perfume.

  • Brand: Engage (ITC)
  • For: Men
  • Type: Eau de parfum
  • Size: 50ml
  • Notes (brand): Leather and amber
  • Marketed by ITC Ltd; country of origin: India, as stated on the brand shop

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: itcengage.com

9. Old Money Perfume for Man — BlaBliblu

Old Money is the statement piece in this list. BlaBliblu sells it as a parfum, the strongest format here, in a woody, floral and earthy family, under the tagline “Legacy. Grandeur. Power.” The brand says it is built for formal occasions and for rooms where first impressions matter.

In the brand’s own telling, it opens with crisp green apple and a bitter, boozy davana, turns floral with osmanthus and damask rose over clean cedar, and finishes with vanilla absolute, tonka bean and deep patchouli. The brand states a 12-hour longevity for it; treat that as the brand’s own claim. One gap: the brand’s store page does not state a bottle size, so check the size on the listing before ordering.

  • Brand: BlaBliblu
  • For: Men
  • Type: Parfum
  • Family (brand): Woody, floral, earthy
  • Notes (brand): green apple and davana; osmanthus and damask rose; cedar; vanilla absolute, tonka bean and patchouli
  • Brand-stated longevity: 12 hours (brand claim)
  • Bottle size: not stated on the brand’s store page

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: blabliblu.com

10. Luxury Perfume Collection — Bella Vita Women’s Gift Set (4 x 20ml)

The listing name undersells what this is: a gift set of four 20ml eau de parfum minis for women, namely Date, Senorita, Glam and Rose. It is the easiest way in this guide to try several Bella Vita scents at once, and the set is positioned squarely for gifting.

Bella Vita describes Rose as a woody rose that meets pink pepper and citrusy orange, and Glam as jasmine-led, with citrusy orange and calming white honey. The set as a whole is floral and fruity in character. Each mini is also a sensible handbag size.

  • Brand: Bella Vita Luxury
  • For: Women
  • Contents: Date, Senorita, Glam and Rose, 20ml each, all eau de parfum
  • Total quantity: 80ml
  • Character (brand): floral and fruity
  • Brand describes Rose with pink pepper and citrusy orange; Glam with jasmine, orange and white honey

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: bellavitaluxury.co.in

11. Ultra Sensual Perfume Spray (100ml) — Wild Stone

Ultra Sensual is the warmer, spicier Wild Stone in this guide, and the brand’s blog gives it a full pyramid: zesty top notes of lemon, rosemary, basil and lavender; a spicy heart of cardamom, coriander and juniper; and a base of dry amber, moss and patchouli.

Where Edge is sharp and green, Ultra Sensual leans aromatic and evening-friendly while still opening fresh enough for daytime. Wild Stone lists it as a 100ml perfume for men on its own store.

  • Brand: Wild Stone
  • For: Men
  • Size: 100ml
  • Top notes (brand): Lemon, rosemary, basil, lavender
  • Heart: Cardamom, coriander, juniper
  • Base: Dry amber, moss, patchouli

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: wildstone.in

12. Godfather Perfume for Men (100ml) — Beardo

Godfather is Beardo’s flagship eau de parfum for men, and the brand files it in the aromatic, spicy family. Beardo describes it as a concoction of mint and lemon with geranium flowers, over base notes of vetiver and musk.

The brand positions Godfather as a day-and-night fragrance with an authoritative, dressed-up character, and points out that an EDP’s higher concentration lasts longer than an EDT. Beardo’s own store currently sells Godfather in 50ml bottles within its combos; the standalone 100ml bottle is the one listed on Amazon, which is the listing linked here.

  • Brand: Beardo
  • For: Men
  • Type: Eau de parfum
  • Size: 100ml (this listing)
  • Family (brand): Aromatic, spicy
  • Notes (brand): mint and lemon; geranium; vetiver and musk base

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: beardo.in

13. Honey Oud Long Lasting Perfume — Bella Vita

Honey Oud is Bella Vita’s sweet take on oud, a unisex eau de parfum. The brand’s stated pyramid is consistent across its stores: bergamot and sweet honey on top; rose, oud and patchouli in the middle; and vanilla, musk and amber at the base. Its headline notes are ambergris, honey and oud.

If White Oud is the fresher oud in this guide, Honey Oud is the warmer and sweeter one, better suited to evenings and cooler weather. The brand states it is IFRA-certified, and it is also sold in a 20ml mini.

  • Brand: Bella Vita Luxury
  • For: Men and women (unisex)
  • Type: Eau de parfum
  • Size: 100ml (20ml mini also sold)
  • Top notes (brand): Bergamot, sweet honey
  • Heart: Rose, oud, patchouli
  • Base: Vanilla, musk, amber
  • Brand states: IFRA-certified

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: bellavitaluxury.co.in

14. Midnight Duo: LSD & Mariner (50ml x 2) — Beardo

This Amazon combo pairs two 50ml Beardo eau de parfums with opposite moods. LSD is the bold one: Beardo places it in the amber, spicy family and describes a blend of black currant, litchi, nutmeg and freesia, aimed at date nights, parties and evenings out.

Mariner is the fresh counterweight, an aromatic, aquatic scent whose brand-stated notes are sea water and lavender, positioned as dark and breezy at once. Together the duo covers the two directions most men’s fragrance wardrobes need: one fresh, one intense.

  • Brand: Beardo
  • For: Men
  • Contents: LSD 50ml + Mariner 50ml, both eau de parfum
  • LSD family (brand): Amber, spicy; notes of black currant, litchi, nutmeg and freesia
  • Mariner family (brand): Aromatic, aquatic; notes of sea water and lavender
  • Total quantity: 100ml

Check price on Amazon →  |  Brand: beardo.in

15. Teriaq Intense Eau De Parfum (100ml) — Lattafa

Teriaq Intense is the heavyweight here: a unisex eau de parfum from Dubai house Lattafa. Lattafa’s official shop states the pyramid plainly: bergamot and saffron on top; plum liquor and cinnamon in the middle; and tonka bean, amber and benzoin at the base.

The brand’s supplied description credits master perfumer Quentin Bisch as its creator and calls the fragrance unapologetically unique. On paper and in character it is warm, sweet and spicy, the most opulent profile in this guide, and one to apply sparingly in Indian heat.

  • Brand: Lattafa
  • For: Men and women (unisex)
  • Type: Eau de parfum
  • Size: 100ml
  • Top notes (brand): Bergamot, saffron
  • Heart: Plum liquor, cinnamon
