content.rendered:
Delhi has every kind of astrology practice, from a South Extension institute with its own software and magazine to a Dwarka centre listed only for palm-leaf Nadi readings. This guide profiles 20 of them across the city, covering Vedic astrologers, Lal Kitab and KP practitioners, Vastu consultants, numerologists, tarot readers and teachers, and it was researched afresh in November 2026.

How the list was compiled: each practice’s own website was checked first, and directories were used only to fill gaps. An experience figure is printed only where the practice itself states it on its own website or profiles; directory-only figures are left out, and no fees, ratings or review counts appear anywhere. Where a practice has no verifiable web presence, the profile says so and sticks to listing facts.

A note on expectations: astrology is a belief-based practice. Treat a consultation as guidance and perspective, be wary of anyone who guarantees outcomes or pressures you into expensive remedies, and never delay medical, legal or financial decisions because of a reading.

Quick Answer

  • Deepest stated experience, classical Vedic: Dr. R.P. Sharma, whose own website dates his practice to 1979. He consults online only.
  • An institution rather than an individual: Future Point, led by Dr. Arun Bansal in South Extension, with software, courses, a magazine and consultations under one roof.
  • Nakshatra-level reading: Pt. Ajai Bhambi at Bhikaji Cama Place, with 40 years stated on his own website.
  • A multi-system sitting in North-West Delhi: Dr Nehaa S Gupta (AstroVaani, Prashant Vihar) combines Vedic astrology with KP, Lal Kitab, tarot and numerology.
  • Lal Kitab in East Delhi: Astrologer Pankaj Kumar in Jhilmil Colony.
  • Long written reports: Jyotish Mantra (Dr. Mukesh Gupta, Dwarka) builds 20-year and 30-year Bhrigu and Parashar reports.
  • Vastu-first help: Pradeep Jainee (Vaastu Baba) for consultancy, and the Institute of Vaastu & Joyful Living for consultancy plus courses.
  • A Nadi reading: the Dwarka Sector 6 centre below, which is listing-only, so confirm the details before you travel.

The Systems on Offer in Delhi

  • Vedic (Parashari) astrology reads the birth chart (kundli) with grahas, rashis, nakshatras and dasha periods. It is the base system for most practices on this list and the usual choice for marriage matching and timing questions.
  • KP astrology refines Vedic reading with sub-lords and is often used for pointed, event-specific questions.
  • Lal Kitab works from its own chart logic and is known for simple, low-cost remedies; two East and South Delhi practices here lead with it.
  • Nadi astrology covers the palm-leaf tradition, including the Bhrigu Nandi Nadi method behind Jyotish Mantra’s long reports and the Dwarka centre’s palm-leaf readings.
  • Tarot and numerology do not need a birth chart at all, which makes them the fallback when a birth time is unknown, though several practices here offer birth time rectification instead.
  • Vastu Shastra is about the building, not the person: homes, shops, offices and factories, sometimes corrected without demolition.

Best Astrologer in Delhi — Quick Comparison

Experience below is printed only where the practice states it on its own website or profiles. A dash means no own-stated figure could be verified, not that the practice is new.

Detailed Astrologer Reviews

1. Dr. R.P. Sharma

Locality: Delhi NCR (online only)  |  Experience: 47+ years (stated on his own website)

Quick highlights

  • Astrology type: Vedic astrology (Parashari), with Vastu Shastra among the disciplines his profile lists
  • Method: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra, Lahiri ayanamsha, Vimshottari dasha, divisional charts and transits
  • Specialisations: kundli consultation and matching (guna milan), marriage and relationships, career and business, gemstones and remedies
  • Consultation: online only, by phone, WhatsApp or video, in Hindi and English
  • Free on his website: a kundli, a 90-page PDF report and kundli matching, with no sign-up

Dr Ram Pravesh Sharma is the senior-most name on this list by his own website’s account. The site dates his practice to 1979, more than 47 years, and presents him as a scholar of Phalit Jyotish: an M.A. Acharya in the subject from the Central Sanskrit University, alongside a Ph.D. from the University of Delhi. His readings follow the classical Parashari method.

The practice is entirely online. His website lists consultations on career, marriage, health, education, children, finance, foreign settlement, property and legal questions, plus muhurat and remedial guidance, and states a single flat fee with no per-minute billing. It also says remedies are not turned into a sales pitch: the emphasis is on the chart studied in advance, then your questions answered in the session.

2. Dr. Arun Bansal (Future Point)

Locality: South Extension Part 1, South Delhi  |  Experience: 45+ years (stated on his Future Point profile)

Quick highlights

  • Role: Founder and Chairman of Future Point; President of the All India Federation of Astrologers’ Societies (AIFAS)
  • Astrology type: Vedic astrology and Vastu Shastra
  • Known for: LeoStar, the Vedic astrology software his profile dates to 1978, and 100+ books on astrology and Vastu
  • Consultation: in person at South Extension (there is also a Noida office), online, by phone or by mail
  • Also at the centre: AIFAS courses, the Future Samachar magazine, and a store selling gemstones, Rudraksha and yantras

Future Point is the institutional entry on this list: a South Extension practice that combines personal consultation with software, publishing and teaching. Its own profile describes Dr Arun Bansal as a global consultant for astrology and Vastu Shastra, with an M.Sc. in Physics from Delhi University, an M.Phil in Computer Science from JNU and a Ph.D. in astrology from Mewar University.

Consultations cover horoscope analysis for marriage, career, business, finance, family and health, and Vastu solutions including for shops. The wider centre also offers tarot, numerology and palmistry consultations, personal horoscope reports and online kundli matching. Dr Bansal edits Future Samachar and the Research Journal of Astrology, and the practice runs courses in association with AIFAS.

3. Pt. Ajai Bhambi

Locality: Bhikaji Cama Place, South Delhi  |  Experience: 40 years (stated on his own website)

Quick highlights

  • Astrology type: Vedic astrology, with a specialism in nakshatra work
  • Also known for: Nakshatra Meditation in the Himalayan Tradition, and a dedicated Vaastu practice including a map consultation
  • Background: a post-graduate in Economics and a law graduate who practised law before astrology (publisher and profile sources)
  • Books: Be Your Own Astrologer, Vaastu for You and Your Family, Vedic Sun Signs and Planetary Meditation, among others
  • Consultation: office at Ansal Chamber-II, Bhikaji Cama Place; contact by telephone and email

Pt. Ajai Bhambi’s own website states 40 years of practice, and its signature is depth at the nakshatra level rather than sign-level generalities. The site carries a dedicated Vastu section covering homes, offices, factories, hospitals and temples, plus a map consultation product for people who cannot visit the Bhikaji Cama Place office in person.

His route into astrology was unusual: publisher biographies record a post-graduate degree in Economics and a law degree, with a legal career before he turned to Jyotish full-time. He has written a shelf of books in English and Hindi, and his official channel offers a free magazine, Nakshatra Brahmn, through his website.

4. Ramapada Acharjee

Locality: Rana Pratap Bagh, North Delhi (visiting chamber; main practice in Kolkata)  |  Experience: practising since 1991 (stated on his own website)

Quick highlights

  • Astrology types: Vedic astrology, palmistry, numerology, Vaastu and traditional tantra-related guidance
  • Delhi arrangement: limited in-person appointments by prior confirmation only; his own Delhi page says not to travel without reconfirming, and no walk-ins are promised
  • Specialisations: horoscope reading, career and education, love and marriage including kundali matching, Vaastu for home, office and business
  • Consultation: online by phone or video for Delhi clients, booked in advance
  • Lineage: he traces his teaching to his father, the late Kamakhya Charan Acharjee (his own website)

Ramapada Acharjee is the one entry on this list who is not Delhi-based full-time, and his own website is open about it: the practice is rooted in Kolkata, with a visiting chamber at Rana Pratap Bagh and a strong connection to Kamakhya. His Delhi page puts it plainly: “Since 1991, I have worked with Vedic astrology, palmistry, numerology, Vaastu, and traditional spiritual guidance.”

The booking process is appointment-first: contact by phone, WhatsApp or email, confirm the format, then sit for a phone or video session, with limited in-person slots on his Delhi visits. The same page disavows guaranteed “control over another person” claims, which is a healthy sign in this market. His practice trades as Acharjee Astro-Web Inc.

5. Dr Nehaa S Gupta (AstroVaani)

Locality: Prashant Vihar, North-West Delhi  |  Experience: 20+ years (stated on her own website)

Quick highlights

  • Astrology types: Vedic astrology first, with KP, Lal Kitab, numerology, tarot and Astro-Vastu used according to the concern (her consultation page)
  • Specialisations: kundli analysis and matchmaking, love and marriage, career and business, health and wealth, gemstone recommendations, Vastu for home, shop and office
  • Also offered: birth time rectification, prashna kundli when birth details are unavailable, name suggestions and muhurat
  • Consultation: in person at Prashant Vihar, and online by Zoom or WhatsApp video or audio, 30 to 60 minutes depending on the service
  • Teaching: certified astrology, tarot and numerology courses through the Indian Institute of Astrological Science (her own website)

AstroVaani is the most multi-system practice on this list. Dr Nehaa S Gupta’s consultation page says a sitting primarily follows Vedic astrology and may also draw on KP, Lal Kitab, numerology, tarot and Astro-Vastu. Her website headlines 20+ years of experience and presents her as a doctorate holder and gold medallist in astrology and Vastu; treat those as her own site’s claims.

The practical offer is broad: delayed marriage or childbirth, business decisions, health and wealth questions, and karmic guidance sit alongside standard chart work. Consultations run offline at the Prashant Vihar office and online, and her institute, the Indian Institute of Astrological Science, teaches certified courses in Hindi and English, online and offline.

6. Acharya Girish Bhatt

Locality: Karol Bagh, Delhi  |  Experience: 12+ years (stated on his own website)

Quick highlights

  • Astrology types (his own website): Vedic astrology (Jyotish Shastra), including horoscope analysis, planetary remedies, career guidance and marriage consultation
  • Also offered (his own website): kundli matching, Vastu consultation for homes, offices and shops, palmistry, numerology and spiritual counselling
  • Rituals (his own website): havan, Satyanarayan Katha, Rudrabhishek, Navgrah Shanti and Vastu Shanti poojas, Kaal Sarp, Mangal Dosh and Pitra Dosh nivaran, and Mahamrityunjay Jaap
  • Setting: based at Rajendra Place, by his website, near Rajendra Place Metro Station; his website gives availability of 9 am to 6 pm
  • Contact: +91 99531 23573, published on his website; directory listings also describe consultations in Hindi and English

Acharya Girish Bhatt practises from Karol Bagh in central Delhi. His own website, which could not be read when this guide was first researched, now fills in the picture: it presents him as a spiritual guide and astrology consultant working across Jyotish Shastra, Vastu Shastra, religious rituals and spiritual counselling, on personal, professional, financial and spiritual questions.

The website's emphasis is as much on ceremony as on chart reading. Alongside horoscope analysis and kundli matching, it lists a full round of Vedic poojas, from Rudrabhishek and Navgrah Shanti to dosh nivaran ceremonies, and states 12+ years of experience. Treat the figure and the timings as the practice's own statements, and confirm the service and sitting you need when you call.

7. Astrologer Pankaj Kumar

Locality: Jhilmil Colony, East Delhi

Quick highlights

  • Astrology types (his own website): Lal Kitab, Vastu Shastra, Feng Shui, Pyra Vastu, numerology and gemology, alongside astrology
  • Credential titles claimed on his own website: Jyotish Praveen, Jyotish Visharad, Lal Kitab Maha Guru, Lal Kitab Kulbhushan, Vastu Mahasamrat and Nakshatra Shiromani
  • Services: horoscope calculation, dosha calculation and remedies, predictions with remedies, and answers to specific questions
  • Topics: love and marriage, business, job, child birth, education, health, litigation, property and vehicle
  • Consultation: office hours Monday to Saturday, 11 am to 6 pm (his own website); directory listings also offer phone and video formats

For Lal Kitab in East Delhi, Astrologer Pankaj Kumar is the dedicated name. His own website leads with Lal Kitab and lists a wide supporting toolkit: Vastu Shastra, Feng Shui, Pyra Vastu, numerology and gemology. His IndiaMART profile, where he is listed as a service provider, adds Lal Kitab services, corporate Vastu and astrology books.

The style, by his site’s own account, is research-led: continuous research and experiments on the ancient sciences, presented with reasoning rather than fear. Directory listings such as WeddingWire describe consultations in person, by phone, online and by video, and his Jhilmil Colony office keeps weekday and Saturday hours.

8. Vedic Astrology Solutions (Jaideepji)

Locality: Lajpat Nagar, South Delhi  |  Experience: over 12 years of practice (stated on his own website)

Quick highlights

  • Practitioner: Dr. Jaideep Masand, known as Jaideepji; the sister website trades as Umeed Se Samadhan
  • Astrology types: astrology combined with palmistry and numerology; elemental and remedial astrology
  • Services: a Palm Report covering both palms with remedies, a Palm Match Making Report, and gem and stone recommendations read from the palms
  • Also listed: an extensive Vedic pooja catalogue, including Navgrah Shanti and marriage poojas, performed under his guidelines
  • Consultation: appointments by voice call or WhatsApp; one free query by email with birth details (his own website)

Jaideepji’s own About page says he has practised astrology for over 12 years and had been studying it for longer, having met his guru in southern India 18 years ago and given up an earlier business for this work. He is a prolific writer on his own sites, with 269 blog posts under his name.

What sets the practice apart is the palmistry-led method: predictions combine the chart with palm reading and numerology, Vaastu remedies are assessed from the birth chart rather than from books alone, and gem recommendations are stated to go beyond lagna and rashi. His current research, per the same page, covers the relationship between Vaastu, astrology and sun rays.

9. Jyotish Mantra (Dr. Mukesh Gupta)

Locality: Dwarka Sector 19, West Delhi

Quick highlights

  • Astrology types (his own website): Vedic astrology and Bhrigu Nandi Nadi; Parashar reports using Vimshottari, Ashtottari, Yogini, Kaal Chakra and Char dashas
  • Signature reports: Bhrigu Patrika, a 20-year life report; Parashar Patrika, a 30-year life report with one personal question included
  • Consultations: career, marriage, health, wealth, education, business and relationships, by appointment
  • Delivery: reports sent as PDF by email within 24 to 48 hours (his own website)
  • Teaching: Bhrigu Nandi Nadi videos and an online course on his YouTube channel

Jyotish Mantra is a report-led practice rather than a single-sitting one. Dr. Mukesh Gupta’s website headlines him as a Vedic and Bhrigu Nandi Nadi expert, and its two flagship products are long-horizon documents: the Bhrigu Patrika covers 20 years, with monthly predictions for the first two, and the Parashar Patrika covers 30 years. The Bhrigu report also folds in a numerology report and gemstone and Rudraksh recommendations.

Personal consultations are by appointment at Dwarka and cover the standard life topics, while directory listings also tag the practice for kundali matching. If you prefer reading and re-reading a written analysis to a conversation, this is the format built for you.

10. Astrologer Kamna Jyotish Kendra

Locality: Connaught Place, Central Delhi

Quick highlights

  • Head: Pandit Krishna Sharma (Google business profile)
  • Astrology types (its own website, in Hindi): Vedic astrology, numerology, palmistry and kundali reading; the Google profile adds Vastu Shastra
  • Services: career, business, finance, love and relationships, marriage compatibility, health and spiritual balance, with remedies, muhurat and compatibility checks
  • Setting: Office 30-B, Hanuman Mandir Complex, near the Prachin Hanuman Mandir, Connaught Place, an address Google, Justdial and Shuru all give
  • Also stated on its website: workshops, seminars and articles sharing astrological knowledge

Kamna Jyotish Kendra is a temple-complex practice in the centre of the city, a short walk from the Connaught Place circle. Its own Hindi website states Vedic astrology, numerology, palmistry and kundali reading, and describes personalised consultations aimed at clarity and balance across career, business, finance, relationships, marriage and health.

Directory listings add kundali matching and rituals such as havan and kaal sarp to the picture, and the practice is office-based: you book an appointment and visit. Because its own website is in Hindi and states no experience figure, this profile sticks to the systems and services the kendra itself publishes.

11. Pradeep Jainee (Vaastu Baba)

Locality: Connaught Place, Central Delhi

Quick highlights

  • Specialism: Vastu Shastra and numerology, with business and corporate Vastu named as his speciality on his own website
  • Methods (his own website): Pyramid Vastu and therapy, geopathic therapy, colour therapy, energy balancing and aura scanning
  • Services: residential, office, industrial and health Vastu, by site visit and supervision or from a floor-plan map
  • Consultation: in person, by phone, and online with the floor plan submitted in advance; video call on WhatsApp (his own website)
  • Also runs: one-day Vastu workshops under the Vaastu Baba banner

Pradeep Jainee, known as Vaastu Baba, is the Vastu-first entry in central Delhi: his website promises a “one stop solution for your complete Vastu and numerology needs” and gives the same Connaught Place address, in the Regal area, in every page footer. The client base he describes is heavily commercial: businesses, real estate, hotels, doctors, industries and startups.

The toolkit goes beyond compass directions. His site lists Pyramid Vaastu, geopathic stress work, colour therapy and aura scanning among its methods, with a stated “zero superstition” policy. Consultations can be a supervised site visit, a map-based reading from your floor plan, or an online session, which makes the practice usable well beyond Delhi.

12. Raja Sachdeva Astrologer

Locality: Rohini Sector 7, North-West Delhi  |  Experience: practising since 1999 (stated on his own profiles)

Quick highlights

  • Roles (his own social profiles): astrologer, Vastu consultant, numerologist, gemologist and palmist
  • Services: kundali matching and Vastu consultation (directory tags); gemstones are supplied by the practice (his own channel)
  • Presence: rashifal and remedy videos under one handle, @rajasachdevaofficial, across Instagram, Facebook and YouTube; no official website
  • Consultation: appointments by call or WhatsApp (his own profiles), with a Rohini office
  • Family line: son of Kewal Krishan Sachdeva, described in his profiles as a famous palmist

Raja Sachdeva runs a social-first practice in Rohini: there is no official website, and the public face is a single handle publishing zodiac forecasts and remedy videos across three platforms. His own profiles date the practice to 1999 and describe him as an astrologer, Vastu consultant, numerologist, gemologist and palmist.

Directory listings add kundali matching and Vastu consultation as the bookable services, and his channel states that gemstones are available through the practice. Appointments are arranged by call or WhatsApp. Because there is no website, verify the current service list with him directly; this profile relies on his own profiles and directory tags, and says so.

13. Astro Aastha

Locality: Delhi (online consultations)  |  Experience: 5 years of practice (stated on her own website)

Quick highlights

  • Astrology types (her own website): Vedic astrology, numerology, Vastu and Lal Kitab remedies
  • Services: a private Jyotish (birth-chart) consultation, Kundali Milan read across both charts, gemstone consultation, and a Vastu consultation read room by room
  • Also offered: couples consultations and a crystal consultation held as a WhatsApp chat session
  • Consultation: online, booked through her website link, Instagram DM, WhatsApp or email; her site states a birth time is needed for a full reading
  • Approach (her BrilliantRead interview): she calls herself a "new-age Vedic astrologer", blending Vedic astrology with psychology, healing and self-awareness, and keeps remedies simple and practical
  • Reach: clients across more than six countries (her own website's FAQ)

Astro Aastha is an online-only practice run by Aastha Diwan, who describes herself on her booking page as an astrologer, numerologist and healer based in Delhi, with five years of practice in Vedic astrology. Diwan is the full name she gives in her BrilliantRead interview. The offer is tightly defined: chart readings, compatibility work, gemstone and Vastu consultations, with a limited number of slots each week.

One caution, re-checked for this update in November 2026: a Justdial listing under the same name gives a Rohini Sector 16 address and a different experience figure, and nothing found in either research pass confirms the two are the same practice. Her own profiles make no mention of a Rohini office, and the listing does not link to her website. This profile therefore continues to follow the practice's own website, astroaastha.in, and leaves the listing aside.

14. Paras Parivaar

Locality: Netaji Subhash Place, Pitampura, North-West Delhi

Quick highlights

  • Nature: a charitable and spiritual organisation (Paras Parivaar Charitable Trust) led by Mahant Shri Paras Bhai Ji, not a conventional astrology clinic
  • Astrology offered (its directory listing): janma kundali readings, kundali matching, and guidance on career, education, business, finance, love, marriage and health
  • Wider work stated by the organisation: prarthna sabha gatherings, Dukhnivaran Mahachandi Path, langar and cow service
  • Address: Aggarwal Millennium Tower-1, Netaji Subhash Place Complex, Pitampura, the registered address company records also give

Paras Parivaar is included because Delhi residents do consult it for kundali guidance, but it should be understood for what it is: a spiritual and charitable organisation led by Mahant Shri Paras Bhai Ji, whom its directory listing describes as an astrologer and spiritual leader. The astrology sits inside a wider structure of prayer gatherings and charitable work.

The organisation’s own profiles say it works 365 days a year and claim it has helped more than ten lakh needy people; those are the organisation’s own figures. No astrology system or experience figure is stated in any source found, so none is printed here, and the service detail above comes from its directory listing rather than an own services page.

15. Institute of Vaastu & Joyful Living

Locality: Saraswati Vihar, Pitampura, North-West Delhi

Quick highlights

  • Founder-President: Pt. Gopal Sharma, an engineering graduate of 1973 from Delhi College of Engineering (the institute’s website)
  • Consultancy (its own website): Vaastu, astrology, numerology, Feng Shui, Pyra-Vaastu, map and horoscope analysis, palmistry and gem therapy, including Vaastu correction without demolition
  • Education: courses certified by the All India Federation of Astrologers’ Societies (AIFAS), from a two-month Vaastu certificate to the Jyotish Ratan to Maharishi ladder
  • Books and media: 42 bestselling books credited to Pt. Sharma, and a doctorate in Vaastu Science from the Open University at Sri Lanka (the institute’s website)
  • Consultation: by email, telephone or on-site visit, by prior appointment only

The Institute of Vaastu & Joyful Living is the education-led entry on this list. Alongside consultancy from its Saraswati Vihar headquarters, it teaches structured courses in Vaastu, astrology, numerology and palmistry, in regular classes at the institute and by correspondence over email or courier, with AIFAS certification behind the ladder of qualifications.

Its founder’s profile is distinctive: an engineer who came to Vaastu from a technical background, credited on the institute’s site with 42 bestselling books in four languages and consultancy through radio and television, including Doordarshan and Zee TV. The same site says he was consulted by the Government of U.P. for planning Tronica City; that is the institute’s own claim, presented as such.

16. Dr Vivek Chopra

Locality: West Patel Nagar, West Delhi  |  Experience: 47 years (stated on his own website)

Quick highlights

  • Practice: founder of Astro Vastu World; styled “Ph.D. – Gold Medalist” on his own channels
  • Systems (his services page): Vedic astrology, palmistry, numerology, Vastu Shastra, crystals and gemstones, and holistic healing
  • Vastu method: observation over house visits before suggesting changes (his own website)
  • Gemstones named on his website: ruby, pearl, coral, emerald, yellow sapphire and diamond
  • Consultation: appointments through his website; his homepage says he has served people worldwide

Dr Vivek Chopra’s own homepage states 47 years of experience providing astrology and Vastu services, and the practice, Astro Vastu World, works from West Patel Nagar near the Patel Nagar Metro station. The services page is broad: Vedic astrology, palmistry, numerology and Vastu sit alongside gemstones and holistic healing.

His Vastu approach, as his site describes it, is observational: it may take a few house visits to study the positioning of everything before amendments are suggested. His homepage also names film personalities among those who have consulted him; that is the practice’s own claim, and directory listings give a shorter experience figure, so the 47 years printed here is specifically his website’s account.

17. Jyotish Disha

Locality: Lajpat Nagar 1, South Delhi

Quick highlights

  • Known from: Justdial listings only; no official website was found for this practice (checked November 2026, and re-checked for this update)
  • Directory categories (Justdial): palmistry, numerology, face reading and computerised horoscope services, with a Vastu consultation tag
  • Setting: a walk-in premises on Service Lane, Lajpat Nagar 1; listings give hours of 10 am to 7 pm

Jyotish Disha remains the thinnest verifiable entry on this list. It appears in Justdial's South Delhi categories for palmistry, numerology, face reading and computerised horoscopes from a Service Lane address in Lajpat Nagar 1, but no website, named astrologer or stated system could be verified for it in either research pass. Verified detail is limited: treat the listing as a starting point, and confirm who you will see and what they practise before you pay for a sitting. It should not be confused with similarly named centres in Badarpur, Ghaziabad or Faridabad.

18. Astro Namami Om

Locality: Mangal Bazar, Laxmi Nagar, East Delhi

Quick highlights

  • Known from: Justdial listings only, which Justdial marks as verified; no official website was found for this practice (checked November 2026, and re-checked for this update)
  • Directory categories (Justdial): Vedic and spiritual astrology, numerology, kundali matching, palmistry and remedy astrology
  • Directory filing also places it under: astrologers on phone and online astrologers
  • Setting: premises at Mangal Bazar, Laxmi Nagar; listings give hours of 10 am to 8 pm

Astro Namami Om is a Laxmi Nagar practice known only through its directory presence. Justdial files it across Vedic, spiritual, numerology, kundali matching and palmistry categories at Mangal Bazar, and marks the listing verified, but no website, named astrologer or own statement of services could be found for this guide in either research pass. Verified detail remains limited, so ask the practice directly about its systems and consultation formats before booking. A similarly named Namami Astro in Lucknow is a different practice.

19. Shukracharya Astro Pvt Ltd

Locality: Laxmi Nagar, East Delhi  |  Experience: working in astrology since 1988 (stated on its own website)

Quick highlights

  • Founder: Dr. R. B. Dhawan (Guruji), founder-director of the Shukracharya group; the Shukracharya Astrological Research Center (SARC) was formed in 1995 (its own website)
  • Systems taught and practised (its own website): Vedic (Parashar) astrology, numerology, Vaastu Shastra, palmistry and Lal Kitab
  • Courses: certificate to research level, including Jyotish Daivagya and Hastrekha Acharya, in regular, weekend, correspondence and online modes
  • Consultancy: topic-wise horoscope reports, including marriage prospects, compatibility, career, education, business and finance, delivered as PDF or printed reports
  • Publishing: editor of the monthly magazines Aap Ka Bhavishyaa and Tantra Darshan; author of books including Vastu Sutra, Parashar Sutra and LalKitab – Yog evam Upaya

Shukracharya Astro is primarily an institute: from Laxmi Nagar it has run courses in astrology, palmistry, numerology, Vaastu and Lal Kitab since the research centre was formed in 1995, and its website says its founder has worked in astrology since 1988 and taught more than 1,000 students. His own-stated qualifications include an Ayurveda Ratna and a degree in astrology and numerology from Lal Bahadur Shastri Vidyapeeth.

The consultancy side is report-based: you choose a topic, from marriage prospects to a single set of questions, and receive a written report with remedies drawn from Vedic, numerology, Vaastu or palmistry methods. For a Delhi learner rather than a one-off client, this is one of only two full teaching institutes on the list.

20. Shri Agasthiya Maha Shiva Ganitha Nadi Jyothidham

Locality: Dwarka Sector 6, West Delhi

Quick highlights

  • Known from: Justdial listings only, which Justdial marks as verified; no official website was found for this centre (checked November 2026, and re-checked for this update)
  • Specialism (directory category): Nadi astrology, the palm-leaf tradition; also filed under Tamil astrologers and pandits, and under astrologers on phone (Justdial)
  • Setting: DDA Flats Pocket 2, Dwarka Sector 6; listings give long hours, from 7 am to about 9 pm
  • Note: several Delhi centres use similar Agasthiya names; this entry covers only the Dwarka Sector 6 listing

This Dwarka centre is the list's dedicated Nadi address, offering palm-leaf readings in West Delhi according to its directory categorisation. Beyond that, verified detail remains limited: no website, named reader or own statement of how readings are conducted could be found in either research pass, and centres with similar names elsewhere, including websites run from Vaitheeswaran Koil and other Delhi listings in Tilak Nagar and West Patel Nagar, are different practices whose details should not be assumed to apply here. Confirm the reader, the format and what a reading involves with the centre before you travel.

How to Choose and Verify an Astrologer in Delhi

  • Start with the practice’s own website or profiles. Eleven of the twenty practices here publish their own systems and services. Where a name exists only as a directory listing, as with Jyotish Disha and Astro Namami Om, treat the listing as a lead, not a profile, and ask the questions below before paying.
  • Count experience only when the practice states it. Directories print figures that often differ from the practice’s own. This guide prints a figure only where the practice itself states it, and leaves the space blank otherwise.
  • Match the system to the question. Kundli and Vedic work suits marriage matching, dasha timing and career direction. Lal Kitab and KP answer pointed questions differently. Nadi is its own tradition, tarot and numerology need no birth chart, and Vastu questions are about the building, not the person.
  • Have your details ready. A full chart reading needs your date, exact time and place of birth. If the time is uncertain, ask about birth time rectification or a prashna chart before the sitting, not after.
  • Agree the format in advance. A live session, a WhatsApp chat and a 30-year written report are different products at different prices. Ask what you will receive, in what form, and by when.
  • Walk away from guarantees and pressure. No practitioner can guarantee an outcome. Be especially wary of fear-based selling that turns a reading into a sequence of expensive remedies, gems or rituals.
  • Confirm the venue for visiting practices. One entry here consults in Delhi only on visits and asks clients to reconfirm the venue first. A two-minute message before travelling saves a wasted trip.

FAQs

Who is the best astrologer in Delhi for kundali matching?

Several practices on this list state matching explicitly: Dr. R.P. Sharma offers guna milan online, Future Point offers online kundli matching, AstroVaani covers matchmaking in its consultation list, and Kamna Jyotish Kendra and Paras Parivaar list it among their services. Choose by the system you trust and whether you want the sitting online, in person or as a written report.

How much does an astrologer in Delhi charge?

Fees vary widely by format, from a single online question to a 30-year written report, and practices change them without notice, so this guide prints none. Check the practice’s own website or ask when you book, and agree the full cost, including any remedies suggested, before the consultation starts.

Are online consultations with Delhi astrologers reliable?

The mode does not change the method: the same chart is read on a video call as across a desk. What matters is what the practice states and delivers. Dr. R.P. Sharma works online only, Astro Aastha is online-only, and Jyotish Mantra’s work is mostly written reports by email. Ask what details they need and what you will receive in writing.

Which astrologer in Delhi is best for Vastu?

For Vastu as the main subject, Pradeep Jainee (Vaastu Baba) and the Institute of Vaastu & Joyful Living lead with it, and the institute adds courses. Dr. Arun Bansal and Dr Vivek Chopra combine Vastu with chart work, while Astro Aastha reads a home or workplace room by room. For a factory, office or shop, ask specifically about commercial Vastu experience.

What details do I need for a kundli reading in Delhi?

Your date of birth, the most exact birth time you can get, and your place of birth. The time sets the lagna, so an approximate time weakens the reading. If the time is unknown, ask about birth time rectification, which Dr. R.P. Sharma and AstroVaani both mention, or a prashna kundli, which AstroVaani offers for questions without birth details.

title.rendered: Top 20 Event Management Companies in Chandigarh for Weddings, Corporate Events and Concerts

content.rendered:
Chandigarh hosts everything from multi-day Punjabi weddings and corporate conferences to concerts, exhibitions and product launches, and the city has a deep bench of event management companies to run them. This guide profiles 20 of them, from MICE and brand-activation specialists to luxury wedding planners and birthday-party decorators, so you can match the company to the kind of event you are planning.

Every profile below was rebuilt from fresh research carried out in November 2026, using each company’s own website first and reputable directories such as WedMeGood and WeddingWire second. Where a company publishes little verifiable information, the profile says so plainly instead of repeating old claims.

Quick Answer: Best Event Management Companies in Chandigarh

  • For corporate events, MICE and brand work: Frigus Events and Marketing and Gravity Event Services both build their offer around conferences, activations, artist management and multi-city execution.
  • For luxury and destination weddings: Shaandaar Events, Weddings n Beyond and NupKnots publish the deepest destination-wedding detail, covering Jaipur, Udaipur, Goa and the Himachal hill towns.
  • For full-service weddings in the Tricity: TCC – The Celebration Company, Kreative Events, Event Casters (now House of Lagan) and Concept Booster all cover planning, decor, catering coordination and guest management.
  • For decor-led and smaller celebrations: Event Decor & Planners and Expert Organisers specialise in themed decor for birthdays, anniversaries and family functions.
  • For parties and artist bookings: Event Casters also lists concerts, fests and DJ booking, while Invincible’z built its name on Chandigarh nightlife and artist management.

What Chandigarh Event Companies Actually Do

The 20 companies on this list fall into three broad groups, and knowing which group you need saves most of the shortlisting work:

  • Full-service event firms (for example Frigus and Gravity) plan and produce corporate and social events end to end: concept, venue, production, branding, artists, hospitality and on-day execution.
  • Wedding planners (the majority of this list) focus on wedding functions: venue booking, decor, catering coordination, entertainment, guest logistics and ritual-by-ritual flow across several days.
  • Decor and party specialists (Event Decor & Planners, Expert Organisers) sell design and decoration first, with entertainment and catering arranged around the theme.

Most Chandigarh planners work across the Tricity of Chandigarh, Mohali and Panchkula without charging extra travel, and the larger wedding names also travel to Kasauli, Shimla and the Rajasthan palace destinations. Always confirm the service area in writing before you sign.

Quick Comparison: Event Management Companies in Chandigarh

Fees in the last column are the starting planning fees the named directory currently publishes for that company; they are not quotes. Most Chandigarh planners charge a fixed planning fee and then bill vendors at cost or on a package, so confirm the full structure before booking.

Detailed Profiles of Event Management Companies in Chandigarh

1. Frigus Events and Marketing

Locality: Chandigarh (head office) | Focus: MICE, concerts, exhibitions and brand activations | Website: frigusevents.com

Frigus is the most corporate-facing name on this list. Its own website says the company was incepted in 2016 and is headquartered in Chandigarh, and the service list leans towards brand work: MICE, exhibitions, product launches, brand activations, sponsorships, branding and fabrication, and 360-degree event production.

Alongside the corporate work, Frigus lists concerts, artist management, fashion shows, stand-up and plays, movie PR and premieres, sports events such as cyclothons and road rallies, and concept destination events. The company says it works through liaison offices and a partner network beyond Chandigarh, which suits brands running the same activation in several cities.

Key facts:

  • Incepted in 2016, according to the company website
  • Founder and managing director: Prikshit Sharma (company website)
  • Core services listed by the company: MICE, concerts, artist management, brand activation, exhibitions and product launches
  • Also listed: movie PR and premieres, sponsorships, sports events and destination events
  • Google listing categories: event planner, marketing agency and advertising

2. Gravity Event Services

Locality: Chandigarh | Focus: Corporate events, branding and artist management | Branches: Delhi and Gurugram | Website: gravityeventservices.com

Gravity Event Services describes itself as a full-service event management firm based in Chandigarh, with branch offices in Delhi and Gurugram. Its published services cover event creation and execution, outdoor branding and marketing, artist and manpower management, media coverage and press releases, decor arrangement and hospitality management.

That mix makes Gravity a natural shortlist pick for conferences, dealer meets, annual days and brand events rather than weddings. On its own About page the company states figures of 87 satisfied clients, 650 completed projects and more than 10,000 event attendees managed; treat those as company-stated numbers rather than independently audited ones.

Key facts:

  • Full-service event management firm based in Chandigarh (company website)
  • Branch offices in Delhi and Gurugram (company website)
  • Services: event execution, outdoor branding, artist and manpower management, media coverage, decor and hospitality
  • Company-stated track record: 87 clients, 650 projects, 10,000+ attendees
  • Chandigarh listing address: First Floor, Plot No. 91

3. Event Casters

Locality: Industrial Area Phase 1, Chandigarh | Focus: Weddings, concerts, fests and artist & DJ booking | Website: theeventcasters.com

Event Casters now trades on WedMeGood as House of Lagan by Event Casters. The WedMeGood profile places it in Industrial Area Phase 1, says the team has been planning since 2012 and is led by Gagan, and lists wedding planning, event management and decorator services, with destination weddings as a specialism.

The company’s other face is live entertainment: its Google listing describes Chandigarh event planners for concerts, fests, artist and DJ booking, and club and corporate events. WedMeGood lists weddings planned across the Tricity and in Solan, Shimla, Kasauli, Ludhiana, Amritsar, Jaipur, Udaipur and Jaisalmer, with a published starting price of ₹4,00,000.

Key facts:

  • Now listed on WedMeGood as House of Lagan by Event Casters
  • Planning since 2012 and led by Gagan (WedMeGood profile)
  • Services: wedding planning, event management, in-house and outside decorators
  • Also listed for concerts, fests, artist and DJ booking, club and corporate events
  • WedMeGood starting price: ₹4,00,000; destination weddings a stated specialism

4. Shaandaar Events

Locality: Industrial Area Phase II, Chandigarh | Focus: Luxury and destination weddings | Website: shaandaarevents.com

Shaandaar Events is Chandigarh’s luxury wedding specialist. The company says it was founded in Chandigarh in 2018 by Karan Bains and has planned and executed more than 100 weddings, and it deliberately limits itself to 20 to 25 weddings a year so each celebration gets a dedicated team.

From its head office at Plot No. 177, Industrial Area Phase II, the company runs destination weddings in Jaipur, Udaipur, Goa, Kerala, Shimla and Mussoorie, and its own blog also names international destinations such as Dubai, Bali and the Maldives. Services run from venue selection and decor design to vendor coordination, hospitality, logistics and on-ground execution, with a large share of NRI clients planning from abroad.

Key facts:

  • Founded in Chandigarh in 2018 by Karan Bains (company website)
  • Company-stated: 100+ weddings planned; takes on 20–25 weddings a year
  • Head office: Plot No. 177, Industrial Area Phase II, Chandigarh
  • WeddingWire profile lists Best Wedding Planner 2025 (WeddingSutra) and Best Wedding Planner 2024 (The New Indian Express)
  • WeddingWire lists its fixed planning fee at ₹5,00,000 and above

5. TCC – The Celebration Company

Locality: Sector 9-C, Madhya Marg, Chandigarh | Focus: Weddings, social and corporate events | Website: tccevents.in

TCC, short for The Celebration Company, is a unit of Mums Mall and one of the longest-running names on this list: its website says founder Tanu Mehtani started the company about two decades ago. It works from SCO 149-150 on Madhya Marg in Sector 9-C, a central address for client meetings.

The published service list is broad: wedding planning and decor, wedding stationery, gift hampers, hospitality, logistics, entertainment, artist management and catering, plus birthday parties, baby showers, corporate events, theme parties, festival events and destination weddings. That breadth suits families who want one team to handle several functions across a wedding week and the smaller celebrations around it.

Key facts:

  • Unit of Mums Mall; founded by Tanu Mehtani about two decades ago (company website)
  • Address: SCO 149-150, Sector 9-C, Madhya Marg, Chandigarh
  • Services include wedding planning, decor, stationery, gift hampers, hospitality, logistics and catering
  • Also covers birthdays, baby showers, corporate events, theme parties and destination weddings
  • Website: tccevents.in

6. Kreative Events

Locality: Industrial Area Phase 2, Chandigarh | Focus: Weddings, corporate gatherings and social events | Website: thekreativeevents.com

Kreative Events is a full-service planner based at 28/1, Industrial Area Phase 2. Its own description presents it as a one-stop shop for weddings and other events, with in-trend decor as a calling card and dedicated specialists for each part of the event.

The published service list covers venue booking, decor management, catering management, invitations, guest management, entertainment, choreographers and light and sound. The team also lists destination weddings in India and abroad, naming Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Hua Hin, Phuket, Goa, Kerala, Jaipur, Udaipur and the Himachal towns among the places it has worked.

Key facts:

  • Based at 28/1, Industrial Area Phase 2, Chandigarh
  • Full-service offer: weddings, corporate gatherings and social events
  • Services: venue booking, decor, catering management, invitations, guest management, entertainment, choreographers, light and sound
  • Destination weddings listed for the UAE, Thailand, Goa, Kerala, Rajasthan and Himachal Pradesh
  • WedMeGood carried 64 reviews with a 4.9 rating when checked in November 2026

7. The RSVP Celebrations

Locality: Industrial Area Phase 2, Chandigarh | Focus: Luxury, destination and intimate weddings | Website: thersvpcelebrations.com

The RSVP Celebrations is a wedding planning service listed at Plot No. 337, Phase 2, Industrial Area, Chandigarh. Its own website says it specialises in luxury weddings, destination weddings, intimate celebrations and grand multi-day festivities, designing bespoke celebrations around each couple’s personality, traditions and love story.

The site lists wedding design and decor, venue sourcing, vendor management, guest hospitality, transportation, entertainment and production, and names palace, hotel and outdoor settings. It publishes no founding year, team names or wedding count, so ask for recent Tricity references and a written breakdown of what the planning fee covers.

Key facts:

  • Listed address: Plot No. 337, Phase 2, Industrial Area, Chandigarh
  • Listed categories: wedding planning service; also party and entertainment service
  • Contact phone published on its listing: +917966966264
  • Own website: thersvpcelebrations.com
  • Specialisms stated on its own website: luxury weddings, destination weddings, intimate celebrations and multi-day festivities
  • Services stated on its own website: wedding design and decor, venue sourcing, vendor management, guest hospitality, transportation, entertainment and production
  • No founding year, team names or events count published on its website; no WedMeGood or WeddingWire profile found

8. Concept Booster

Locality: Industrial Area Phase 1, Chandigarh | Focus: Wedding planning and decor | Website: conceptbooster.in

Concept Booster is an event management company in Industrial Area Phase 1 whose WeddingWire profile focuses on weddings. The profile says its planners look after arrangements from decor to catering and transport, and that packages can be customised to the couple’s preferences and budget.

WeddingWire lists its service set as vendor management, event flow management, decor planning and execution, guest management, and entertainment design and choreography, with a planning fee starting from ₹50,000, the lowest published starting fee on this list. That makes it worth a conversation for couples who want professional coordination without a luxury-tier fee.

Key facts:

  • Based in Industrial Area Phase 1, Chandigarh (WeddingWire profile)
  • Services: vendor management, event flow management, decor planning and execution, guest management
  • Also listed: entertainment design and choreography, transport arrangements
  • WeddingWire lists a planning fee from ₹50,000
  • Website: conceptbooster.in

9. Event Decor & Planners

Locality: Industrial Area Phase II, Chandigarh | Focus: Party and event decor

Event Decor & Planners does what the name says: it is a decor-first team at Plot No. 68, Ground Floor, opposite Harmony Honda in Industrial Area Phase II. Its own site describes a team of trained professionals specialising in planning, decorating and managing events.

The published specialisms are celebrations rather than conferences: birthday parties, theme parties, anniversary celebrations, festive decor, baby showers, surprise decor and retirement parties. If your event is a family function in the Tricity and the look matters more than full-scale production, this is the shape of vendor to call.

Key facts:

  • Address: Plot No. 68, Ground Floor, opposite Harmony Honda, Industrial Area Phase II, Chandigarh
  • Specialises in planning, decorating and managing events (company website)
  • Published services: birthdays, theme parties, anniversaries, festive decor, baby showers, surprise decor, retirement parties
  • Decor-led offer rather than full corporate production

10. Expert Organisers

Locality: Main Road, Chandigarh | Focus: Themed birthday parties and party entertainment | Website: expertorganisers.com

Expert Organisers is Chandigarh’s birthday-party specialist. From Shop No. 164 on Main Road, above Vishwakarma Ply Palace, the company builds children’s parties around themes: its own material lists cartoon, jungle, castle, princess, butterfly, fairy, teddy and character themes, among many others.

Around the theme it supplies entrance and cake-station decor, balloon and helium decor, cut-outs and table dressing, and entertainment such as DJs, magic and puppet shows, anchors, dance groups, live characters and bouncy castles, plus games and catering stalls from candy floss to chocolate fountains. It is also listed as a wedding planning service, but birthdays are clearly the core trade.

Key facts:

  • Address: Shop No. 164, 1st Floor, Main Road, above Vishwakarma Ply Palace, Chandigarh
  • Core specialism: themed birthday parties for children
  • Decor offered: entrance, cake station, balloon, helium and foil, cut-outs, table decor, tent decoration
  • Entertainment offered: DJ, magic shows, puppet shows, anchors, dance groups, live characters, games
  • Website: expertorganisers.com

11. Invincible’z Event & Artist Management

Locality: Industrial Area, Chandigarh | Focus: Artist management and nightlife events

Invincible’z is one of the older nightlife names in Chandigarh. In December 2009 The Tribune named Saurabh Aggarwal as managing director of Invincible’z Entertainment and quoted his Christmas and New Year plans: roping in Mumbai’s DJ Tejas or DJ Spin Twin for 24 December, and a lavish New Year’s Eve bash at the Piccadily Hotel on a cowboy and Mexican theme.

The Indian Express reported the same month that the company was involved in promoting the Down Gate Party Lounge in Panchkula, whose planned events were to bring in celebrities from across the country. Today it is listed in the MW market, Industrial Area, Chandigarh, as an event planner, but no own website or recent coverage could be verified, so confirm its current roster directly.

Key facts:

  • Listed in the MW market, Industrial Area, Chandigarh, as an event planner
  • Contact phone published on its listing: +919988428009
  • Managing director named in 2009 press coverage: Saurabh Aggarwal
  • December 2009 Tribune report: Mumbai DJ bookings for Christmas Eve and a themed New Year’s Eve bash at the Piccadily Hotel
  • Historically known for DJ bookings, Christmas and New Year parties and club promotions (2009 press)
  • No own website, social page or recent event coverage found; current verified public detail is limited

12. Rustic Wedding Vows

Locality: Chandigarh | Focus: Wedding planning

Rustic Wedding Vows appears in Chandigarh wedding-planning listings, but fresh research for this guide could not find a working official website or a verifiable directory profile for the business under this name, so verified detail is limited.

The name suggests a rustic-themed wedding focus, but that is an inference from the name rather than a published fact, and we have not repeated any of the older article’s claims about the company. If you are considering it, verify the business in person: ask for its registered name, recent weddings and client references before paying any advance.

Key facts:

  • Appears in Chandigarh wedding-planning listings
  • No verifiable official website or directory profile found in November 2026 research
  • Verified detail is limited; check registration, portfolio and references directly

13. Eraya Events

Locality: Chandigarh | Focus: Weddings and destination weddings

Eraya Events is a Chandigarh wedding planner whose WedMeGood reviews give a clear picture of how it works. Reviewers name Siya as the lead planner and describe a team structure with dedicated decor planning, RSVP and hospitality teams, and help with invites, guest coordination, accommodation and travel.

The same reviews credit Eraya with destination weddings in Kasauli and at Chail Palace in Himachal Pradesh, including a wedding planned for a couple organising from the United States, and with decor and coordination for Chandigarh hotel weddings. It reads as a hands-on, mid-sized team rather than a large production house.

Key facts:

  • Chandigarh wedding planner listed on WedMeGood
  • Lead planner named in reviews: Siya
  • Reviewers credit dedicated decor, RSVP and hospitality teams
  • Destination weddings in Kasauli and at Chail Palace, Himachal Pradesh (WedMeGood reviews)
  • Services mentioned by clients: invites, guest coordination, accommodation and logistics

14. The Wedding Affair

Locality: Chandigarh | Focus: Wedding planning

The Wedding Affair is named in Chandigarh wedding-planning contexts, but fresh research could not verify a distinct Chandigarh planning company under this exact name: the best-known business called Wedding Affair is a Delhi-based wedding magazine and app, which is a different operation.

Because of that name clash, verified detail for a Chandigarh planner trading as The Wedding Affair is limited, and we have not carried over any claims from the older version of this article. If a planner offers you this name, confirm its Chandigarh address, registration and recent local weddings before you rely on it.

Key facts:

  • Name appears in Chandigarh wedding-planning contexts
  • No distinct Chandigarh company verifiable under this name in November 2026 research
  • Not to be confused with the Delhi-based Wedding Affair magazine and app
  • Verified detail is limited; verify identity and portfolio directly

15. WOWsters Planners

Locality: Sector 34-A, Chandigarh | Focus: Wedding planning and decor

WOWsters Planners is led by Chandni, whose name runs through its WedMeGood reviews: couples credit her team with running full wedding weeks, from shagun, mehndi and haldi through cocktail and the wedding day, including decor, food, accommodation and guest services.

WeddingWire places the office at SCO 80-81-82, Top Floor, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh, with prices starting at ₹2,00,000. Reviewers also describe a three-day wedding at WelcomeHeritage Parv Vilas in Kasauli assembled in about ten days, which suggests a team comfortable with short timelines and hill-station logistics.

Key facts:

  • Led by Chandni (WedMeGood reviews)
  • Office: SCO 80-81-82, Top Floor, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh (WeddingWire)
  • Covers full wedding weeks: shagun, mehndi, haldi, cocktail and wedding functions
  • WeddingWire lists prices starting at ₹2,00,000
  • WedMeGood carried 18 reviews at 5.0 when checked in November 2026

16. A2Zee Events

Locality: Industrial Area Phase 2, Chandigarh | Focus: Wedding planning

A2Zee Events is a Chandigarh wedding planning company listed near Tribune Chowk, at 24/8, Industrial Area Phase 2, behind the Altius Hotel. WeddingWire places it in Sector 18, Chandigarh City, and its description there presents a team of passionate, creative professionals who handle a wedding from start to finish for a stress-free execution.

The listing publishes a contact phone, +917508299007, which does not match the Kolkata firm’s published numbers, and no own website or social profile for the Chandigarh firm could be verified. Public detail beyond the directory presence is limited, so ask A2Zee directly for recent Tricity weddings and references when you shortlist it.

Key facts:

  • Listed address: 24/8, Industrial Area Phase 2, behind Altius Hotel, near Tribune Chowk, Chandigarh
  • WeddingWire lists it among Chandigarh wedding planners, placed in Sector 18, Chandigarh City
  • Contact phone published on its listing: +917508299007
  • Described on WeddingWire as handling weddings from start to finish
  • No own website or social profile found; verified public detail is limited
  • Not the Kolkata firm of a similar name; its published phone numbers differ

17. Weddings n Beyond

Locality: Industrial Area Phase 2, Chandigarh | Focus: Weddings and destination weddings | Website presence: WedMeGood and WeddingWire profiles

Weddings n Beyond works from Plot No. 984, First Floor, Industrial Area Phase 2, Chandigarh, and keeps a second office in Jim Corbett, which explains its strength in hill destination weddings. WedMeGood says the team has been planning since 2016 and charges a fixed planning fee, with a published starting price of ₹2,50,000.

Its WedMeGood profile lists weddings planned across the Tricity and in Kasauli, Jim Corbett, Ramnagar, Nainital, Shimla, Solan, Jaipur, Pushkar, Udaipur, Manali, Amritsar and beyond. Listed services include venue selection and booking, end-to-end planning, decor, furniture and props, audio-visual set-up and wedding assistants for the family.

Key facts:

  • Offices in Chandigarh (Industrial Area Phase 2) and Jim Corbett (WedMeGood)
  • Planning since 2016 (WedMeGood profile)
  • WedMeGood starting price: ₹2,50,000; fixed planning fee
  • Services: venue selection and booking, end-to-end planning, decor, furniture and props, audio-visual set-up
  • Destination experience listed across Himachal, Uttarakhand and Rajasthan

18. Rudra Events and Weddings

Locality: Chandigarh | Focus: Weddings, events and destination weddings

Rudra Events and Weddings is listed at Plot No. 54 in Chandigarh, with categories spanning event planning, wedding planning and event space. The firm has a track record in the press: in June 2020 The Indian Express quoted Vimal Roy Bhola of Rudra Events and Wedding Planners on the business of destination weddings.

In that report Bhola described confirmed destination bookings for Thailand and a Vietnam wedding that was moved to a Jaipur hotel when the pandemic intervened. Current directory detail is otherwise limited, so confirm the team’s recent weddings and its present service list directly.

Key facts:

  • Listed address: Plot No. 54, Chandigarh
  • Categories: event planner, wedding planning service, event space and venue
  • Vimal Roy Bhola quoted on destination weddings in The Indian Express, June 2020
  • Current verified public detail beyond listings is limited

19. Made In Heaven Wedding Planners

Locality: Chandigarh | Focus: Wedding planning

Made In Heaven Wedding Planners is listed at Plot No. 191 in Chandigarh as a wedding planning service, with a published contact phone of +919056772701. Fresh research found no official website, detailed directory profile or social page for this Chandigarh business, and firms with the same or similar names operate in other cities, so verified detail is limited.

As with the other lightly documented names on this list, the safeguard is the same: meet the team, confirm the registered business name and address, and ask for recent Chandigarh weddings and references you can speak to before paying an advance.

Key facts:

  • Listed address: Plot No. 191, Chandigarh
  • Listed category: wedding planning service
  • Contact phone published on its listing: +919056772701
  • No official website, detailed profile or social page found in November 2026 research
  • Verified detail is limited; same-name firms in Vadodara, Chennai and Kolkata were excluded by address and phone matching

20. NupKnots

Locality: Sector 40-D, Chandigarh | Focus: Full-service wedding planning | Website: nupknots.com

NupKnots is a full-service wedding planner at SCO 220, Second Floor, Sector 40-D, Chandigarh. Its own services page is unusually detailed, covering conceptualisation and design, venue selection and management including guest stay management, menu curation, entertainment design, hospitality with hotel reservations and help desks, trousseau help, and stationery and invitations.

Its WedAbout profile says the team has more than five years of experience and has planned 35 to 40 destination weddings, with work across Chandigarh, New Delhi, Agra, Jaipur, Mussoorie, Amritsar, Yamuna Nagar and Panchkula. WeddingWire lists its planning fee from ₹3,00,000.

Key facts:

  • Address: SCO 220, Second Floor, Sector 40-D, Chandigarh (company website)
  • Services: concept and design, venue selection and management, menu curation, entertainment design, hospitality, trousseau, stationery and invitations
  • WedAbout profile: 5+ years of experience; 35–40 destination weddings (directory-stated)
  • Areas served include Chandigarh, Delhi, Agra, Jaipur, Mussoorie, Amritsar and Panchkula
  • WeddingWire lists a planning fee from ₹3,00,000

How to Choose and Verify an Event Management Company in Chandigarh

Chandigarh has many capable planners and a few names that exist mainly as listings. This checklist keeps the good ones and filters the rest:

  • Match the specialism first. A MICE firm will not necessarily run a wedding week well, and a birthday-decor specialist is not a conference producer. Use the focus column in the comparison table.
  • Check two independent sources. Prefer companies whose claims appear both on their own website and on a directory such as WedMeGood or WeddingWire; where only one source exists, treat figures as company-stated.
  • Ask for recent, local references. Request two weddings or events from the last year in the Tricity that you can verify with the family or client, not just photographs.
  • Get the fee structure in writing. Published starting fees on this list run from ₹50,000 to ₹5,00,000 and above. Clarify whether the fee is fixed, a percentage of budget, or per function, and what it excludes.
  • Confirm who supplies what. Decor, catering, sound, light, artists and transport may be in-house or outsourced; outsourced items should be named vendors in the contract, not vague line items.
  • For destination weddings, test the logistics. Ask how the team handles guest travel, rooming lists and local permissions in Kasauli, Shimla or Jaipur, and who travels with the family.
  • Never pay the full amount in advance. Stage payments against milestones, and keep the final instalment for after the event.

FAQs About Event Management Companies in Chandigarh

Which is the best event management company in Chandigarh for corporate events?

On published evidence, Frigus Events and Marketing and Gravity Event Services are the clearest corporate specialists: both list MICE, conferences, brand activations, artist management and multi-city execution, and Gravity adds branch offices in Delhi and Gurugram. For a wedding, the wedding-led planners further down the list are a better fit.

How much does a wedding planner in Chandigarh charge?

Published directory fees vary widely. WeddingWire lists Concept Booster’s planning fee from ₹50,000 and NupKnots from ₹3,00,000, WeddingWire lists WOWsters from ₹2,00,000, WedMeGood lists Weddings n Beyond at ₹2,50,000 and Event Casters at ₹4,00,000, and Shaandaar Events’ fixed fee is listed at ₹5,00,000 and above. These are starting planning fees only; venue, catering and decor are extra.

Do Chandigarh event companies plan destination weddings outside the city?

Yes. Shaandaar Events, Weddings n Beyond, Kreative Events, Event Casters and NupKnots all publish destination-wedding work, covering the Himachal towns of Kasauli, Shimla and Solan, Jim Corbett in Uttarakhand, and Jaipur and Udaipur in Rajasthan; Shaandaar and Kreative also list international destinations.

How early should I book an event management company in Chandigarh?

Shaandaar Events recommends starting 6 to 12 months ahead, especially for destination or peak-season weddings, and that is a sensible benchmark for the popular names on this list. Smaller functions and decor-only bookings can often be arranged closer to the date, but venue-linked dates in November to February go first.

What does a full-service event management company actually handle?

Typically everything between the brief and the farewell: venue selection and booking, concept and decor design, vendor and catering management, entertainment and artist booking, guest hospitality and transport, and on-day coordination of the event flow. NupKnots’ published service list is a good example of the full stack, down to trousseau help and stationery.

How can I verify a Chandigarh planner with very little online presence?

A few names on this list, such as Rustic Wedding Vows, The Wedding Affair and Made In Heaven Wedding Planners, have limited verifiable public detail. Meet the team at a real office address, ask for the registered business name, and insist on recent client references you can call before paying any advance.

Conclusion

For corporate work in Chandigarh, start with Frigus and Gravity; for weddings, shortlist by budget and style among Shaandaar, TCC, Kreative, Event Casters, Weddings n Beyond, NupKnots and the other specialists above; and for decor-led family functions, look at Event Decor & Planners and Expert Organisers. Whichever you choose, verify recent work and get the fee structure in writing, and your event is far more likely to run the way the brochures promise.
